full_content: Dear Student, We are delighted to share a proud achievement that belongs to the entire LPU community. full_content: Link to apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/scholarship/sml-unnati-scholarship-2026-27 The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 21-10-2026 Across India, drivers of heavy and light commercial road transport vehicles for carrying goods and large passenger transport vehicles like buses spend long hours on the road, working tirelessly to build a better future for their families. However, financial constraints often become a barrier to their daughters' educational aspirations. To help bridge this gap, the SML Mahindra Scholarship Program 2026–27, an initiative by SML Mahindra Limited, aims to provide financial assistance to deserving and meritorious girl students, empowering them to continue their education with confidence and pursue their academic goals. Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: . Open to girl students pursuing undergraduate degree and diploma (any year) in STEM disciplines (A STEM field is an academic or professional discipline that falls under the categories of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics) and core engineering fields, at recognised institutions across India. . The applicant must be the daughter of a driver of a heavy or light commercial road transport vehicle for carrying goods or a large passenger transport vehicle like a bus. . Applicants must have passed the previous semester/academic year. . Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA/grade) in the previous academic year. . Annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 6,00,000. . Applications are invited from across India. . Children of employees of SML Mahindra and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: In addition to meeting the above-mentioned criteria and the merit-based selection system, preferences could be given for fulfilling any or all of the points outlined below, subject to availability of the scholarships: . Applicants from Delhi-NCR, Punjab, Chandigarh, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh and aspirational districts. . Persons with Disabilities (PwD) . Students from single-parent households or orphaned students . Transgender students Applicants whose parents are not drivers of heavy and light commercial road transport vehicles for carrying goods and large passenger transport vehicles like buses are not eligible. In case students haven't received the results of their last even semester, then they can be selected based on the results of the last odd semester as well. Benefits: Selected students will receive a scholarship of INR 30,000 for UG and Diploma Students under SML Unnati Scholarship Documents: . Recent passport-size photograph . Valid government ID proof or masked Aadhaar card . Current academic year admission proof (school/college ID card, admission letter, bonafide certificate issued by the institute confirming current enrolment, or latest fee receipt) . Previous academic year mark sheet . Fee receipts and fee structure from the institution . Graduation certificate and mark sheet for postgraduate students . Driving licence of the parent who is a driver of a heavy or light commercial road transport vehicle for carrying goods or a large passenger transport vehicle like a bus . NSQF certificate/vocational course completion certificate (if applicable) . Parental income certificate/ITR issued by a competent authority . Bank account details (copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in applicant's name or joint account with parent) . Supporting documents for special category applicants, if applicable (e.g., disability certificate, death certificate, transgender certificate, or orphan certificate), to ensure equitable consideration The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2026-27--------> SML Unnati Scholarship 2026-27 All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The Buddy4Study India Foundation Scholarship is a flagship program launched by Buddy4Study India Foundation to support students in their educational journey. Under this scholarship programme, Buddy4Study has helped more than 1,90,000 students across India through scholarships, with a total fund of more than Rs. 600 crore mobilised from 100+ partners. In the last financial year (2025–26), Buddy4Study successfully supported 74,000+ students, with 56% of the beneficiaries being girl students, reflecting a strong focus on female education. Open to Indian students pursuing undergraduate courses in B.Tech, B. Design, B.F.A., B. Arch, B. Planning, or related disciplines during the academic session 2026-27. . Applicants must be enrolled in the first or second year of their undergraduate program. . Applicants must have secured a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent in Class 12. For second-year students, an aggregate of a minimum 60% in their previous year. . Annual parental/family income must be INR 8 lakh or below. Preference will be given to: . Candidates with top All India Rank (AIR) . Single-parent child/orphans . Girl Students . PwD students . Government school students . Students from the North-East region and aspirational districts . Crisis-Based - Student in urgent need based on personal crisis | difficult situation | family crisis | without adverse impact on their education Benefits . Scholarship in the range of INR 30,000 to INR 60,000 for Design and Architecture Courses. . Scholarship in the range of INR 35,000 to INR 75,000 for Engineering Courses. . Automatic application submission assistance for other matching scholarship programmes implemented by Buddy4Study India Foundation. Documents . A recent Passport-sized photograph . Proof of identity (Masked Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, or any other valid government-issued ID). . Government-approved income certificate . Class 12 marksheet of the applicant . First-year marksheet/semester result (for second-year students only) . Entrance exam rank/scorecard, if applicable . Bank account details (copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in the applicant's name) . Current Year Admission Letter, Fee Receipt, or College ID Card The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies------->Session 2026-27--------> Buddy4Study India Foundation Scholarship for Engineering Courses, Design and Architecture. All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. full_content: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from Nov 2026 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State-of-the-Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) biannually after successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of ETP registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per university policy for that term. c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. e. In case the scholar has communicated/accepted/published a research/review article, the scholar is required to select the log request ID while registering for ETP evaluation. A log request can be generated through the supervisor’s UMS via following path: UMS Navigation --> Research and Development Cell --> Research and academic contributions --> Monthly status of research achievements/log request Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->ETP Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 1st Oct 2026 to 17th Oct 2026 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics --> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->ETP-->Click to Submit report. ETP reports will be considered only if submitted through the UMS interface. Submissions made through any other means, such as email or RMS, will not be accepted. Therefore, all scholars must ensure that their reports are uploaded through the online interface. Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 1st Oct 2026 to 17th Oct 2026 3. Selection of ETP Evaluation Slot Research scholars are required to select their preferred week for the upcoming ETP evaluation through the UMS interface after uploading the ETP report. The scholars can follow the below mentioned Path for selecting the slots: Academics --> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity--> Click to Select the ETP Evaluation Slot --> Click to select the ETP evaluation slot The selected slot will be final and cannot be changed under any circumstances. Scholars must ensure their availability as per the allotted schedule. Slot modification will be permitted only in case of a university-declared event or holiday. Note:- The scheduled slots are applicable only for RAC evaluation, and availability is limited for each domain; therefore, scholars are advised to book their slots at the earliest to secure their preferred schedule. If a scholar fails to select a slot within the stipulated timeline, the Department of Ph.D. Evaluation will automatically assign a slot based on availability. 4. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path UMS navigation -->Division of Examination--> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation -->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification -->ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 21st Oct 2026. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. d) Research scholars are required to bring two hard copies of the ETP report, duly verified and signed by the respective Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (wherever applicable), at the time of evaluation. e) It is mandatory to submit one hard copy of the ETP report to CRDP (Block 38, Room No. 304), while the second copy must be retained by the scholar for reference by the panel members during the evaluation. f) Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. g) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. h) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. i) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process/appear for the evaluation after registration will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". j) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). k) The slot booking is not applicable for Research Mentorship committee (RMC) evaluation For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines and as per guidelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: ETP. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes). Attachment: 1 Eligible scholars Nov Dec 2026.xls 2 Guidelines for ETP Report 2026.pdf 3 Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature
title: Instructions for Ph.D. Scholars and Supervisors Regarding Registration for End Term Presentation. : LPU/10.2/ANN(EXAM)/2024/023(23.4)(Vol-9)/IC/260930/0103 (9/30/2026)

full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Framework Agreement and a Student Exchange Agreement between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the University of León, Spain. This collaboration aims to foster mutual cooperation in key areas such as student and faculty exchange, joint research, teaching collaboration, exchange of institutional publications, and other mutually beneficial academic initiatives. Through the Student Exchange Agreement, LPU students will also have the opportunity to spend a semester at the University of León and gain international academic and cultural exposure. Founded in 1979, the University of León is a public university in Spain offering a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across disciplines including engineering and technology, computer science, business and economics, health sciences, education, humanities, law, agriculture, environmental sciences, food technology, biotechnology, and veterinary medicine. The university is particularly recognized for its academic and research strengths in veterinary medicine, food technology, biotechnology, health, agriculture and environmental sciences, while also offering programmes across a broad range of other disciplines. It is ranked #1001–1200 in the QS World University Rankings 2027, reflecting its international academic and research presence. As part of the Student Exchange Agreement, 3 exchange seats are available for LPU students, giving selected candidates the opportunity to study at the University of León for a semester and experience academic and cultural life in Spain. If you're interested in exploring academic, research, student exchange, and other collaborative opportunities under this new partnership with the University of León, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs at 32-310 or contact us at international@lpu.co.in Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration! Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature
title: LPU signs Framework Agreement and Student Exchange Agreement with University of León, Spain : LPU/11.2/IRC(ULE)/2026/003(3.4)/IC/260930/0001 (9/30/2026)

full_content: Dear Student, As conveyed earlier, online classes will be conducted from 5 to 7 October 2026, followed by doubt-clearing sessions on 8 and 9 October 2026, through LPU’s My Class platform. The online classes scheduled for 5, 6 and 7 October 2026 will cover the syllabus originally planned for 28, 29 and 30 September 2026, respectively, thereby ensuring completion of the entire pre-MTT syllabus. The timetable for the classes is available on UMS and the My-Class interface. Before attending the classes on LPU My-Class, you are advised to view the videos via the links given below for better understanding on how to use this online platform. 1. How To Login to My-Class: - https://youtu.be/Wj4xge0tIdg?si=uTrU_qhvkVCoDnKi 2. How To Join Online Class: - https://youtu.be/eqLFcrZXwL8?si=xRgGDbPwog83RPEx 3. Ensure your attendance at this session to ensure that you are well acquainted with the login procedure and platform usage, thereby avoiding technical difficulties and any unintended loss of attendance during the scheduled online classes. The schedule of the mock session will be communicated to you via UMS “My Messages”. Technical requirements to attend Class on LPU My Class: Ensure the below-mentioned minimum system requirements to attend online classes: . CPU: i3 Processor or equivalent (higher is always recommended) . Ram: 4 GB (higher is always recommended) . Browser: Google Chrome (Updated), Microsoft Edge (Updated) or Safari (only for Mac and IOS) . Device Form Factor: Laptop/Desktop/Tablet/Mobile (Use Laptop/Desktop preferably to avoid any technical issues) . Operating Systems: Windows, MAC, Linux, IOS or Android . Minimum Internet Speed Required: 2 MBPS . Mic: Required (To be switched on only on the faculty’s instruction; otherwise, it should be kept off) . Camera: Required (To be switched on only on the faculty’s instruction; otherwise, it should be kept off) . Headphone: Required General guidelines: 1. It is mandatory to attend all the classes as per the time-table. 2. Use a laptop/desktop for attending class (preferably). 3. Since you may be asked to switch on your camera for interaction with the faculty, ensure that you are well-dressed and well-groomed in presentable attire for all the classes. 4. Ensure that you attend the class in an undisturbed and quiet place, preferably with a plain and clear background. The room should be well-lit and airy. 5. Be seated at a table and chair while attending classes. Do not attend the class while lying or reclining on a bed or sofa. 6. Use only the chat or raise your hand option to ask a query. You can also post your queries in the respective groups on LPU Live App. 7. Maintain the decorum of the class while posting a message in the chat box. Do not use disrespectful or abusive language and refrain from criticising or mocking. 8. Be prepared and fresh for the class. Refrain from leaving the class in the middle for any purpose. 9. Indulging in any other activity like eating food, chatting/messaging on phone, attending phone calls, surfing net on other devices, etc. is strictly not allowed. In case you are found doing so, you shall be marked absent for the class. 10. Use headphones/earphones and a microphone for better reception and voice clarity. 11. Faculty will intermittently ask polling questions in the lecture. Participation in the polling questions is mandatory; otherwise, it may be counted towards absenteeism. 12. Any unauthorized use of lecture recordings such as posting a part/full lecture on any online/social media platforms or modifications in lecture recordings is strictly not allowed. You are strictly advised to keep your UMS/My Class password strictly confidential and not share your login credentials with anyone. Any unauthorised activity carried out through your respective login credentials shall be deemed your responsibility. In case of any query related to online classes, you may call the helpline on any of the numbers: 01824-520150, 01824-520099. full_content: Dear Students, With reference to the prevailing situation and concerns arising from the circulation of misleading information and rumours concerning the University, students are informed that the situation remains stable and is being closely monitored by the University. All necessary measures are in place to ensure the safety and well-being of our students. As a precautionary measure and to avoid any unnecessary anxiety or panic among students, offline classes will remain suspended from 28 September to 7 October 2026. It is assured that there will be no dilution of the academic calendar or academic loss to students. In addition, to make effective academic use of the period of offline class suspension, the following arrangements have been made: 1. To ensure academic continuity, online classes will be conducted through the LPU My Class platform on 5, 6 and 7 October 2026. Attendance in these classes will be compulsory. The updated timetable will be available shortly on UMS and My Class. 2. Instructions and videos on “How to attend class on LPU My Class platform” shall be communicated via a separate communication. 3. Doubt-clearing sessions will be conducted on 8 and 9 October 2026 in both online and offline modes to support students in their preparation for the Mid-Term Tests. Attendance at these sessions will be optional. Students attending the sessions will be marked present, while those not attending will not be marked absent. Students may also use the laboratories on these days for practice and revision. 4. Students wishing to attend the doubt-clearing sessions in offline mode may travel back to the University on 8 or 9 October 2026. Those attending the sessions online may utilise 10 and 11 October 2026 for their return travel to University. 5. The Mid-Term Tests (MTT) will be conducted from 12 to 17 October 2026. The updated MTT date sheet will be communicated to students through UMS soon. 6. Students having no MTT, or whose MTT has already been conducted, will resume regular offline classes from 12 October 2026. They will also follow the online class and doubt-clearing schedule from 5 to 9 October 2026 as stated above. 7. The academic calendar of Autumn Term 2026-27 will be suitably extended, wherever required, and the End-Term Practical Examinations will be conducted after the End-Term Theory Examinations to ensure completion of all prescribed academic requirements. The final date of commencement of Spring Term 2026-27 will be shared with you through the UMS “My Messages”. Note: Placement drives will continue to be conducted as scheduled. Students registered for upcoming drives are advised to check UMS regularly for updates. Depending on company requirements, some students may need to report to the University earlier. The exact reporting date will be communicated individually through UMS My Messages. The University remains firmly committed to your academic progress, career and future. At times, disruptive elements may attempt to divert your attention from your larger goals; we therefore urge you to remain focused, responsible and committed to your aspirations. Let us continue to work together in a spirit of mutual trust and cooperation, so that the University takes pride in your achievements. For any queries, you may submit an RMS through the Relationship Management System under the Category: Academics, Sub Category: Online Classes. With Regards Lovely Professional University

full_content: Dear Students, The School of Design (Interior & Product) invites students to participate in Edu-Rev Projects under the EDU Revolution initiative—an opportunity to move beyond conventional classroom learning and apply their design knowledge to real-world spaces, functional requirements and practical design solutions. Why Should You Participate? . Work on real-world design requirements identified across the University. . Apply classroom knowledge to practical interior, furniture and spatial design solutions. . Strengthen design thinking, problem-solving and technical skills. . Develop projects that enhance your academic and professional portfolio. . Gain practical experience through project-based learning. . Understand the relationship between design proposals, user requirements, materials and execution considerations. . Be considered for an academic benefit under the EDU Revolution framework, subject to the prescribed process. Courses Covered Under This Initiative The Edu-Rev Project initiative has been identified for the following courses under the School of Design (Interior & Product): Course Code Course Name PID163 Design Tools IFD361 Design Studio III IFD222 Furniture design PID227 Furniture design IFD261 Design Studio I IFD242 Building material and construction Project Participation Students may undertake an approved project individually or in a team, as applicable to the respective course and project requirements. Students are encouraged to select a project that aligns with their design skills, interests, technical readiness and ability to complete the identified design requirement. Project Approval & Course Equivalence Students undertaking an Edu-Rev Project may be considered for Course Equivalence under the EDU Revolution framework. . Submission of a nomination does not guarantee approval. . The Standing Committee will evaluate and approve proposed projects at its discretion. . Project approval does not automatically guarantee Course Equivalence; the approved project must be completed, and all prescribed requirements must be fulfilled. . The academic benefit under Course Equivalence is determined after end-semester evaluation of the completed project and consideration of the prescribed requirements. . The Standing Committee's decision regarding project approval, eligibility and academic benefit is final, subject to applicable University regulations. End-Semester Project Evaluation . All approved projects will be evaluated at the end of the semester through the prescribed evaluation process. . Students must demonstrate the completed project and fulfil all requirements applicable to the approved project. . Course Equivalence is granted only after successful completion and evaluation of the approved project and fulfilment of prescribed requirements. . Faculty should retain evidence of the student's/team's contribution, design process, final output and other project-specific requirements for evaluation. How to Apply LMS → LPU EDU Revolution: Be the Change → Apply for EDU Revolution → Project Students are strongly encouraged to review the available project details before submitting their nomination and select a project that they can successfully undertake and complete. Project List & Detailed Specifications The complete project basket, course mapping, programme applicability, project scope, and expected deliverables are available in the Google link mentioned below. full_content: Dear Students, The School of Electronics and Electrical Engineering invites students to participate in projects under the EDU-REV initiative-an opportunity to move beyond conventional classroom learning and apply Electronics and Electrical Engineering knowledge to real-world problems, innovative ideas and practical solutions. The complete project list and information are available in the attached document. Why Should You Participate? . Work on real-world and meaningful Electronics and Electrical Engineering problem statements. . Apply classroom knowledge to practical engineering solutions. . Strengthen technical, problem-solving, design and innovation skills. . Develop projects that enhance your portfolio and career profile. . Gain hands-on experience through project-based learning, circuit design, simulation, programming, testing and prototyping. . Explore innovative and potentially patentable engineering solutions. . Develop interdisciplinary skills by integrating electronics, electrical systems, embedded systems, IoT, automation, AI and data analytics. . Be considered for an academic benefit under the EDU Revolution framework, subject to the prescribed process. Project Opportunities The School has identified project opportunities across Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, IoT, Automation, Control Systems, Communication Systems, VLSI, Renewable Energy, Electric Vehicles, Power Systems, Robotics and Artificial Intelligence applications. Project Participation Students may undertake an approved project individually or in a team. Maximum Team Size: 4 Students Students are encouraged to select a project that aligns with their skills, interests and technical readiness. Each team member should make a meaningful contribution to the approved project. Project Approval & Course Equivalence Students undertaking an EDU-REV Project may be considered for Course Equivalence under the EDU Revolution framework. . Submission of a nomination does not guarantee approval of the project. . The Standing Committee will evaluate and approve the proposed project at its discretion. . Approval of a project does not automatically guarantee Course Equivalence. Students must complete the approved project and fulfil all prescribed requirements specified in the project application. . The Standing Committee will determine the academic benefit under Course Equivalence after evaluating the completed project at the end of the semester and considering the prescribed requirements. . The decision of the Standing Committee regarding project approval, eligibility, and academic benefit shall be final, subject to applicable University regulations. End-Semester Project Evaluation . All approved projects will be evaluated at the end of the semester through the prescribed evaluation process. . Students will be required to demonstrate the completed project and fulfil all requirements applicable to the approved project. . The evaluation may include assessment of the project design, implementation, prototype/model, simulation results, technical documentation, innovation, individual contribution and demonstration. . The Standing Committee will determine the academic benefit under Course Equivalence based on the project evaluation and fulfilment of the prescribed requirements. .Course Equivalence will be granted only after successful completion and evaluation of the approved project and fulfilment of the prescribed requirements. How to Apply LMS → LPU EDU Revolution: Be the Change → Apply for EDU Revolution → Project Students are strongly encouraged to review the available project details before submitting their nomination and select a project that they can successfully undertake and complete. Students are encouraged to think beyond conventional projects, identify real-world engineering challenges, develop innovative solutions and transform their ideas into working prototypes or practical engineering applications. full_content: The Actuarial Innovation Challenge (AIC) 2026 is a South Asia-wide case study competition jointly hosted by the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA), Institute of Actuarial & Quantitative Studies (IAQS), and Swiss Re. Now in its third edition, the challenge provides students with an opportunity to apply their analytical thinking, research, problem-solving and presentation skills to a real-world case study. Participants will work in teams to develop innovative solutions and present their ideas to professionals from the actuarial and wider industry community. Why Participate? - Work on a real-world challenge: Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to a practical case study beyond the classroom. - Develop innovative solutions: Work as a team to analyse the challenge, conduct research and develop an original approach. - Gain industry exposure: Understand how actuarial thinking and analytical skills are applied to real-world business and societal challenges. - Showcase your ideas: Present your solution to professionals from the actuarial and industry community. - Connect with employers: Finalists will have the opportunity to participate in the IFoA Student Showcase, providing an opportunity to interact and network with employers. - Gain recognition: Compete for prizes and receive certificates of recognition for your participation and achievements. Competition Timeline The competition will progress through multiple stages, beginning with the screening round and culminating in a live grand finale. Stage Date Registration open 16 September 2026 Registration closes and screening submission are due 11 October 2026 Screening winners announced 19 October 2026 Virtual semi-finals 4-6 November 2026 Finalists announced 7 November 2026 Grand Finale 6 December 2026 The Grand Finale will be held live at the IFoA India Conference in New Delhi, giving the finalists an opportunity to present their solutions in front of professionals from the actuarial and industry community. Who Can Participate? The challenge is open to undergraduate and postgraduate students. Students interested in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, finance, economics, business, data analytics, risk, or related areas are encouraged to participate. Students are encouraged to form teams and register for the competition. How to Register Interested students can register through the LPU registration form: https://forms.gle/RJ1fTbpbD8nc4q76A The registration deadline is 11 October 2026. The official competition page will contain the case study, participation guidelines and other information provided by the organisers: For Faculty Members Faculty members are encouraged to share this opportunity with interested students and motivate them to participate in the challenge. The competition provides students with an opportunity to apply classroom learning to a practical case study while gaining exposure to actuarial professionals and the wider industry. full_content: Sitaram Jindal Scholarship 2026-27 The Sitaram Jindal Scholarship is a merit-cum-means scholarship program by the Sitaram Jindal Foundation, Bengaluru, supporting students from Class 11 up to post-graduation across multiple streams. The scholarship provides financial assistance to help eligible students meet tuition, hostel, and academic expenses. Under the Sitaram Jindal Scholarship 2026, eligible students can receive financial assistance ranging from Rs. 500 to Rs. 3,200 per month, depending on the course and category. Additional hostel allowances of Rs. 1,200–Rs. 1,800 per month are also available. Eligibility Open to students across India enrolled in Class 11–12, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate programmes. Minimum marks criteria vary by category (e.g., 60% for boys / 55% for girls in Class 11–12; 65%/60% for Engineering/Medicine). Applicant’s annual family income must be up to Rs 400,000 (salaried) or Rs 250,000 (others). Maximum age limit: 30 years. Applicable to students from General, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS categories. Special provisions for widows, wards of ex-servicemen, and physically challenged students. Benefits Scholarship amount: Rs. 500–Rs. 3,200 per month depending on course and category. Hostel allowance: Rs.1,200– Rs.1,800 per month. Financial assistance is intended to cover tuition fees, hostel charges, and academic expenses. Applicants must declare they are not receiving other scholarships. Application Deadline Open throughout the year (no fixed deadline) Registration Details Apply Online:https://www.buddy4study.com/article/sitaram-jindal-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/9Y3V6U7XXtZtQBn38 Note Selection is based on merit-cum-means criteria. Applicants must submit academic records, income proof, and supporting documents. Renewal is possible annually based on performance and compliance with rules. Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in. full_content: Dear Students, The School of Mechanical Engineering invites students to participate in Edu-Rev Projects under the EDU Revolution initiative—an opportunity to move beyond conventional classroom learning and apply their technical knowledge to real-world problems and practical solutions. Why Should You Participate? . Work on real-world and meaningful problem statements. . Apply classroom knowledge to practical solutions. . Strengthen technical, problem-solving and innovation skills. . Develop projects that enhance your portfolio. . Gain practical experience through project-based learning. . Be considered for an academic benefit under the EDU Revolution framework, subject to the prescribed process. Courses Covered Under This Initiative The Edu-Rev Project initiative has been taken for the following courses: 1. Introduction to Cryogenics (ASE419) 2. Thermo-Fluids (MEC235) 3. Design of UAV Systems (ASE438) 4. Aerospace Engineering Drawing (ASE201) 5. Automobile Engineering Drawing (ATE201) 6. Machining Processes (MEC425) 7. AI and ML for Mechanical Engineering (MEC731) 8. Finite Element Analysis Laboratory (MEC467) 9. Design Project (MEC581) Project Participation Students may undertake an approved project individually or in a team. Maximum Team Size: 4 Students Students are encouraged to select a project that aligns with their skills, interests and technical readiness. Each team member should make a meaningful contribution to the approved project. Project Approval & Course Equivalence Students undertaking an Edu-Rev Project may be considered for Course Equivalence under the EDU Revolution framework. . Submission of a nomination does not guarantee approval of the project. . The Standing Committee will evaluate and approve the proposed project at its discretion. . Approval of a project does not automatically guarantee Course Equivalence. Students must complete the approved project and fulfil all prescribed requirements specified in the project application. . The Standing Committee will determine the academic benefit under Course Equivalence after evaluating the completed project at the end of the semester and considering the prescribed requirements. . The decision of the Standing Committee regarding project approval, eligibility, and academic benefit shall be final, subject to applicable University regulations. End-Semester Project Evaluation . full_content: The Mahindra EmpowerHer Scholarship Program 2026–27 is an initiative by Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, launched to help meritorious girl students belonging to the SC, ST or OBC communities from low-income families continue their education without interruption. This opportunity is open to eligible girl students pursuing general undergraduate and postgraduate courses. The program offers financial assistance that eases the burden of academic expenses and allows young women across India to focus on what matters most building a future shaped by their own ambition and ability. Link to apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/mahindra-empowerher-scholarship-program The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 21-09-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: . Open to girl students belonging to SC, ST or OBC communities pursuing general undergraduate courses (such as B.A., B.A. Hons, B.Sc. or B.Com.) and general postgraduate courses (such as M.A., M.A. Hons, M.Sc. or M.Com.). . Applicants must have secured at least 50% marks in their previous academic year or semester. . Annual family income from all sources should not exceed INR 4,00,000. . Students from PAN India are eligible to apply. . Children of employees of Mahindra & Mahindra Limited and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: Preference will be given to persons with disabilities (PwD). . Students awaiting their latest results can apply using their previous semester's or academic year's marks. If the result of the last even semester has not been declared, the result of the last odd semester may be used instead. Benefits: Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship award of INR 5,500. Documents: . Applicant’s recent passport-size photograph . Valid government ID proof or masked Aadhaar card . Current year admission proof (e.g., college ID card for the current academic year, bonafide certificate issued by the institute confirming current enrolment, or latest fee receipt) . Previous academic year mark-sheet (last available marksheet) . Class 10th and 12th mark sheet (if applicable) . Graduation marksheet for a postgraduate student . Document proof for SC, ST, OBC category . Supporting document proof for disability (if applicable) . Parental income certificate/ITR by a competent authority . Educational expenses receipts (tuition fees, hostel fees, books, etc.) . Fee Receipts from the school/college . Bank account details (copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in the applicant’s name/ joint account with parent) The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2026-27--------> Mahindra EmpowerHer Scholarship Program 2026-27 All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of SBI Foundation, the corporate social responsibility arm of the State Bank of India. The programme aims to support meritorious students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds and help them continue their education without financial constraints.The scholarship covers students for undergraduate programme and postgraduate programme. Under the programme, selected students can receive financial assistance ranging from INR 75,000 to INR 1,50,000 per academic year, depending on their scholarship category. The application process is completely online, and no application fee is charged. The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the selected students through Direct Benefit Transfer. Link to apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-asha-scholarship-program The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 19-09-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: . Open to Indian nationals pursuing an undergraduate and master’s degree or another eligible postgraduate programme at a recognised institution in India in regular mode. .The applicant’s institution must fulfil at least one of the following conditions: i. Hold a valid NAAC accreditation of Grade ‘A’ or above, or ii. Be ranked among the Top 300 institutions in the Overall Category of the NIRF 2025-26 rankings. . Applicants must have secured at least 75% marks or an equivalent 7.0 CGPA in the previous academic year or qualifying examination. . Applicants belonging to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe categories will receive a 10% relaxation in the minimum academic requirement. . The applicant’s total annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 6,00,000. . Students enrolled in diploma or certificate programmes are not eligible under this category. Note: The applicable family-income limits, institutional requirements and course restrictions differ by scholarship category. Applicants should therefore apply only under the category that corresponds to their current course and institution. Benefits: Selected Undergraduate students can receive financial assistance of up to INR 75,000 per academic year. Selected postgraduate students can receive financial assistance of up to INR 1,50,000 per academic year. Note: The scholarship amount may be utilised towards eligible education-related expenses, including tuition fees, hostel or accommodation expenses, books, study materials, examination fees, educational equipment and other course-related expenses. Documents: . Recent passport-size photograph of the applicant . Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence or another valid government-issued identity proof . Class 10 marksheet . Class 12 marksheet . Previous semester or academic year marksheet, (Undergraduate Programme) Graduation semester-wise or year-wise marksheets (Postgraduate Programme) . Graduation degree certificate or provisional degree certificate (Postgraduate Programme) . Previous postgraduate semester or academic year marksheet, wherever applicable (Postgraduate Programme) . Current undergraduate / postgraduate admission letter, admission confirmation or allotment document . Bonafide certificate or valid student identity card issued by the institution . Latest tuition fee or academic fee receipt . Official course fee structure issued by the institution . Government-issued family income certificate . Form 16A, salary slips or another valid income proof, wherever applicable . Bank passbook displaying the applicant’s name, account number, IFSC, bank name and branch details . SC or ST caste certificate, wherever applicable . Disability certificate issued by a competent authority, wherever applicable . Proof of the institution’s applicable NAAC accreditation or NIRF ranking, wherever requested . Death certificate of a parent, divorce decree, separation document or relevant affidavit, wherever applicable . Education loan sanction letter, wherever applicable . Details of any other scholarship, grant or financial assistance received or applied for . Any additional document requested during the verification or selection process The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2026-27--------> SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship for Undergraduate / Postgraduate Students 2026 All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The Student Welfare Wing is inviting applications for the position of Student Instructor – Fashion & Modelling to manage and support the Fashion Society Club and train students for various university events, competitions, fashion shows, photoshoots, and other professional activities. Key Performance Areas:- 1. Ensure timely delivery of scheduled modelling and fashion training sessions with active student participation. 2. Ensure measurable improvement in students’ modelling, presentation, styling, and professional skills. 3. Prepare students effectively for fashion shows, competitions, photoshoots, and other events. 4. Maintain positive student feedback regarding training quality, practical guidance, and engagement. 5. Develop students’ creative, technical, communication, and professional skills related to modelling and fashion. Roles & Responsibilities Conduct practical and theoretical modelling and fashion training sessions. Prepare students for fashion shows, competitions, photoshoots, and university events. Mentor students in modelling, ramp walk, stage presence, posture, grooming, styling, and presentation skills. Plan and conduct demonstrations, practice sessions, rehearsals, and other training activities. Guide students in developing confidence, creativity, communication, and professional etiquette. Coordinate and assist in organizing fashion shows, modelling events, and related activities. Provide individual feedback and guidance to help students improve their performance. Support the Fashion Society Club in conducting regular activities and events. Eligibility Criteria · Qualification: Master’s degree or above. · Minimum CGPA: 5.5 and above. · Work Experience: 2–3 years of relevant experience in modelling. · Experience in judging and choreographing 2–3 fashion/modelling shows outside the university. · Experience as a freelancer in conducting or coordinating fashion shows. · Candidates should have relevant practical exposure in modelling, fashion shows, choreography, and student training. Personal Qualities Required· State-level title achiever in modelling/fashion-related competitions. Experience in organizing at least one event related to modelling or fashion shows. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Confident, creative, organized, and professional approach. Ability to motivate and mentor students effectively. How to Apply Interested students must apply through the UMS Portal using the following path: UMS Navigation → Student Welfare System → Part-Time Job Module → Student Registration OR Apply directly through the Part-Time Job Application (Job ID: 293) section on the UMS Portal. full_content: The Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is a collaborative CSR initiative by the Kotak Mahindra Group, implemented in partnership with the Kotak Education Foundation. This scholarship is designed to provide financial assistance to deserving girl students from underprivileged backgrounds, enabling them to pursue higher education in professional fields after completing Class 12. For the 2026 Kotak Kanya Scholarship, eligible girl students who have passed Class 12 and wish to enroll in reputable professional graduation courses (Engineering, Architecture, Design, integrated LLB, and others) are invited to apply. Selected students will receive a scholarship of ?1.5 lakh per year to help cover their academic expenses until they complete their degree. Link to apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30-09-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: . Open for meritorious girl students across India. . Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. . Applicant's annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000. . Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees, such as Engineering, Integrated LLB (5 Years) or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). . Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits: . A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. . The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilized to cover academic expenses, including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. Documents: . Marksheet of previous qualifying examination (Class 12) . Income proof of parents/guardians . ITR of parents for FY 2025-26 (if available) . Fee structure (for academic year 2026-27) . Bonafide student certificate/letter from college . College seat allocation document . College entrance examination scorecard . Masked Aadhaar card . Bank passbook . A passport-size photograph . Disability certificate (if applicable) . Death certificate of the parent (for single-parent/orphan candidates) . Photographs of the house Note: The scholarship will be operational and run through till the completion of the girl student’s professional graduation degree or professional courses pursued alongside graduation. However, for the scholarship renewal in successive years, the scholars must fulfil the following renewal criteria: . No dropout (from regular academic sessions) . No disciplinary issues . Students should receive at least 6 CGPA yearly or should be promoted by the Institute to the next Academic Year. The criteria are to be decided by Kotak Education Foundation from time to time. . The renewal of the scholarship every year will be at the sole discretion of the Kotak Education Foundation. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2026-27--------> Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The Centre for Professional Enhancement, in collaboration with the School of Law, is going to conduct “Internship Decoded – A workshop on Mentor Selection, Learning Outcomes & Skill Building.” This event is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the internship journey—from identifying the right mentor and setting clear learning goals to developing industry-relevant skills and maximizing practical exposure. The event will help participants understand how effective mentorship, purposeful learning, and continuous skill development can transform an internship into a meaningful career-building experience. Further, the event will encourage students to take ownership of their professional development, identify key competencies required in the workplace, and make the most of mentorship and internship opportunities. The main objectives of the event are: · To help participants understand the role of mentors in guiding their internship journey and professional development. · To enable students to identify clear learning outcomes, professional goals, and skill-building priorities during their internship. · To develop industry-relevant skills, professional communication, problem-solving, adaptability, and workplace readiness. · To encourage students to actively seek feedback, reflect on their experiences, and convert internship exposure into measurable learning and career growth. · To empower participants to approach internships with a structured, goal-oriented, and growth-focused mindset. Target audience: The students from School of Law, Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 11th September, 2026 Time: 03:30 PM Onwards Venue: Block 20-302 Resource Person: Mr. Chander Shekhar Sharma Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/InternshipDecodedWorkshop Attachment: 1 Brochure.jpeg Uploaded By: Office of HOD Centre for Professional Enhancement *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. full_content: SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship for Postgraduate Students 2026 The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship for Postgraduate Students 2026 provides financial assistance to eligible postgraduate students pursuing master’s degrees or other eligible postgraduate programmes at recognised institutions in India. Eligibility Open to Indian nationals pursuing a master’s degree or another eligible postgraduate programme at a recognised institution in India. The applicant’s institution must fulfil at least one of the following conditions: hold a valid NAAC accreditation of Grade ‘A’ or above, or be ranked among the Top 300 institutions in the Overall Category of the NIRF 2025-26 rankings. Applicants must have secured at least 75% marks or an equivalent 7.0 CGPA in the previous academic year or qualifying examination. Applicants belonging to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe categories will receive a 10% relaxation in the minimum academic requirement. The applicant’s total annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 6,00,000. Students enrolled in diploma or certificate programmes are not eligible under this category. Note: The applicable family-income limits, institutional requirements and course restrictions differ by scholarship category. Applicants should therefore apply only under the category that corresponds to their current course and institution. Benefits Selected postgraduate students can receive financial assistance of up to INR 1,50,000 per academic year. Note: The scholarship amount may be utilised towards eligible education-related expenses, including tuition fees, hostel or accommodation expenses, books, study materials, examination fees, educational equipment and other course-related expenses. Application Deadline:-19 September 2026. Scholarship Link Apply Now –https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-platinum-jubilee-asha-scholarship-for-iit-students-2026 Google Form- https://forms.gle/Bnvkzd96m3Cycdbw7 Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. In case of any query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in. full_content: This is to inform all that the Institutional Animal Ethics Committee (IAEC) meeting for the consideration of pre-clinical studies is tentatively scheduled to be held in November 2026. All concerned faculty members/guides are requested to submit the duly completed Form B (attached herewith) on or before 15th October 2026 at Room 5-101. Please note that Form B submissions received after the specified deadline will not be entertained. Important Instructions for Form B Submission, Presentation, and Animal Work 1. Guide Evaluation:Form B must be thoroughly evaluated and verified by the respective Guide/Co-guide before submission. The Guide/Co-guide and students will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of the submitted Form B. 2. Submission Protocol:Form B must be submitted by the respective Guide only. 3. Correction and Re submission:If any corrections are suggested during scrutiny, the corrected Form B must be resubmitted within 1–3 days, along with the earlier version. Late re submission will not be accepted. 4. Attendance at Meetings:Attendance at the Pre-IAEC meeting (if conducted) and the IAEC meeting is mandatory for both the Guide and the concerned student(s). Failure to attend may result in non-approval/deferment of the Form B to the next IAEC meeting. 5. IAEC Certification:The certificate/documentation related to the approved animal work will be issued only after submission of the duly completed Form D and summary report, signed by the Guide and other authorized personnel, as applicable. 6. Faculty/Guide Involvement:All faculty members/Guides are requested to visit the Animal House and actively assist and guide their respective students during animal-related work. 7. Review of Instructions:Before signing Form B, the Guide and concerned personnel must carefully read and follow all instructions provided in Form B, including the instructions related to personnel involved in the animal work. 8. Personnel Responsibility:Only the names of the actual personnel responsible for carrying out the proposed animal work (including research scholars/co-guides, wherever applicable) should be mentioned in Form B. Only the persons duly authorized and listed in the approved Form B will be permitted to carry out animal-related work in the Animal House. 9. Integrity of Form B:The prescribed format of Form B must not be altered, modified, or tampered with. Any unauthorized alteration of the format may result in the Form B being rejected/not considered for presentation before the IAEC. All concerned are requested to strictly adhere to the above guidelines and submission deadline to facilitate smooth scrutiny, presentation, and timely consideration of Form B during the upcoming IAEC meeting. Your cooperation is highly appreciated. Attachment: 1 Revised Form B 202003.doc Uploaded By: Office of HOD School of Pharmaceutical Sciences *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the University of the Philippines (UP), Philippines. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual cooperation in key areas such as student and faculty exchange, joint research, teaching collaboration, exchange of institutional publications, and other mutually beneficial academic initiatives. Established in 1908, the University of the Philippines (UP) is the national university of the Philippines and the country's premier institution for higher learning. With a university system comprising multiple constituent universities and campuses across the Philippines, UP offers a wide range of academic programmes across disciplines including science and engineering, agriculture, social sciences, management, education, law, and arts and letters. Ranked #=402 in the QS World University Rankings 2027, the university is internationally recognized for its academic excellence, research contributions, and significant role in national development. If you're interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with the University of the Philippines, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs at 32-310. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration! Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Study Abroad *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement.To join the Skill Development Courses, you are required to complete the payment through the enrollment link provided below by 31st August, 2026. full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the University of Nottingham, United Kingdom. Founded in 1881 and based in Nottingham, United Kingdom, the University of Nottingham is a leading research-intensive university with a strong international reputation for excellence in education, research, and innovation. A member of the prestigious Russell Group, the university is ranked #97 in the QS World University Rankings, placing it among the world’s top 100 universities. The University of Nottingham is widely recognized for its academic and research strengths across disciplines, including engineering, sciences, medicine and health sciences, business, social sciences, humanities, and the arts. Through this partnership, LPU students and faculty will have opportunities to explore international academic exposure, collaborative research, mobility initiatives, knowledge exchange, and other avenues of global engagement with one of the United Kingdom’s leading universities. If you are interested in exploring joint academic initiatives, research collaborations, or study abroad opportunities with the University of Nottingham, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs at 32-310. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting global collaboration! full_content: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 is an initiative of Kotak Mahindra Group Companies, aimed at providing financial support to meritorious girl students from economically disadvantaged sections to help them pursue higher education. Under this scholarship, eligible girl students pursuing professional undergraduate courses can receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to cover their academic expenses and other educational costs. Eligibility Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and an Indian citizen. Must have secured at least 75% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII. Annual family income must not exceed INR 6,00,000 from all sources. Must have secured admission to a recognized institution for a professional undergraduate course. The scholarship is applicable for professional undergraduate courses in fields such as Engineering, Medicine, Design, Architecture, Specialised Commerce, Finance, Computer Courses, and other professional courses. The applicant must be studying in a recognized college/university/institution in India. Benefits Selected students will receive scholarships of up to INR 1,50,000 per year to support their educational expenses. Application Deadline: 31 August Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/kotak-kanya-scholarship Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EnF7gh947EmjwYXWA Note It is mandatory for all candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for scholarship qualification. full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. To join the Skill Development Courses, you are required to complete the payment through the enrollment link provided below by 30th August, 2026. Please note: As per the requests received from students, the last date for registration has been extended to 30th August, 2026.Tentatively classes will start in the First week of September and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. full_content: Dear Students, The School of Computer Science & Engineering invites students to participate in Edu-Rev Projects under the EDU Revolution initiative—an opportunity to move beyond conventional classroom learning and apply your technical knowledge to real-world problems and practical solutions. EDU Revolution is a student-centric initiative that recognizes and rewards learning acquired beyond the classroom through projects and other achievement-oriented activities. Why Should You Participate? . Work on real-world and meaningful problem statements. . Apply classroom knowledge to practical solutions. . Strengthen technical, problem-solving and innovation skills. . Develop projects that enhance your portfolio and career profile. . Gain practical experience through project-based learning. . Be considered for an academic benefit under the EDU Revolution framework, subject to the prescribed process. Courses Covered Under This Initiative The EduRev Project initiative has been taken for the following courses: CSE326: Internet Programming Laboratory INT252: Web App Development with REACTJS INT253: Web Development in Python using DJANGO INT257: Modern Web Application Development Project Participation Students may undertake an approved project individually or in a team. Maximum Team Size: 4 Students Students are encouraged to select a project that aligns with their skills, interests and technical readiness. Each team member should make a meaningful contribution to the approved project. Project Approval & Course Equivalence Students undertaking an Edu-Rev Project may be considered for Course Equivalence under the EDU Revolution framework. . Submission of a nomination does not guarantee approval of the project. . The approval and selection of the project shall be at the sole discretion of the Standing Committee. . Approval of a project does not automatically guarantee Course Equivalence. . Students must successfully complete the approved project and fulfill the prescribed requirements once the standing committee approves the project application. . The academic benefit under Course Equivalence will be decided by the Standing Committee after evaluation of the completed project at the end of the semester and consideration of the prescribed requirements. . The decision of the Standing Committee regarding project approval, eligibility and academic benefit shall be final, subject to university regulations. End-Semester Project Evaluation All approved projects will be evaluated at the end of the semester through the prescribed evaluation process. Students will be required to demonstrate the completed project and fulfill the requirements applicable to the approved project. The Standing Committee will take the final decision regarding Course Equivalence after considering the project evaluation and prescribed requirements. Course Equivalence is therefore not automatic upon registration, project approval or project participation. How to Apply UMS → LMS → EDU Revolution: Be the Change → Apply for EDU Revolution → Project Nominations will be placed before the School Standing Committee for review and consideration. Students are strongly encouraged to review the available project details before submitting their nomination and select a project that they can successfully undertake and complete. Project List & Detailed Specifications https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vy9eEHqU2Rv86O-8SrCbq57k8r1WudUm For guidance and assistance regarding EDU Revolution, students may visit the EDU Revolution Query and Assistance Zone, Block 38-205B or may contact: 1. Mr. Pushpendra Kumar Pateriya ( Phone No-8427578606) 2. Dr.Chirag Sharma ( Phone No-9464014927) 3. Dr.Subhita ( Phone No- 9872436377) TAKE THE CHALLENGE. BUILD. INNOVATE. Transform your classroom learning into practical solutions, meaningful projects and a stronger professional portfolio. Step forward. Choose your challenge. Build something that matters!
