full_content: Students with pending E grades are being provided an opportunity to strengthen their academic preparation through Remedial Classes. In addition to comprehensive coverage of the course syllabus, students opting for the 40-hour Remedial Classes will have an opportunity to improve their attendance marks, in the registered course to maintaining the prescribed attendance in the Remedial Classes. Students may register for either of the following two options as per their academic requirements: Option Benefits Fee Option 1: 10 Hours Quick revision of important topics before the examination Rs. 300 per course Option 2: 40 Hours Complete syllabus coverage Opportunity to improve attendance marks earned during the regular term Rs. 1,000 per course Attendance-Based Academic Benefit in Option 2 Your attendance in the 40-hour Remedial Classes can directly help you earn additional attendance marks: Final Attendance in 40-Hour Remedial Classes Attendance Marks 75% to less than 80% 2 marks 80% to less than 85% 3 marks 85% to less than 90% 4 marks 90% and above 5 marks The attendance marks will be calculated only on the basis of the final attendance maintained in the 40-hour Remedial Classes. Important Guidelines 1. A minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory for students registered in Remedial Classes. 2. The provision for earning attendance marks is applicable only to students registered under Option 2 (40-hour classes). No attendance marks benefit will be applicable under Option 1. 3. A maximum of 5 attendance marks may be awarded for each registered course. In case, the attendance of student doesn’t improve, then the best existing attendance shall prevail. 4. The attendance benefit will be given only in registered course. 5. Classes will commence from 1 September 2026 (tentatively) and will be conducted after 05:00 PM. 6. The mode of classes will be Offline, depending on the number of registrations. 7. A student can register for a maximum of 2 courses. 8. Classes will be conducted only if sufficient registrations are received. 9. The registration fee is non-refundable, and no deregistration will be allowed, and the fees for the classes will be automatically reflected in their UMS only after the commencement of the classes. 10. The examination will be conducted after completion of the Remedial Classes. 11. Students enrolling in Remedial Classes must separately register for the corresponding E grade examination, wherever applicable, through the designated examination registration portal. How to Register Last Date of Registration is 25th August 2026. Students can register for the tuition/remedial classes through UMS using the following path: UMS Navigation ----> Examination System -----> Exam Registration ------> Registration for Remedial/Tuition Classes. Or to register Click here (Link only applicable on UMS) Need Help? In Case of any query, student may log RMS at UMS Navigation---- RMS--- Log Request--- Student Relationship (DSR) ---- Academic Support--- Additional Tutoring classes or contact us at 01824-520150 or may visit DSR (32-100) Students are encouraged to make effective use of this academic support initiative. full_content: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. They breed in containers holding water and remain around the breeding site. full_content: All Schools, Divisions and Departments of Lovely Professional University are informed that the Centre for Space Science (CSS), R&D Cell, LPU is organizing National Space Day (NSpD – 2026) as a university-wide celebration on Friday, 21 August 2026. National Space Day is observed annually on 23rd of August to commemorate the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 and to promote awareness of India's achievements in space science and technology. Students, faculty members and researchers from all Schools are invited to participate in this interdisciplinary celebration showcasing the applications of space technology across diverse domains. Program Details 10:00 – 10:15 AM Inaugural Ceremony (32-513) 10:30 – 11:30 AM Keynote Address (32-513) 11:30 – 01:00 PM Space Expo (30-603) 11:30 – 01:00 PM Geospatial Innovation Challenge (30-604) 01:00 – 02:00 PM Lunch Break 02:00 – 03:30 PM Space Debate Championship (38-119) 03:30 – 04:30 PM Award Ceremony (38-119) 04:30 – 05:00 PM Valedictory Ceremony (38-119) Keynote Speaker Dr. Rishitosh K. Sinha, Scientist/Engineer SF, Planetary Remote Sensing Section, Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), Ahmedabad, Department of Space, Government of India, will deliver the keynote lecture. His expertise in planetary remote sensing and his contributions to the Chandrayaan and Mars Orbiter Mission-based research will offer valuable insights into India's space missions, planetary exploration and emerging opportunities in the space sector. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Bio Engineering and Biosciences is going to conduct “SDG in a Snapshot: A Competitive Event on Visual Storytelling.” The event is designed to engage students in a collaborative and competitive activity where teams of two will explore the university surroundings, capture a photograph representing one or more Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and present their visual interpretation before the audience. Through this activity, students will connect global sustainability goals with real-life situations while developing their observation, creativity, teamwork, critical thinking, and communication skills. The challenge encourages students to look beyond the classroom, identify meaningful SDG-related practices or issues, and communicate their ideas effectively through visual storytelling. The main objectives of the event: · To enhance students’ communication and presentation skills through visual storytelling. · To develop observation, creativity, and critical thinking by connecting real-life situations with SDG themes. · To encourage students to identify and interpret sustainability-related issues in their surroundings. · To strengthen teamwork and collaborative learning through pair-based participation. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Department of Communication Skills presents an opportunity to join “Ummute” Club – a space that help students break barriers of fear, hesitation, and self-doubt while building communication skills, leadership qualities, and confidence. full_content: Dear Students, The Centre for Professional Enhancement (CPE) is conducting the AMCAT Final Assessment on 22 and 23 August, 2026 for 2027 batch placement registered students of MBA, Engg, MCA, pharma programs. For some students, this assessment will serve both as the Summer PEP End Term Examination (ETT) and as a Placement Preparation Assessment. For students who are not part of the Summer PEP (MBA, Pharma), or whose Summer PEP ETT has already been conducted through the OMR-based examination process (Civil, CHEM) the same assessment will serve as a Placement Preparation Assessment for the 2027 placement process. School Exam Date Purpose of the Assessment Agri (Engg.), SCSE, Bio (Engg.), SCAP (All), SEEE, MECH 22-23 August, 2026 Summer PEP End Term exam and Placement Preparation Exam Other Schools 22-23 August, 2026 Placement Preparation Exam Finalization of Students The final list of eligible students will be finalized and released by 18 August 2026, after completion of the required eligibility/detention process. For students appearing for the Summer PEP ETT, eligibility will be finalized after completion of the applicable detention process. Students are therefore advised to regularly check their UMS messages for the final eligibility status and further instructions. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates on the basis of their core skills which includes reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS AMCAT assessment will be conducted in University premises in offline mode. You are required to bring your laptop, Charger and rough sheets in order to appear in the assessment. Seating Plan of the assessment will be shared with you via UMS my messages two days prior to the commencement of assessment. Scores of these assessments will be shared with companies visiting for placement drives. Therefore participate in this assessment with full enthusiasm. Absence or non-serious participation in the assessment may lead to debarment from placement services and/or consequences related to the End Term Examination, as applicable. Duty leave will be provided to the participants according to their participation slot. Assessments login credentials will be shared with you on the day of assessment at your assessment venue. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. full_content: EDU Revolution is LPU's student-centric academic framework that recognizes and rewards learning beyond the classroom. Through Revenue Generation opportunities, Projects & Hackathons, National and International Internship Opportunities, and Certifications, students gain academic recognition, industry exposure, career-ready skills and academic equivalence. All students are encouraged to register under Edu-Revolution. Whether you already possess exceptional skills and achievements or are just beginning your journey, Edu-Revolution offers opportunities to discover and develop your potential. Course-based EDU Rev initiatives planned by faculty members will be available on the portal, enabling students to register and participate based on their interests and career aspirations. Why Register? By becoming a part of Edu-Revolution, you can benefit from: . Earn back your fee through revenue generation . Early placement readiness through structured skill development from the first semester . Portfolio building by showcasing your projects, achievements, certifications, research, innovations, and experiential learning Register through either of the following platforms: Through UMS UMS → LMS → Edu-Revolution: Be the Change Through LPU Touch App Login → Edu Revolution (Tile on Home Page) → Get Started Please note that after registration, all student nominations under Edu-Revolution will be reviewed by the respective Standing Committee. Based on the Committee's recommendations, the concerned Category In-charge will accord the final approval in accordance with the University's guidelines. An Edu-Revolution Manual has been shared for your reference. Students are advised to read the manual carefully to understand the registration process, eligibility criteria, benefits, and opportunities available under Edu-Revolution. Need Assistance? Visit the Edu-Revolution Assistance & Query Zone, Block 38, Room No. 205B, or raise your query through RMS using the following path: UMS Dashboard → Student Services → Relationship Management System (RMS) → Log Request → Academic & Administrative Issues → Academics → Edu Revolution (MOOCs / Value Added Courses / Lab) Your journey at LPU is not limited to earning a degree—it is about discovering your potential, building a strong professional portfolio, becoming placement-ready from the very first semester, and creating a lasting impact. Register today and continue your journey with Edu-Revolution towards a future full of opportunities. Attachment: 1 EdU Revolution Manual Final.pdf 2 How to apply.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Academic Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: In line with the University’s commitment to supporting students in their academic journey, Remedial classes are being organized for students who have received E/G grades in their courses. This initiative aims to help students clear pending grades (E/G) and meet promotion criteria before the commencement of the next regular term. There are two options for Remedial classes. Students may register for the option that best suits their learning needs. Option 1: Classes of 10 Hours . Coverage: Quick revision of important topics just before the examination . Fee: Rs. 300 per course Option 2: Classes for 40 hours . Coverage: Comprehensive teaching covering the complete course syllabus . Fee: Rs. 1,000 per course Key Details: - Commencement of Classes: 1st September 2026 (Tentatively) - Class Timing: After 05:00 PM - Mode of Classes: Offline/ Online (Based on registration). - Course Registration Limit: Maximum of 2 courses per student - Classes will be conducted only if sufficient registrations are received Important Instructions: - A minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory. - The registration fee is non-refundable, and no deregistration will be allowed. - Examinations will be conducted after completion of the classes. - Students enrolling in remedial classes must separately register for the corresponding E/G grade examinations, wherever applicable, through the designated exam registration portal. This initiative is designed to provide focused academic support and help students achieve their academic goals and clear their pending grades. All eligible students are strongly encouraged to take advantage of this opportunity Registration Details: Last Date of Registration is 20th August 2026. Students can register for the remedial classes through UMS using the following path: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System ----- Exam Registration ------ Registration for Remedial/Tuition Classes. Or to register Click here ( Link Applicable only for UMS ) In Case of any query, student may log RMS at UMS Navigation---- RMS--- Log Request--- Student Relationship (DSR) ---- Academic Support--- Additional Tutoring classes or contact us at 01824-520150 or may visit DSR (32-100) Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Student Relationship *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree) Eligibility:- Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than INR 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2026-27 in institutes of repute like NIRF/NAAC accredited for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27. Benefits:- A scholarship amount of INR 1.5 lakh* per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. The scholarship amount under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 should be utilised to cover academic expenses including tuition fees, hostel fees, internet, transportation, laptops, books and stationery. full_content: Dear Students, Why wait until graduation to start earning? Become financially independent while you study. Shape Your Future with RGM! Take the first step towards financial independence and transform your learning into real-world success. full_content: School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, in collaboration with the Human Resource Development Center (HRDC) is organizing a 6-Day Workshop on Experimental Animal Handling, Ethics, and Regulatory Frameworks for students, research scholars, faculty members, and professionals in pharmacy, biomedical sciences, and life sciences. full_content: Build Your Future in AI with IBM SkillsBuild! Dear Students, BharatCares, in association with AICTE and in collaboration with IBM SkillsBuild, invites eligible students to participate in the IBM SkillsBuild Machine Learning & Applied AI Internship 2026. This six-week, 100% virtual internship will provide practical exposure to Machine Learning and Applied Artificial Intelligence through IBM SkillsBuild self-learning modules, expert-led masterclasses, hands-on practice, industry mentoring, career-readiness sessions and an individual capstone project. 1. Programme Details Particular Details Programme IBM SkillsBuild Machine Learning & Applied AI Internship 2026 Duration 6 Weeks Commencement 24 August 2026 Mode 100% Virtual Programme Fee Completely Free of Cost Learning Approach Self-learning, live masterclasses, hands-on exercises and project-based learning Certification Internship Certificate upon successful participation and project submission 2. Curriculum Component Topics Covered IBM SkillsBuild Self-Learning Foundations of AI, Machine Learning Fundamentals, Python for AI, Data Science Essentials, AI Ethics and IBM AI Technologies Masterclass 1: Kickstart Your Machine Learning Journey Introduction to Machine Learning, VS Code setup, Python environment and IBM BOB introduction Masterclass 2: Build Your First AI Model Teachable Machine, IBM watsonx, Watson Studio, AI model training and deployment fundamentals Masterclass 3: Master Supervised Learning Regression, classification, decision trees, model evaluation and hands-on implementation Masterclass 4: Discover Hidden Patterns Unsupervised learning, clustering, deep learning fundamentals, neural networks and practical applications Masterclass 5: Train Intelligent AI Agents Reinforcement learning, Q-Learning, interactive simulations and AI-agent development Capstone Project End-to-end Machine Learning solution addressing a real-world challenge, project documentation and presentation Career Readiness and Mentoring Resume development, LinkedIn optimisation, AI portfolio building, industry mentoring and career guidance 3. Programme Highlights a) IBM SkillsBuild self-paced digital learning b) Five live expert-led masterclasses c) Hands-on labs using IBM AI tools d) Practical exposure to IBM watsonx and Watson Studio e) Industry-focused capstone project f) Resume, LinkedIn and interview-preparation support g) Guidance from industry mentors h) Internship certificate upon successful completion 4. Eligibility Recommended for undergraduate and postgraduate students from: a) Computer Science and Engineering b) Artificial Intelligence c) Machine Learning d) Data Science e) Information Technology f) Electronics g) Mathematics h) Other related technical disciplines Students aspiring to build careers in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Data Science are strongly encouraged to register. 5. Delivery Format Component Delivery Mode Self-Learning IBM SkillsBuild platform Live Sessions Instructor-led virtual masterclasses Practical Work Guided hands-on exercises Project Individual capstone project Mentoring Guidance from industry experts Completion Based on successful participation and project submission 6. Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/hmzrez3w 7. Important Instructions Students must enter their details accurately, as the name submitted in the registration form will be used on the Internship Offer Letter and Completion Certificate. An active email address and mobile number must be provided for further communication. Register at the earliest and take the first step towards building an industry-ready career in Machine Learning and Applied Artificial Intelligence! For any queries, you may contact Dr. Tanuj Mishra at tanuj.12948@lpu.co.in Attachment: 1 Curriculum IBM SkillsBuild Machine Learning and Applied AI Internship 2026.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Industry Interface *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: This is to inform all regular students that applications are invited for a Paid Internship Opportunity under LPU’s Education Revolution. This internship offers students a unique opportunity to work on high-impact projects, gain hands-on industry experience, and contribute to one of India's most transformative education initiatives. Outstanding performers may also be considered for full-time employment opportunities based upon the year of degree, performance and organizational requirements. In addition, selected interns will be provided with academic benefits and recognition support, which may include certification, academic enrichment value, and institutional acknowledgment. Open Positions: . Content Writer . Social Media Manager . Video Editor . Photographer and Videographer Students possessing relevant skills, creativity, dedication, and a willingness to learn are encouraged to submit their applications within the stipulated timeline. The application form can be accessed Google Form link shared along with this notice. Last Date to Apply: 15th August 2026 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the subsequent selection process. Required Skill Set Content Writer . Excellent written communication and storytelling skills . Strong command of English grammar . Ability to research and write engaging content for digital platforms . Creative thinking with attention to detail Social Media Manager . Understanding of Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and YouTube . Content planning and scheduling . Basic graphic design and social media analytics knowledge . Strong communication and trend awareness Video Editor . Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software . Motion graphics and basic color grading skills . Strong storytelling and editing sense . Ability to meet deadlines Videography & Photography . Hands-on experience with DSLR/Mirrorless cameras . Knowledge of framing, lighting, and composition . Basic photo and video post-production skills . Creativity and attention to visual storytelling Mandatory Technical Requirements (All Applicants) To ensure smooth participation in the internship, students must have access to the following: . full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Overcoming MTI (Mother Tongue Influence) for Effective Vocal Communication — A Workshop on Accent Neutralization and Clear Speech”. This workshop will help students to identify and correct pronunciation patterns influenced by their mother tongue that affect clarity, confidence, and professionalism in spoken English. Participants will be introduced to common MTI patterns found among Hindi, Punjabi, Haryanvi, and other regional-language speakers, and will practice correcting them through guided listening, articulation drills, and live speaking exercises. The workshop aims to simulate real interview and workplace speaking situations, enabling students to apply correct stress, intonation, and pronunciation while communicating with clarity and confidence. The main objectives of the event: · To help students identify their own Mother Tongue Influence (MTI) patterns affecting pronunciation and clarity. · To train participants in correct articulation, word stress, and intonation for professional spoken English. · To build confidence in neutral, clear vocal communication for interviews, presentations, and workplace interactions. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering, is going to conduct "Art of Reading: A Workshop on Reading with Effective Techniques", designed for students who wish to improve their reading efficiency, comprehension, and critical thinking skills. Participants will discover practical techniques to move beyond passive reading and engage with texts more effectively. Through interactive activities, reading challenges, discussions, and guided exercises, students will practise strategies such as skimming, scanning, active reading, annotation, and the SQ3R method to enhance understanding and retention. The main objectives of the event are: To enable students to develop purposeful reading habits by understanding and applying effective reading techniques for different types of texts. To help students practise strategies such as skimming, scanning, active reading, annotation, and the SQ3R method to improve comprehension, and critical thinking. To encourage students to become confident and independent readers who can analyze, interpret, and engage with academic and non-academic texts more effectively. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. Moreover, students can also join Foreign language courses. In order to join these Skill Development Courses, you have to make a Payment on the enrollment link provided below by 31st July,2026.Tentatively classes will start in the month of August and time table of course will reflect on your UMS before the start of classes. Last Date to Enroll SDC Courses: 31-07-2026 Enrolment link: https://skilldevelopment.lpu.in Uploaded By: Office of HOD Centre for Professional Enhancement *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Admission Referral – National Students (Under Student Revenue Generation Policy – EDU Revolution) Final Countdown Has Begun! Admissions for 2026 Closing on 31 July. Apply Now. As part of the University’s Education Revolution (EDU Revolution) and the Student Revenue Generation Policy, Lovely Professional University continues to empower students to become active contributors in the institution’s growth journey. Students can now refer eligible and high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the structured Revenue Generation framework. Students are advised to refer to the official announcement titled “Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution)” (Ref. No.: LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260330/0001) for detailed guidelines. Path to Apply: UMS → Student Services → Admission Referral Form. Guidelines (Mandatory) - The referral in all cases must be new and should not exist in any university system before submission. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - All referrals must be submitted through the official university portal only . - University holds final discretion on approval of referral and allocation of points. - Points will be reviewed and awards will be granted based on total accumulated points by November 2026. Referral Policy is not applicable in the following cases: - Admission for Online or Distance Mode programmes. - Referring student who is receiving a 100% scholarship. - An existing student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - Candidate who has already applied for admission before submission of the referral form. - If the referred student’s admission status is not active. All interested students are requested to follow the above-mentioned process and complete the form accordingly. Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) is attached for your reference. For any further clarification, you are kindly requested to visit Ms. Kavita Ghotra at Block 30-408, Cabin 5. full_content: The Nehru Sidhant Kender Trust (“the Trust”) is dedicated to empowering young minds, particularly girl students, by enhancing access to quality higher education. The Trust has launched the Satya Scholarship Program 2026, a merit-cum-means initiative designed to assist students from various socio-economic backgrounds in pursuing higher education after Class 12. The scholarship offers 100% coverage of annual course fees, plus accommodation and meal support, for students enrolled in 3–5-year undergraduate or integrated master's programs in Commerce, Engineering & Technology, and Medical & Health Sciences. It is available to students from Punjab admitted to 38 selected institutes in Ludhiana district, and to Ludhiana district students entering any of the top 50 NIRF-ranked institutions in India. Recipients will be known as Satya Scholars. The scholarship is renewable annually based on academic performance, attendance, conduct, and continued enrollment Link to apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/satya-scholarship-program The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30-07-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: . Open to first-year students in 3 to 5-year undergraduate or integrated master's courses in: a) Commerce: BBA, B. Com b) Engineering and Technology: B. Tech, (all streams), BCA, B. Arch c) Medical and Health Sciences: BPT . Must have passed Class 12 Board Exam from a recognised board in Punjab with at least 60% aggregate. . Students from the Ludhiana district who have secured admission to any of the above courses at one of the top 50 NIRF-ranked institutions across India are eligible for the scholarship. (List Attached) . Annual parental income must not exceed INR 8 lakh; guardian income limits apply for orphans. Note: . Preference for girl students, sportspersons, persons with disabilities (PwD), orphans, and children of single parents. . Satya Scholars must maintain 75% attendance, good conduct, and a minimum GPA of 6 (or 60% marks) for scholarship renewal. Benefits: . 100% of the annual course fee coverage as per the approved fee structure of the selected institute, for the full duration of the course (3 to 5 years). . Hostel and mess charges or PG/rented accommodation support will be provided to all eligible scholars studying outside their hometown, based on the institute's approved charges or actual expenses incurred, whichever is lower. . For institutes without hostel facilities, a fixed monthly stipend of ?5,000 will be provided towards accommodation and meals. Note: . Refundable charges, including caution money and security deposits, are not covered under the scholarship and shall be borne by the student. . If a Satya Scholar has already paid the course fee to the institute at the time of scholarship announcement, the amount paid will be reimbursed directly to the bank account of the scholar or the parent/guardian, as applicable. Documents: . Recent passport-sized photograph . Proof of identity (Masked Aadhaar, Driving License, Voter ID Card, PAN Card or any government-approved ID) . Current-year admission letter issued by the institute . Class XII marksheet . Institute fee structure . Parental income proof, such as a) Tehsildar/BDPO income certificate b) Affidavit (in case of orphan or single-parent applicants) c) Salary slips d) Income Tax Return (ITR) / Form 16 e) Valid BPL certificate (if applicable) . Bank account details of the student and the parent/guardian . Crisis-related documents, such as a parent’s death certificate or proof of critical illness (if applicable) . PwD certificate or sports achievement certificates, if applicable . Statement of Purpose (SOP) outlining the applicant’s aspirations and reasons for applying for the scholarship The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2026-27--------> Satya Scholarship Program 2026 All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No. 103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: Inspired by the vision and legacy of India’s first President, Buddy4Study has launched the Dr. Rajendra Prasad Scholarship Program 2026-27 in his honour to support deserving students. full_content: Biswabina Scholarship 2026 is an opportunity provided by the Biswabina Foundation* for high secondary passed students. It aims to support meritorious students by offering financial aid. Selected candidates will receive a yearly grant. *The Biswabina Foundation officially began its journey on April 7, 2014, when it was registered as a Public Charitable Trust at the office of the Additional Registrar of Assurance-III in Kolkata, West Bengal. Its creation was inspired by a noble idea nurtured over several years by its President, Dr. Rina Pal, along with a few founding trustee members. As a voluntary organisation, the Foundation is dedicated to improving the lives of disadvantaged individuals by providing financial support and assistance. Link to apply Scholarship: https://biswabinafoundation.in The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 31-07-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. The student must have secured a minimum of 80% in higher secondary or equivalent 2. The student must have an admission slip for a bachelor’s degree or a professional course Note:- Current year pass-out students will receive preference. Benefits: Selected candidates will receive a yearly grant. The scholarship amount will be disbursed in two instalments during the academic year after an interview and final selection. Candidates must submit self-attested photocopies of their mark-sheets or grade cards from yearly, semester, or term examinations for renewal. The scholarship will be discontinued without prior notice if the candidate is found ineligible at any point. Required Documents: 1. A passport-size photograph 2. Proof of DOB 3. Caste certificate (if applicable) 4. 10th or equivalent certificate/marksheet 5. 12th or equivalent certificate/marksheet 6. Family income proof 7. Bank details Important Note: 1. All Applications to be sent by post/courier. No application through Mail will be considered. Physical presence in the Interview is mandatory for all shortlisted candidates. 2. Application with required attachments referred in the application form uploaded on the Website of Biswabina Foundation is to reach the postal address on or before 31st July, 2026. 3. Applications will be short listed by the Trustees based on the criteria and an interview will be conducted. Date of Interview will be notified on the Website/ shortlisted candidates will be communicated. The foundation will award scholarships after verifying all the criteria. full_content: Professional University is pleased to share an exciting Fully funded five months fellowship opportunity for young professionals passionate about climate change, clean energy, sustainability, and environmental leadership. The Yale Emerging Climate Leaders Fellowship 2027 is a prestigious five-month global leadership programme that brings together outstanding professionals from the Global South to collaborate with leading experts from Yale University, the International Energy Agency (IEA), the OECD, and other renowned international organizations. Important Dates: Orientation Week at Yale University, USA (In Person) 1–5 February 2027 Interactive Online Learning Journeys (Remote) March – June 2027 Closing Week in Paris, France (In Person) 14–18 June 2027 Application fee: $20 USD to be paid by credit or debit card (at the time of application submission). Highlights of the program: Climate policy and global governance Clean energy transition Renewable energy and innovation Climate finance Nature-based climate solutions Climate communication Carbon capture technologies Leadership development and international networking Who Can Apply? Applicants should: Ph.D. Scholars with the minimum of 5–10 years’ experience into their professional careers with demonstrated achievements. Be citizens or representatives of countries in the Global South (Asia, Africa, the Middle East, or Latin America/Caribbean). Be fluent in English. Be committed to addressing climate and clean energy challenges. Be available to participate in all programme components, including the in-person sessions at Yale and Paris and the online learning journeys. Professionals from government, academia, research, industry, entrepreneurship, finance, media, law, civil society, and the energy sector are encouraged to apply. Benefits of The Program Fully funded international travel and accommodation for the Yale and Paris sessions (including round-trip airfare, hotels, local transfers, and most meals). Learning from world-renowned experts and Yale faculty. Global networking with climate leaders and policymakers. Collaborative policy project and publication opportunities. Membership in the Yale Climate Fellows Alumni Network. Application Requirements Applicants must submit: Resume/CV (maximum 3 pages) Personal Statement (maximum 600 words) Brief Video Statement One Letter of Recommendation Application Fee (required) at the time of submission. Application Deadline: 26th July 2026 Register at the given link : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1FNgthuHKrtfUfbHvmGpAQ5KpQL40gPqUCY0DYHVunvo/edit Please note: Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their applications at least 24 hours before the deadline, as no extensions will be granted. This fellowship offers an exceptional opportunity to develop global leadership skills, contribute to climate solutions, and become part of an international network of emerging climate leaders. We encourage all eligible candidates to take advantage of this outstanding opportunity and submit their applications before the deadline. full_content: This is in reference to the Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from August 2026 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for the summer term classes in May-June 2026 and have successfully completed their attendance criteria are required to appear for Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is as follows: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation: All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars who can register for summer term SAS evaluation with subject to eligibility criteria) are required to register for summer term SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 21st July 2026 to 31st July 2026. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis: All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the attached guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-->SAS-->Click to Submit report. All the research scholars are required to completely register for SAS evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the synopsis followed by the verification of synopsis by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 21st July 2026 to 31st July 2026. 3. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation --->Ph.D. Seminar File---> Verification SAS. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the SAS synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 5th August 2026. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 31st July 2026, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS. d) If a research scholar registers for the summer term SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from Dec 2026 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. e) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h) Research scholars are required to bring two hard copies of the Synopsis report, duly verified and signed by the respective Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (wherever applicable), at the time of evaluation. i) It is mandatory to submit one hard copy of the SAS report to CRDP (Block 38, Room No. 304), while the second copy must be retained by the scholar for reference by the panel members during the evaluation. j) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. k) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. m) The research scholar must bring their own laptop and projector cable (HDMI & VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1.The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: Student Services --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) --> Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Center for Research Degree Programmes). Attachment: 1 Eligible scholars.xls 2 Format for SAS presentation.pdf 3 SAS Guidelines Summer Term August 2026.pdf 4 Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

The main aim of the End Term Presentation is as follows: a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. full_content: The Division of International Affairs, LPU, is pleased to announce an exciting international internship opportunity with the World Health Organization (WHO), Geneva, Switzerland. The World Health Organization (WHO) is inviting applications for a 24-week Internship in Epidemic and Pandemic Management at its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. This internship provides an opportunity for students and recent graduates to gain international exposure and contribute to global health initiatives related to epidemic and pandemic preparedness, vaccines, diagnostics, therapeutics, research, and policy development. Eligibility: Applicants must meet one of the following criteria: Be a student who has completed at least three years of a full-time undergraduate degree and is currently enrolled in a degree program (undergraduate, postgraduate, or doctoral level) in a relevant field. Be a recent graduate who completed their degree within the last 18 months. Relevant Fields: Public Health, Medicine, Biology, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Virology, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Medical Sciences, Information Sciences, Statistics, or related disciplines. Note: For students pursuing a four-year undergraduate degree, this generally means they should be in their final year of study at the time of application. Key Areas of Exposure: Global health research and analysis Literature reviews and data collection Report and policy brief preparation International meetings and workshops Pandemic preparedness and response initiatives Financial Support: Living allowance of up to 1,680 CHF per month for interns whose permanent residence is outside Geneva (final amount determined by WHO after selection) 20 CHF daily lunch vouchers for each working day Medical and accident insurance coverage provided by WHO Location: Geneva, Switzerland Duration: 24 Weeks (05 October 2026 – 19 March 2027) Application Deadline: 25th July 2026 Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSenyAoIis_TYRYTAP31r08Rr6pKTFCcMk8Ekgk6P9lB2zIyaA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108598394312321334324 For Queries: Call 9888598782 or Visit: Block 32, Room 310 Division of International Affairs, LPU Students are advised to review the eligibility criteria carefully before applying, as this opportunity is primarily intended for students from health, medical, life sciences, and related disciplines. full_content: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 6.0 This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 6.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 6.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- Renewable Energy Energy Efficiency Automotive Technology Industry 4.0 and 5.0 Robotics and Automation Other Frontier Technologies Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes(Online Mode) Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 26-27 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon: The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. full_content: The Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India, is delighted to invite all Indian citizens to participate in the "Mascot Design Contest for India Post". This initiative aims to create a symbolic brand ambassador that embodies the core values of the Department—trust, reliability, inclusivity, and digital innovation. We seek a creative and memorable mascot to modernize our brand identity and build an emotional connection with citizens across all age groups. Contest Details & Schedule • Contest Duration: 15th July 2026 – 15th August 2026. • Submission Mode: Online exclusively through the MyGov platform. • Eligibility Criteria: Open to all Indian citizens of all age groups. • Participation Limit: Each participant is permitted to submit only one entry. Submission Requirements •Format & Quality: High-resolution designs in JPG, PNG, or PDF format (minimum 300 DPI, resolution of at least 1920x1080, maximum 10 MB). • Required Content: Each entry must include the mascot design, a name in any Indian language (with transliteration in English or Hindi), and a brief concept note (150–200 words). • Originality: Designs must be original and manually created; AI-generated or copied entries will be disqualified immediately. • Source Files: Selected participants must provide editable source files (AI/CDR/EPS/SVG) within one week if requested by the Department. Mascot Design and Name Guidelines • Ethos: The design and name must reflect the ethos of the Department of Posts—trust, reliability, inclusivity, digital empowerment, last-mile connectivity, and "Dak Sewa Jan Sewa". • Adaptability: The design must be unique, simple, and engaging for all ages, while allowing flexibility for adaptation into 3D, animated, or stylized formats. • Restrictions: Entries must not contain illegal, offensive, political, or inappropriate content, nor infringe on any third-party intellectual property or trademark rights. Evaluation Process and Criteria • Mascot Design (100%): Creativity, originality, and uniqueness (30%); alignment with Department values/objectives (25%); aesthetic appeal and universal relevance (25%); adaptability and scalability (20%). • Mascot Name (100%): Creativity, originality, and uniqueness (30%); alignment with Department values/objectives (25%); simplicity and ease of pronunciation (25%); ease of use across platforms/languages (20%). • Final Decision: The decision of the Department of Posts shall be final and binding; no requests for re-evaluation will be entertained. Prizes & Recognition • Mascot Design Prizes: 1st Prize: Rs 75,000; 2nd Prize: Rs 50,000; 3rd Prize: Rs 25,000 (all include a certificate). • Mascot Name Prizes: 1st Prize: Rs 25,000; 2nd Prize: Rs 15,000; 3rd Prize: Rs 10,000 (all include a certificate). Important Information • IP Rights: Selected entries will become the exclusive intellectual property of the Department of Posts. • Documentation: Winners must provide valid Government ID, PAN card, and bank account details within one week when requested. • Registration Link: https://innovateindia.mygov.in/mascot-design-contest-for-india-post/. Contact Information For detailed terms, conditions, and technical criteria, please visit the official contest page on the MyGov platform. full_content: Applications are now open for the GEV Memorial Merit Scholarship for Law Students 2026.The scholarship is offered by the GEV Scholarship Fund Trust in memory of Late Dr. Goolam E. Scholarship Benefits: Selected students may receive: i) Financial assistance ranging from Rs 50,000 to Rs 2,00,000 per year towards tuition fees and other academic expenses. ii) Mentorship from leading legal professionals. iii) Exposure to the Indian legal and judicial ecosystem. full_content: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 6.0 This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 6.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 6.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- Renewable Energy Energy Efficiency Automotive Technology Industry 4.0 and 5.0 Robotics and Automation Other Frontier Technologies Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes(Online Mode) Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 26-27 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon: The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 12/07/2025 Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Note: While Registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. full_content: Admission Referral – National Students (Under Student Revenue Generation Policy – EDU Revolution) Admissions for 2026 is closing soon. Hurry Up! As part of the University’s Education Revolution (EDU Revolution) and the Student Revenue Generation Policy, Lovely Professional University continues to empower students to become active contributors in the institution’s growth journey. Students can now refer eligible and high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the structured Revenue Generation framework. Students are advised to refer to the official announcement titled “Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution)” (Ref. No.: LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260330/0001) for detailed guidelines. Path to Apply: UMS → Student Services → Admission Referral Form. Guidelines (Mandatory) - The referral in all cases must be new and should not exist in any university system before submission. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - All referrals must be submitted through the official university portal only. - University holds final discretion on approval of referral and allocation of points. - Points will be reviewed and awards will be granted based on total accumulated points by November 2026. Referral Policy is not applicable in the following cases: - Admission for Online or Distance Mode programmes. - Referring student who is receiving a 100% scholarship. - An existing student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - Candidate who has already applied for admission before submission of the referral form. - If the referred student’s admission status is not active. All interested students are requested to follow the above-mentioned process and complete the form accordingly. Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) is attached for your reference. For any further clarification, you are kindly requested to visit Ms. Kavita Ghotra at Block 30-408, Cabin 5. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct a webinar titled "Vocabulary Voyage: A Webinar on How to Improve Vocabulary" to help students expand their vocabulary and strengthen their English language proficiency. This webinar will focus on practical techniques for learning, retaining, and effectively using new words in everyday communication. Participants will explore engaging vocabulary-building activities, contextual learning methods, and memory-enhancing strategies that make language learning both enjoyable and effective. Whether preparing for competitive examinations, placement interviews, presentations, or daily interactions, a rich vocabulary enables individuals to express their ideas with greater clarity and precision. This interactive webinar will equip learners with simple yet effective approaches to develop a lifelong habit of vocabulary enhancement. The main objectives of the event are: · To help students improve their English vocabulary through practical learning techniques. · To develop effective word retention and usage strategies. · To enhance communication skills and boost confidence in academic and professional settings. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. Date: 4th July, 2026 Time: 05:00 PM Onwards Venue: Online Resource Person: Ms. Rajni Arora Register at Link: https://tinyurl.com/VocabularyVoyageWebinar Attachment: 1 Brochure.jpeg Uploaded By: Office of HOD Centre for Professional Enhancement *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Dear Students, The integration of MOOCs (NPTEL/SWAYAM/Industry certifications) into the university curriculum, directly supports the transformative vision of the National Education Policy (NEP) and Education revolution initiatives. This enhances academic flexibility, promotes skill-based learning, and strengthens student’s readiness for future careers through recognized national level certifications. In order to provide world-class learning opportunities and the development of skills and also to be at par with industry trends, the University offers students an option to enroll in Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) that are available through a number of private, public, and other international online educational institutes. To ensure that this opportunity is well seized by the students of LPU, a mandatory MOOCs course [CSE393-Online Academic Course] has been included in the 6th term of program schemes 2024 and 7th term of program schemes 2025 intake batch students and equivalent stubs of lateral entry programs (passing out in 2028 and 2029 respectively). The programs are listed below where the mandatory course is applicable. Program Code & Program Name Applicable to intake batch Complete the course on or before the term P132::B.Tech. (Computer Science and Engineering) 2024 6th Term P132-Y B Tech (CSE) [ 2+2 with international credit transfer option] 2024 6th Term P133::B.Tech. (Information Technology) 2024 6th Term P132::B.Tech. (Computer Science and Engineering) 2025 7th Term P132-Y B Tech (CSE) [ 2+2 with international credit transfer option] 2025 7th Term P133::B.Tech. You are required to enroll in one of these courses and complete the course by or before the end of corresponding term (whichever applicable 6th or 7th Term) of B. Tech program and equivalent term of lateral entry program. All the registered students in the specified course code must complete mandatory registration on both platforms, NPTEL MOOC Certification portal (before the enrolment and exam registration end date), and UMS portal (UMS Navigation: Application for Edu Revolution → NPTEL MOOCs or Academics → Examination Systems → Application for MOOC Certification). Non-accomplishment of the course in first attempt will result in “I grade” followed by “F grade” if failed in second attempt. For any further queries contact: Mr. Manjinder Singh or Dr. Navjot Kaur in 34-207. full_content: The Progress Akanksha Scholarship for Women in STEM 2026 supports women in India pursuing first-year undergraduate studies in computer science-related fields with renewable financial assistance of up to INR 1,50,000 per year based on need. It is open to Indian women students enrolled in eligible computing and STEM courses, with a family income limit of INR 5,00,000 and a minimum of 75% in Class XII. Link to apply Scholarship: www.buddy4study.com/page/gev-memorial-merit-scholarship-for-law-students The Last date to apply the scholarship is 15-07-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: Students who wish to apply for this scholarship must fulfil the following eligibility criteria: 1. Applicants must be an Indian citizen 2. Student must be already enrolled in any year of an LLB/LLM degree course at a recognized law institute in India, or have applied for CLAT, LSAT-India, AILET, or any other law entrance exam 3. Must have scored a minimum of 60% in Class X and XII board exams 4. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 10,00,000 from all sources 5. Be willing to sign-up for the scholarship fund’s annual mentorship programs to assist and nurture the next batches of GEV Merit Scholars Benefits: Selected students will receive scholarships ranging from INR 50,000 to INR 2,00,000 per year. Documents: 1. Copies of the marksheets (each qualifying examination from Secondary School Certificate examination to latest qualification) 2. Copy of the letter of admission to the Law College, Institution or University at which the applicant is enrolled or intends to undertake studies (optional) 3. Income proof (Salary Statement, IT Returns) of applicant’s parents 4. Copy of latest CLAT/LSAT-India/AILET/other law entrance exam results 5. Passport size photograph 6. Masked Aadhaar card The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2026-27--------> GEV Memorial Merit Scholarship 2026-2027 for Law Students All the eligible students must submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship 2026–28 is a need-based financial assistance program for students pursuing the first year of a full-time MBA course. It is an initiative by the IDFC FIRST Bank designed to support students from families with an annual family income of less than INR 6,00,000, helping them continue their postgraduate management education without financial barriers. Selected students will receive a total scholarship of INR 2,00,000, disbursed as INR 1,00,000 per year over the two-year MBA program. Link to apply Scholarship: firstimpactscholarships.idfcfirst.bank.in The Last date to apply for the scholarship is 08-07-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship: 1. Open to Indian nationals residing in India only. 2. Students must be enrolled in the first year of a 2-year full-time MBA program or its equivalent for the class of 2026-2028. 3. The gross annual family income from all sources should be less than or equal to INR 6 lakh per annum. 4. Applicants must have a valid mobile number linked to their Aadhaar number. 5. The earning member should not be an IDFC FIRST Bank employee. Benefits: The selected MBA students will be awarded a scholarship sum of INR 2,00,000 for two years of full-time MBA studies (INR 1 lakh per annum, subject to terms and conditions*). Documents: 1. Admission Related Documents: a) Admission proof (including the name of the institution, admission year, and batch) b) Copy of fee receipt 2. full_content: Dear Students, To promote interdisciplinary learning, innovation, and collaboration across various schools and domains, the Interdisciplinary Project Topics Module has been made available on UMS for all eligible students. The module provides students with access to a wide range of approved project topics contributed by different Schools of the University. Students can explore project opportunities beyond their parent discipline and identify topics aligned with their interests, career goals, and emerging industry trends. Students can view the available project topics by following the UMS Path: Academics → Project/Dissertation → Interdisciplinary Project Topics 1. Steps to Access the Interdisciplinary Project Topics or can follow Annexure-I: i) Select the respective School from the dropdown menu. ii) Choose the Domain of interest. iii) View the approved project topics along with their brief descriptions, project area, nature of the project, supervisor details, and seating place. Students are encouraged to explore the available interdisciplinary project topics to gain exposure to emerging technologies and research areas, foster collaboration across multiple disciplines, and align their project work with current industry requirements and innovation trends. The module also provides opportunities to identify projects with potential for publications, patents, prototypes, and start up initiatives, thereby supporting informed project selection based on individual interests, academic goals, and future career aspirations For any assistance or clarification regarding interdisciplinary project topics, students may contact the concerned School Project Coordinator or visit the Department of Project and Internship Evaluation in block 30-310. Attachment: 1 Interdisciplinary_Project_Topics_User_Guide.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The Division of International Affairs (DIA), Lovely Professional University, is pleased to inform students about the AYFN Autumn Japan Culture Camp 2026, a fully funded international cultural immersion program hosted by the ASEAN Youth Friendship Network (AYFN). This one-week program offers participants a unique opportunity to experience Japan's rich cultural heritage while exploring the vibrant cities of Osaka, Kyoto, and Nara. The camp is designed to provide international participants with an understanding of Japanese culture, traditions, and basic Japanese language through interactive learning, cultural activities, and educational tours. Program Details Host Country: Japan Host Organization: ASEAN Youth Friendship Network (AYFN) Program Type: Cultural Exchange Camp Camp Dates: 15–20 November 2026 Duration: One Week Location: Osaka, Kyoto & Nara, Japan Funding: Fully Funded Deadline to Register: 5th July 2026 Financial Benefits: Selected participants will receive: Flight expense support (up to USD 750) Program fee coverage Accommodation Meals Visa fee support (up to USD 50) Cultural activities and guided tours Local transportation (Metro & Bus) Certificate of Participation Eligibility Criteria Applicants must: Have 8 CGPA in his/her academics. Be 17–40 years of age. Have an interest in travel, cultural exchange, and global engagement. Demonstrate leadership potential. Have experience in youth or social activities (preferred). Be available to travel to Japan during the program dates. Be willing to document their learning experience throughout the program. Note: As part of the application process, applicants are required to complete a pre-application and purchase an AYFN e-book before submitting their final application. Register Here: https://forms.gle/FhBXHyVZKHohUMVe8 For any queries or assistance regarding the program, please contact the Division of International Affairs: Phone: 9888598782 or Visit: Division of International Affairs, Block 32, Room 310, Lovely Professional University. Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Admission Referral – National Students (Under Student Revenue Generation Policy – EDU Revolution) Don't miss out the chance to grab Current Scholarship benefit i.e, 30th June 2026 As part of the University’s Education Revolution (EDU Revolution) and the Student Revenue Generation Policy, Lovely Professional University continues to empower students to become active contributors in the institution’s growth journey. Students can now refer eligible and high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the structured Revenue Generation framework. Students are advised to refer to the official announcement titled “Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution)” (Ref. No.: LPU/19.2/AN25/2025/001/IC/260330/0001) for detailed guidelines. Path to Apply: UMS → Student Services → Admission Referral Form. Guidelines (Mandatory) - The referral in all cases must be new and should not exist in any university system before submission. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - All referrals must be submitted through the official university portal only. - University holds final discretion on approval of referral and allocation of points. - Points will be reviewed and awards will be granted based on total accumulated points by November 2026. Referral Policy is not applicable in the following cases: - Admission for Online or Distance Mode programmes. - Referring student who is receiving a 100% scholarship. - An existing student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). - Candidate who has already applied for admission before submission of the referral form. - If the referred student’s admission status is not active. All interested students are requested to follow the above-mentioned process and complete the form accordingly. Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) is attached for your reference. For any further clarification, you are kindly requested to visit Ms. Kavita Ghotra at Block 30-408, Cabin 5. full_content: Celebrating the Spirit of Yoga Yoga is India's timeless gift to the world, promoting physical well-being, mental clarity, and emotional balance. Continuing its commitment to health, wellness, and mindful living, Lovely Professional University is proud to celebrate International Yoga Day 2026 on a grand scale. This year marks the 12th consecutive year of LPU's active participation in this global movement, inspiring thousands of students and faculty members to embrace a healthier lifestyle. The event will be held at the LPU Campus on Sunday, 21st June 2026. Distinguished Chief Guest The celebrations will be graced by Sh. Nitin Nabin, National President, Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), who will be the Chief Guest for the event. Sh. Nitin Nabin is a distinguished public leader known for his contributions to youth engagement, nation-building initiatives, and public service. Rewarding the Spirit of Wellness (Duty Leave) As a special encouragement for participation in this prestigious event, students who attend and actively participate in the complete Yoga Day celebrations shall be awarded Two (02) Days Duty Leave in the upcoming term as a recognition of their contribution towards promoting health, wellness, and the spirit of Yoga. Dress Code & Complimentary T-Shirts All participating students will be provided with a complimentary International Yoga Day T-shirt by the University. Students are required to wear the provided T-shirt along with black lower/track pants while attending the event. Registration Details Students willing to participate may register using the link below: https://tinyurl.com/Regforyogaday Registration closes on 19th June 2026 at 6:00 PM. The registered students shall be allocated a block number and seat number, which will be communicated through "My Messages" on UMS. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Image Insight: A Workshop on Decoding Visual Messages.” The event is designed to strengthen students' observational and analytical abilities through the medium of picture perception. This initiative aims to sharpen learners’ interpretive thinking and promote deeper understanding by encouraging them to explore various perspectives hidden within visual frames. Through engaging with images, students will be encouraged to look beyond the surface, analyze contexts, draw inferences, and express ideas thoughtfully. This workshop provides a platform to foster critical thinking—an essential skill for both academic and real-world problem-solving. The event will be activity-based, with students participating in guided visual tasks, discussions, and reflections designed to stimulate intellectual curiosity and analytical reasoning. The main objectives of the event are: · To enhance observation and interpretation skills. · To strengthen students’ ability to articulate thoughts clearly and logically. · To promote creative thinking through picture-based prompts. · To develop the habit of exploring multiple perspectives. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. You are requested to submit your proposed Form B (attached herewith) by 25th June 2025 in 5-101. Please note that submissions received after this date will not be entertained. Personnel Responsibility: Ensure that only the names of the concerned persons responsible for work in the animal house (research scholar/co-guide, if any) are listed in Form B, as they will be the only ones permitted to work with the animals. 9. Please adhere strictly to these guidelines to ensure a smooth and timely approval process.
