full_content: Dear Students, This is to inform you that the Hostel Leave Check-In / Check-Out System is being updated and will be implemented at the Main Gate w.e.f. 31st March 2026 (Tuesday). The system now utilizes Face Recognition technology integrated with numbered turnstile gates (G1, G2, G3 etc.) for a completely Automatic Check-Out & Check-In process. Key Instructions: Gate Assignment: After your leave is approved in UMS, you will be assigned specific turnstile gates for check-out and check-in. These gate numbers (e.g., G3, G5) will be clearly mentioned on your Hostel Leave Slip. Movement Protocol: You are required to use only your assigned gates for exit and entry. The gates will remain active only for your approved leave duration. Face Scan Entry: To pass through the turnstile, simply approach your assigned gate and look into the Face Scanner. Note: Ensure your face is clearly visible (remove helmets or deep-tinted sunglasses) for a quick scan. System Sync Time: After leave approval, gate access may take 2–4 minutes to reflect in the system. Students are advised to plan accordingly to ensure smooth and hassle-free movement. Understanding Gate Activation Status Please refer to the Activation Status table on your digital Hostel Leave Slip to confirm if the turnstile gate is ready for your movement: Status Meaning Action Activated Your face scan is synced and the gate is authorized. Proceed to your assigned gate for scanning. Processing The system is currently uploading your data to the gate. Wait 2-5 minutes for the status to turn green. Deactivated Your leave time has expired or the movement is complete. Students can apply for new leave or extend existing leave via UMS. Error There is a technical mismatch or system issue. Contact the Security/Helpdesk. Example Scenario: If your leave is approved from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and your slip shows: Check-out Gate: G3, G4 Check-in Gate: G5, G6 Then: 1. You can exit through Gate G3 or G4 and enter only through Gate G5 or G6 via Face Scan. 2. The Face Recognition will only work between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM. 3. Entry/Exit attempts before or after this time will be automatically denied. Sample Hostel Leave Slip (Updated Version) is attached. Attachment: 1 Sample Leave Slip.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Residential Services *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy - a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you - as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator - to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel - your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives: - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General participation conditions & guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. -PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral). - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity. - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPA. No disciplinary case. b. No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives. c. It is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community. full_content: Updated Student Admission Referral Incentives of Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy - a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you - as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator - to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel - your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives: - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General participation conditions & guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. -PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral). - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity. - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPA. No disciplinary case. b. No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives. c. It is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community. full_content: Dear Students, LPU Literary Society is pleased to announce that LPU has been invited to participate in the 1st NLUJ-CCLRP National Essay Writing Competition 2026 by The National Law University Jodhpur to commemorate World Consumer Rights Day. The competition is focused on “Safe Products, Confident Consumers”, aims to encourage students to explore issues such as product safety, digital consumer rights, platform accountability and emerging risks in modern marketplaces. Competition Highlights : Open to students pursuing 3-year or 5-year law degrees. Individual and co-authored submissions permitted. (Maximum 2 students can jointly co-author). Cash prizes for top entries, along with Certificate of MeritE-Certificates of participation for all contributors .The following cash prizes shall be awarded to the best three entries: a. First Position: Rs. 4000 & Certificate of Merit b. Second Position: Rs. 3000 & Certificate of Merit c. Third Position: Rs 2000 & Certificate of Merit Theme: “Safe Products, Confident Consumers” Sub themes - Consumer Awareness and Education, Consumer Rights in the Digital Age, Speedy Redressal of Consumer Disputes, Dark Patterns in E-Commerce and Digital Platforms, AI Driven Consumer Harm, Data Privacy as a consumer right, Centre for Consumer Law Research & Practice Influencer Advertising and Consumer Risks, Consumer Protection in Healthcare and Pharmaceuticals, Misleading Advertising and Consumer Knowledge, Rise of greenwashing and its regulation in India, Effectiveness of Consumer Protection Act, 2019, The list of themes is only indicative. Participants may make submissions on any theme within the purview of the broad theme of consumer protection. full_content: To provide a common platform for students to have their concerns addressed in a timely manner, the Division of Student Relationship (DSR) is organizing Student Sessions in the hostels. full_content: In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy - a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you - as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator - to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel - your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives: - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General participation conditions & guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. - PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution. - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026. - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral). - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity. - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPA. No disciplinary case. b. No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives. c. It is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community. full_content: We are pleased to inform you about an exciting webinar series organized by MathWorks on “Developing AI-Powered Battery Management Systems for Electric 2-3 Wheelers.” This series will demonstrate how MATLAB® and Simulink® are used to design, simulate, and validate advanced Battery Management Systems (BMS) for next-generation electric vehicles. The sessions will cover topics such as battery modeling, AI-based SOC/SOH estimation, predictive diagnostics, and model-driven development for EV software, helping engineers build safe, efficient, and production-ready battery systems. Webinar Schedule (a) 17 March 2026 Topic: Battery Pack Development and BMS Design for Electric 2-Wheelers & 3-Wheelers Learn about lithium-ion battery modeling, battery pack design, thermal performance evaluation, and BMS algorithms for SOC/SOH estimation. (b) 18 March 2026 Topic: Intelligent BMS – Leveraging AI for Accuracy, Safety, and Sustainability Explore how Artificial Intelligence can improve battery performance through predictive maintenance, fault detection, and accurate battery analytics. (c) 8 April 2026 Topic: Delivering Production-Ready Software for EV 2-3 Wheelers with Confidence Understand model-driven development, automated testing, and embedded code generation for reliable EV software deployment. Key Highlights 1. Battery modeling and simulation using MATLAB & Simulink 2. AI-driven SOC/SOH estimation and predictive diagnostics 3. Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing workflows 4. Model-based design and automated verification 5. Generation of production-ready embedded software Students interested in Electric Vehicles, Battery Technology, AI in EV systems, and Embedded Software Development are encouraged to attend. External Registration Link:https://tinyurl.com/3jn5ekr8 Internal Registration Link: https://forms.gle/wKNV3ZoQMxdqZfug7 Kindly take advantage of this opportunity to gain insights into AI-driven EV battery technologies and industry workflows. full_content: The vivo Kanya Gyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 is vivo India’s CSR initiative designed to empower young women from underserved and economically disadvantaged backgrounds across India to pursue education and careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) by providing financial assistance, mentorship and industry connect. The program is open to young women currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses (first or second year). This initiative enables students to continue their studies without financial barriers while building a strong foundation by receiving curated mentoring sessions which help them for corporate readiness for future STEM careers. Selected scholars will receive an annual scholarship renewable for up to three years. Eligibility Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) at NIRF-ranked colleges; preference will be given to government colleges. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or vivo India are ineligible. Note: Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible. Preference will be given to the following applicants: Single-parent children Children from the Aspirational District Have deceased parents Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalised communities. Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families Girls Representing State and National Level Sports Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by a selection panel. Benefits Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 60,000 per year for up to three years. Note: The scholarship will cover essential education-related expenses, including institution fees, hostel and accommodation, food, transport, equipment, and laptop costs, for which the scholar will submit relevant documents for verification as proof. Application Deadline: Deadline:15- March- 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: Apply Now : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/vivo-kanya-gyaan-scholarship-program Google Forms: https://forms.gle/RKRoZxFeQyXsmNn17 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. full_content: Lovely Professional University invites final year Undergraduate students (8th semester) who will be completing their 4-year/8-semester Bachelor’s Degree by June 2026 with minimum 75% aggregate marks (or equivalent grade as prescribed by UGC) to apply for admission to the Ph.D. Programme. This initiative provides a unique opportunity for talented and research-oriented students to begin their doctoral journey immediately after completing their undergraduate degree, without the need to wait for a postgraduate qualification. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, and research contingency grant. Who are eligible ? Completion of 4-year/8-semester Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant discipline Minimum 75% aggregate marks or equivalent grade as prescribed by UGC at the time of admission to Ph.D. programme Relaxation of 5% marks (or equivalent grade) may be allowed for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/Differently-Abled/EWS and other categories, as per the guidelines of the statutory body from time to time. Why Consider a Ph.D. after Your UG Degree? Pursuing a Ph.D. directly after a 4-year undergraduate programme offers several advantages: . Start your research career early and gain expertise in your chosen field. . Opportunity to work closely with experienced faculty and researchers. . Access to advanced research facilities, laboratories, and datasets. . Enhance your academic profile for careers in research, academia, industry, and policy-making. . Potential opportunities for research fellowships, publications, and international collaborations. . Become part of a community of scholars driving innovation and knowledge creation. Important Points 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year UG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student needs to appear for LPUNEST on 4th April 2026 (Saturday) followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Important Dates: LPUNEST Ph.D. Registration 26th February 2026 (Thursday)– 01st April 2026 (Wednesday) Conduct of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 04th April 2026 (Saturday) Result of LPUNEST (Ph.D.) 08th April 2026 (Wednesday) Research Proposal Discussion 10 th April 2026 (Friday) - 13 th April 2026 (Monday) Final Result 17 th April 2026 (Friday) Last date of Ph.D. Admission 31st May 2026 (Sunday) Programme Fee and Scholarship The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 60% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee Applicable per semester 60% Rs 30,000/- Rs 20,000/- 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- How to Apply? Final year undergraduate students can register for LPUNEST through their UMS by following the path below: UMS Navigation: Academics → Research and Development → PhD Discipline Preference The detailed step-by-step process to apply for LPUNEST is provided in the attachment with this announcement. IMPORTANT NOTE: Admission to the following Ph.D. programmes is not permitted directly after a 4-year UG programme: Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology, Pharmacy Practice, Agronomy, Fruit Science, Vegetable Science, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Law, Clinical Embryology For more information For detailed information regarding benefits, eligibility, and research opportunities, students may visit: Centre for Research Degree Programme (CRDP) Block 38, Room 406 or raise a request through RMS using the following path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request--->Message Type-- > Category Type -- > Department (Ph.D. [Centre for Research Degree Programmes]) -- > Category -- > Sub Category -- > Contact No. -- > Description Attachment: 1 Detailed steps to apply for Ph.D..doc Uploaded By: Office of HOD Office of Academic Services *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) is pleased to announce the successful signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University and the Directorate of Census Operations Punjab for the establishment of a Census Data Workstation at the Central Library (Level–3). This collaboration marks an important step towards strengthening research infrastructure within the University. The Census Data Workstation will provide authorized access to detailed census datasets. Since first synchronous census of the entire country which was conducted in year 1881 and related resources, enabling researchers to undertake advanced academic studies based on authentic national data. The availability of this facility will significantly benefit Ph.D. scholars and faculty members by providing them with reliable demographic, socio-economic, and regional datasets. These datasets will support high-quality research in areas such as population studies, urban and rural development, migration patterns, education, health, employment, and public policy analysis. Access to such structured and verified data will enhance the quality, accuracy, and impact of research publications and doctoral work conducted at the University. Researchers interested in using the Census Data Workstation must obtain prior approval from the Steering Committee. For initiating the approval process, Ph.D. scholars and faculty members are required to approach the Centre for Research Degree Programmes (CRDP) in block 38-406 or raise RMS. The CRDP will facilitate the necessary permissions and guide researchers regarding the appropriate procedures for accessing and utilizing the census data resources. This MoU reflects the University’s commitment to promoting data-driven research, evidence-based policy analysis, and interdisciplinary academic collaboration. The Census Data Workstation is expected to become a valuable resource for researchers, enabling them to generate meaningful insights and contribute to impactful scholarly work. Faculty members and research scholars are encouraged to make effective use of this facility to strengthen their research outcomes and contribute to the broader academic community. full_content: Admission Referral – National Student Now Live (Under Student Revenue Generation Policy – EDU Revolution) As part of the University’s Education Revolution (EDU Revolution) and the Student Revenue Generation Policy, Lovely Professional University continues to empower students to become active contributors in the institution’s growth journey. This initiative enables students to transform their network, influence, and outreach efforts into measurable institutional impact while earning recognition and incentives. In this direction, the category 'Admission Referral – National Student' is now officially LIVE on the University portal. Students can now refer eligible and high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the structured Revenue Generation framework. (Refer to the official announcement Title Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) No. LPU/19.4/AN25/2025/001/IC/260226/0001 dated 26th Feb 2026 for details.) How to Refer: UMS → Student Services → Student Referral Form Students can now refer high-achieving national candidates for admission and earn points under the Revenue Generation framework. Guidelines (Mandatory) • The referral in all cases must be new and should not exist in any university system before submission. • Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid. • No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). • All referrals must be submitted through the official university portal only. • University holds final discretion on approval of referral and allocation of points. • Points will be reviewed and awards will be granted based on total accumulated points by November 2026. Referral Policy Not Applicable in Following Cases: • Admission for Online or Distance Mode programmes. • Referring student who is receiving a 100% scholarship • An existing student (joining again with/without completing previous degree). • Candidate who has already applied for admission before submission of the referral form. • If the referred student’s admission status is not active. Attachment: 1 Announcement Student Revenue Generation.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Digital Strategy, Innovation and Growth *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy — a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you — as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator — to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities.Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel — your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives- - Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. - Link student efforts to university advancement. - Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. - Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General Participation Conditions & Guidelines: - SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. - PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. - All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal. - - Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program. - The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before. - Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid.· - Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution.· - Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· - Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026.· - No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral).· - Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity.· - University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points.· - Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: a. Minimum 6.0 CGPAo No disciplinary case. b. No fee defaultThis initiative extends beyond incentives. c. it is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. d. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community. Attachment: 1 Announcement Student Revenue Generation.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Digital Strategy, Innovation and Growth *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Online Allotment Process for Residential Facilities i.e. Residence, Mess, Laundry, and Gym for existing students with Academic Status “A”,“N”,“I”,“SA”,“YA”,“S” (Admission Batch 2026 or earlier) is going to start from 05th March 2026 for session 2026-27. Students can book the residential facility with Early Decision Benefit (upto Rs. 10,000/-) till 31st Mar. 2026. Allotment of residential facilities will be done in 3 Phases as mentioned below: Hostel Booking Timelines and Process Phases Start Date End Date Eligibility EDB Token Amount Phase-1 Round -I At 05:30 PM on 05th March 2026 At 11:59 PM on 31st March 2026 Students Having CGPA 08 or Above (For both Boys & Girls) Rs. 10,000/- Rs. 10,000/- (To be paid between 1-7 April 2026) Round –II At 05:30 PM on 06th March 2026 For all Girls Rs. 10,000/- Round –III At 11:00 AM on 07th March 2026 For all Boys Rs. 10,000/- Phase-2 At 02:00 PM on 01st April 2026 At 11:59 PM on 30th April 2026 All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) Rs. 5,000/- Rs. 10,000/- (At the time of Booking) Phase-3 01st May 2026 NA All Students (For Both Boys & Girls) NA Rs. 10,000/- (At the time of Booking) Residential Charges Payment Timelines and Process Payment Type Timeline Action From To Hostel Seat EDB Token Amount 01st April 2026 07th April 2026 Confirmed Rs. 10,000/- (Secured) 08th April 2026 15th April 2026 Confirmed Rs. 5,000/- (Reduced To 50%) 16th April 2026 30th April 2026 Confirmed Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) After 30th April 2026 Cancelled Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) 50% Residential Charges Till 15th June 2026 Confirmed Secured (As Applicable) 16th June 2026 30th June 2026 Confirmed Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) After 30th June 2026 Cancelled Rs. 0/- (Cancelled) 100% Residential Charges On or Before Hostel Reporting Confirmed Secured (As Applicable) Booking can be done through “Hostel Booking” option available on UMS Dashboard or by visiting: UMS Navigation -> Residential Services -> Residential Facilities Booking -> Hostel Booking There are 3 options available on this interface that a student can choose: INDIVIDUAL BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat for their own. GROUP BOOKING: This option is applicable for those students who want to book the hostel seat along with their friends. Student can choose his/her roommates by selecting group booking option (Validation of group members has to be done using the OTP sent to individual group member’s “My message” on UMS). WAITLIST: This option is applicable for the situation if student is unable to book the desired hostel/seater. Waitlist request can be submitted under following scenarios: Waitlist (Hostel Already Booked):- In case student have already booked the hostel seat but still want to change the booked seat and the desired hostel/ seater is not available, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. Waitlist (Hostel Not Booked):- In case student has not booked the hostel due to non-availability of preferred hostel/ seater, then student can submit the request for desired hostel/ seater. Student will be notified about the availability of requested hostel/ room type as soon as it is available for booking. EDB benefits will not be applicable on waitlist request; rather these benefits will be applicable according the date of actual booking the residential services. Allotment for Residential Scholarship Holder:- Allotment will be separately managed by OMC-DRS (Block 29-301) (based on the details provided by the concerned departments i.e Sports or Cultural) for students awarded hostel charges waiver under any scholarship scheme (like Sports, Cultural, Board topper etc.), such students need not to participate in the Allotment Process of Residential Facilities. Changes in the booked residential facilities: - Option to change booked hostel seat will be provided to students after 01st April 2026. Students can change their booked hostel seat without any shifting charges once in a complete academic session. Second time onwards each request for the change of hostel/ room will be processed with a shifting charge of Rs. 1000/-. Students may upgrade their booked seat by paying the difference of amount between both room types and without shifting charges any time during the complete academic session, whereas down-gradation of hostel seat will be permitted before reporting in hostel only and with shifting charges (As applicable). Important Point:- Students who are not opting for the residential facility will be required to submit their PG/Rented/Private Accommodation details as per guidelines of UGC, Police and other local authorities. Residential Facilities will be provided till the end of the regular academic session including regular exams or 10 months from the start of the session, whichever is earlier. Students can come and join 02 days prior to the start of academic session and will be required to vacate residential room/apartment within 02 days after completion of stay period. Students may check the complete process of booking through demo video as mentioned in following link: Click Here To Watch Hostel Booking Process Students must go through the attachments for rest other details i.e. Residential Charges, Refund Guidelines. For any query students may visit Residential Query Window: Block 32 Basement, Window No. 03, or lodge RMS on UMS through following path: UMS Navigation >> Relationship Management System (RMS) >> Log Request >> Academic & Administrative Issues >> Select Message Type “Grievance” >> Search by category “Residential Services (Hostel Allotment/ Transfer) : Hostel Allotment” category. Attachments: 1. Charges For Residential Facilities.pdf 2. Residential Facilities Refund Guidelines.pdf Uploaded By: Pardeep Kumar Division of Residential Services

full_content: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to announce an exceptional global leadership opportunity for students to participate in the I.I.M.U.N. U.S.A. Leadership Program 2026. This 21-day international leadership and experiential learning program will be held from 6th to 26th September 2026 and will provide students with unparalleled exposure to global leadership, diplomacy, innovation, and industry practices across eight major U.S. cities — Boston, New York, Washington D.C., Dallas, Houston, Seattle, Portland, and San Francisco. The program is designed to immerse students in academic learning, institutional visits, and industry interactions with global leaders and renowned organizations. Key Highlights: Selected students will have the opportunity to: Attend leadership lectures delivered by tenured professors from leading universities such as Harvard, MIT, Stanford, and Tufts. Participate in 40+ experiential learning engagements aimed at developing leadership skills and global awareness. full_content: Students are invited to participate in GOER 2026, a national level enterprise risk management competition conducted by Institute of Risk Management (IRM) India. GOER - Game of Enterprise Risk 2026, is a business simulation where teams manage a hypothetical company and make strategic decisions to handle financial, operational, and external risks. It is designed to test analytical thinking, leadership, negotiation, and crisis management skills. Eligibility: UG Category First and Second Year students (For 4 year programmes, up to Third Year). Final Year students are not eligible. PG Category First Year students only. Each team will consist of 10 students plus 2 backup members. Shortlisted teams will attend a virtual masterclass and take part in further evaluation rounds. Finalist teams will compete in person in Hyderabad on 20 June 2026. There is no participation fee. Important Dates: Initial Institutional Registration: 15 March 2026 Team Submission Deadline: 20 March 2026 Finale Round: 20 June 2026 at Mahindra University, Hyderabad Interested students are requested to coordinate with their respective faculty members immediately, as the institutional registration deadline is 15 March 2026. full_content: Student Revenue Generation Policy (Under EDU Revolution) In line with the transformative vision of the EDU Revolution (EduRev), Lovely Professional University is proud to launch the Student Revenue Generation Policy — a dynamic platform that empowers students to convert their ideas, referrals, skills, and efforts into real, trackable contributions to the university’s ecosystem. Unlike traditional reward or incentive schemes, this initiative is based on the principle of student-driven value creation. It allows you — as a learner, innovator, connector, and creator — to participate in diverse activities that generate revenue, visibility, and institutional impact. And in return, the university recognizes your effort through points, recognition certificates, and opportunities. Whether you refer a brilliant new student, help the university partner with an NGO, close a school outreach, or monetize your skills through freelancing or a YouTube channel — your initiative counts. And now, it is formally recognized and rewarded. Objectives- 1. Recognize revenue-generating student contributions. 2. Link student efforts to university advancement. 3. Encourage student-led branding, admissions, outreach, and innovation. 4. Promote a culture of responsible earning while learning. General Participation Conditions & Guidelines· 1. SEPARATE GUIDELINES AND PROCESS WILL BE ANNOUNCED FOR EACH CATEGORY ON UMS. 2. PATHWAY TO APPLY WILL ALSO BE SHARED IN SEPARATE ANNOUNCEMENT. 3. All contributions must be verifiable through the official university portal.· 4. Fraudulent or unverifiable claims will lead to disqualification from the program.· 5. The referral in all cases should be new and should not exist in any of the university systems before.· 6. Only the first verified and portal-submitted referral will be considered valid.· 7. Complete and submit your contribution as per the guidelines specified for each contribution.· 8. Upon reaching contribution milestones, receive your rewards and official certification!· 9. Points will be reviewed and awards will be given based on points accumulated by Nov. 2026.· 10. No referral benefit will be given for referring any existing LPU student (Joining again with/without completing previous degree except self-referral).· 11. Verification includes documents, screenshots, MoUs, offer letters, fund receipts, or proof of activity.· 12. University holds final discretion on approval of activities and points.· 13. Eligibility conditions to participate in the programme: - Minimum 6.0 CGPA - No disciplinary case. - No fee default. This initiative extends beyond incentives; it is an opportunity to become an active stakeholder in the University’s growth and success. Whether you are supporting admission outreach, strengthening the University’s digital presence, or facilitating industry collaborations, your contributions play a significant role in shaping the institution’s future trajectory. Let us progress collectively — as responsible students, emerging leaders, and as a forward-looking University community. For further information regarding the policy, please refer to the attached document for clarification. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “The Perspective Duel– A Competition on Critical Thinking.” This competition is designed to enhance students’ collaborative thinking and professional communication skills by challenging teams to analyse a given statement from multiple perspectives and present a well-reasoned collective viewpoint. full_content: Description The MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program is an initiative by Myntra Cares, the CSR and Sustainability arm of Myntra, designed to empower students from garment worker and artisanal families by offering financial assistance for their higher education. This scholarship provides annual support for three consecutive years, covering educational expenses for students pursuing graduation courses at recognised State and Central universities. By easing financial barriers, the program enables students to complete their higher education with confidence. The scholarship also extends upskilling programs certified by the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, focusing specifically on upskilling artisans. Eligibility Applicants must have completed Class 12 (any stream) with a minimum of 60% marks. Must be enrolled in any year of a full-time graduation course (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA, BCA, and any technical courses -Tech & Engineering, etc.) in a recognised State/Central university. Annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 5,00,000. The applicant's parent must be employed as a full-time garment worker. Note: Preference will be given to the children of single mothers employed in the garment industry and students from the Scheduled Caste, the Scheduled Tribe and the Other Backward Classes. Benefits Selected students will receive a scholarship of INR 20,000 per year for 3 years. Note: Renewable for up to 3 years for students enrolled in full-time graduation courses, subject to continuation of the program to subsequent years, academic performance, and fulfilment of renewal criteria. Application Deadline Deadline:28-Feb- 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details: Apply Now : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/mynvidhya-myntra-cares-scholarship-program#scholarships Google Forms: https://forms.gle/fk6tXKuJKAab7ZZTA NOTE It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. full_content: The vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 is vivo India’s CSR initiative designed to empower young women from underserved and economically disadvantaged backgrounds across India to pursue education and careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) by providing financial assistance, mentorship and industry connect. The program is open to young women currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses (first or second year). This initiative enables students to continue their studies without financial barriers while building a strong foundation by receiving curated mentoring sessions which help them for corporate readiness for future STEM careers. Selected scholars will receive an annual scholarship renewable for up to three years Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/vivo-kanya-gyaan-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 03-Mar-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in full-time, regular undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) at NIRF-ranked colleges. 2. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. 3. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester. 4. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or vivo India are ineligible. 5. Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible. 6. Preference will be given to the following applicants: •Single-parent children •Children from the Aspirational District •Have deceased parents •Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes •Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalized communities. •Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families •Girls Representing State and National Level Sports Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by a selection panel. Benefits: Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 60,000 per year for up to three years. Note: The scholarship will cover essential education-related expenses, including institution fees, hostel and accommodation, food, transport, equipment, and laptop costs, for which the scholar will submit relevant documents for verification as proof. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-sized photograph 2. Valid Government Identity Proof (PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving License, etc.) 3. Current academic year admission proof (college ID Card or admission letter) 4. Previous semester/class marksheet 5. Parental Income Certificate (issued by the competent authority) 6. Bank Account Details (Copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in student’s name or joint account with parent/s) 7. Complete Fee Structure 8. Disability certificate (if applicable) 9. Caste Certificate (if applicable) 10. Certificate stating that the applicant has represented their State or National level in sports (if applicable) 11. Undertaking by the applicant confirming that they are a First-Generation Learner or belong to a Marginalised Community (if applicable) 12. Certificate of any position of leadership (if applicable) 13. Declaration by the applicant confirming the authenticity of submitted documents and stating that they are not receiving full financial support from any other scholarship or government scheme. 14. Visible Passion & Aspirations expressed through a short essay / personal statement in 200 words — “Why I want to pursue this field” and “How this scholarship support will help me make an impact.” How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. . Log in to Buddy4Study using your registered ID to access the ‘Application Form page’. . If you’re not registered, sign up on Buddy4Study using your Email, Mobile, or Google account. . You will be redirected to the “vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26” application form page. . Click the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload the relevant documents. . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click ‘Preview’. . If all the details are correct in the preview, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete your application. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26-------->- Vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: Administrative-------> Fee and Scholarship System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming education by reshaping teaching methods, assessment systems, and student engagement practices. full_content: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell) is pleased to announce an enriching opportunity for LPU students to participate in the International Summer Internship Program 2026 in Germany, in collaboration with IES Group (Indo Euro Synchronization), reputed German institutions, and industry partners. This structured Summer Internship is designed to provide hands-on experiential learning in advanced German technologies, artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship, and innovation, while offering students global exposure to industries, institutions, and European culture. Program Structure: 15 Days On-Ground Internship & Immersion in Germany 13 Days Online Technical Training (Pre-departure Modules) Program Tracks AUTOSOL Summer Internship – Advanced Automobiles, Automation & Mobility CYBERSOL Summer Internship – Advanced Artificial Intelligence & Applications European Tech Leaders (ETL) Summer Internship – Entrepreneurship, Technology Management & Leadership Eligibility: Open to all Engineering, Computer Science, and Business (2nd, 3rd and 4th Year). Minimum 6 CGPA preferred No backlog/reappear or disciplinary cases Valid Passport required Inclusions: Certificate-based International Internship Programme Multi-city international experience: Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Aachen (included in package) and Paris (optional with an additional €240 charge) Accommodation with food coverage: Breakfast and working lunch on training days Assistance with economical dinner options and meals on non-training days Visits to Mercedes Benz, Audi, or Porsche manufacturing plants/museums in Stuttgart (Credit Equivalent: 4 Academic Credits) Industry & institutional visits across Germany Cultural immersion and networking opportunities Local transportation within Germany End-to-end program coordination and support Exclusions: Round-trip Flights VISA Charges Travel/Health Insurance Personal & Medical Expenses Programme Fee: AUTOSOL Summer Internship • Early Bird: ?1,50,000 + ?15,000 Application Fee • Regular: ?1,75,000 + ?15,000 Application Fee CYBERSOL Summer Internship • Early Bird: ?1,50,000 + ?15,000 Application Fee • Regular: ?1,75,000 + ?15,000 Application Fee European Tech Leaders (ETL) Summer Internship • Early Bird: ?1,50,000 + ?15,000 Application Fee • Regular: ?1,75,000 + ?15,000 Application Fee Duration: • 1st June – 28th June 2026 (15 Days On-Ground in Germany + 13 Days Online) Important Dates: • Early Bird Deadline: 25th February 2026 • Final Application Deadline: 15th March 2026 To Apply register at: https://forms.gle/4oprHQubACJg88fHA For further information, please contact the Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310): Call on: 7986997720 / 9875928583 Email: study.abroad@lpu.co.in Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Description The vivo Kanya Gyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26 is vivo India’s CSR initiative designed to empower young women from underserved and economically disadvantaged backgrounds across India to pursue education and careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) by providing financial assistance, mentorship and industry connect. The program is open to young women currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses (first or second year). This initiative enables students to continue their studies without financial barriers while building a strong foundation by receiving curated mentoring sessions which help them for corporate readiness for future STEM careers. Selected scholars will receive an annual scholarship renewable for up to three years. Eligibility Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) at NIRF-ranked colleges; preference will be given to government colleges. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or Vivo India are ineligible. Note Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible. Preference will be given to the following applicants: Single-parent children Children from the Aspirational District Have deceased parents Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalised communities. Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families Girls Representing State and National Level Sports Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by a selection panel. Benefits Selected students will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 60,000 per year for up to three years. Note: The scholarship will cover essential education-related expenses, including institution fees, hostel and accommodation, food, transport, equipment, and laptop costs, for which the scholar will submit relevant documents for verification as proof. Application Deadline Deadline: 03 March 2026 till 11:59 pm Registration Details Apply Now: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/vivo-kanya-gyaan-scholarship-program Google Forms: https://forms.gle/EchgoWRcGc9HH4r59 It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both links for participation in the scholarship. The submission received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Amrit Kaur at amrit.kaur@lpu.co.in Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Industry Interface *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 is a flagship initiative by the BGM Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Bombay Gowrakshak Mandali (BGM). This scholarship is designed to support students enrolled in full-time undergraduate or postgraduate (general/professional) courses as well as diploma programs in Agriculture. This initiative empowers meritorious students to overcome financial barriers and pursue their education with confidence, thereby contributing to India’s thriving animal and dairy sciences sector. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/bgm-pashu-seva-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 28-02-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Must be an Indian citizen enrolled in a recognised institution in India. 2. Must be pursuing a full-time undergraduate course (General / Professional) any year in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, Dairy Science, Livestock (Horned Cattle) Management, Para Veterinary, Fodder Management or allied fields. 3. Must have secured a minimum of 50% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the last qualifying examination. (Note: 5% relaxation to students belonging to the preference list.) 4. Annual parental income should not exceed INR 8 lakh (from all sources) 5. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or BGM Foundation are not eligible to apply. Note: Preference will be given to: 1. Girl students, PwD, Single-parent Child, Orphans 2. First-generation college graduates 3. Students from aspirational or rural districts 4. Students who have studied in government schools 5. Students who come from village/rural backgrounds Benefits: Students will receive a fixed scholarship per year: 1. For General Graduation: INR 36,000 2. For Professional Graduation: INR 75,000 Note: The scholarship fund covers tuition fees, accommodation, food, transport, examination fees, and other academic expenses. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-size photograph 2. Proof of admission for the current academic year (admission letter or college ID card) 3. Previous semester/class marksheet 4. Fee receipt or fee structure from the institution 5. Family income certificate (issued by the competent authority) 6. Bank account details (copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in applicant’s name) 7. Declaration by the applicant confirming the authenticity of the submitted documents How can you apply? . Click on the 'Apply Now' button. . Login to Buddy4Study using a registered ID to land on the 'Online Application Form Page. . If not registered, register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile/Google account. . You will now be redirected to the ‘BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 application form page. . Click on the 'Start Application' button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload the required documents. . Accept the 'Terms and Conditions' and click on 'Preview.' . Review the preview screen to ensure that all the filled-in details are correct. . If all the details appear correctly on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26-------->- BGM Foundation Pashu-Seva Scholarship Program 2025–26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: Administrative-------> Fee and Scholarship System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. Centre for Professional Enhancement presents Skill Development Courses beyond classroom hours for all of you to gain skills that come handy at job interviews especially, thereby augmenting your employ-ability. These courses would not just elevate skills but also would provide us with a certificate (basis evaluation) to add to our respective resumes. These courses are designed in a way in which they cater current industry needs and to make students achieve their career goals. With a wide range of options available you can select courses as per your requirement. full_content: Under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement, club “Legal Eagles” of School of Liberal and Creative Arts is going to conduct “Imaginarium – A Competitive event on Visual Perception and Expression” - a competitive academic event centred on picture-based interpretation and expression. The event is thoughtfully designed to strengthen students’ verbal communication, presentation skills, and articulation abilities, while simultaneously enhancing time management, analytical reasoning, and critical thinking. Participants will be presented with a visual stimulus (picture) and will be required to observe it closely, interpret its elements, and convey their understanding within a stipulated time frame. The main objectives of the event are: · To enhance participants’ verbal communication and public speaking proficiency through structured visual interpretation. · To develop effective presentation skills by enabling students to articulate ideas with clarity, confidence, and creative insight. · To strengthen time management abilities by training participants to organize and deliver their responses within a prescribed time limit. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: The Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Program 2025–26, an initiative by Tata Capital Limited, is designed to support the higher education of meritorious students from economically weaker sections of society. Under this program, students pursuing General or Professional Graduation, Polytechnic/Diploma courses at recognised institutions in India may receive a scholarship covering up to 80% of their tuition or course fees, subject to a maximum limit ranging from INR 10,000 to INR 1,00,000, depending on their academic level. The scholarship aims to reduce financial barriers and enable students to focus on their studies and achieve their aspirations. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/the-tata-capital-pankh-scholarship-programme The Last date for the scholarship is 15-02-2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to Indian nationals only. 2. Students currently enrolled in undergraduate degree programs (e.g., B.Com, B.Sc, B.A, etc.) or Diploma courses at a recognized institution in India. 3. Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in the preceding class, semester, or academic year. 4. The annual family income from all sources must be less than or equal to INR 2.5 lakh. 5. Must be pursuing education from a recognized college, university, or technical institute in India. 6. Children of employees of Tata Capital and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: Selection will be based on a combination of academic excellence and financial background. Benefits: 1. Students scoring 60% – 80%: Up to 80% of tuition/course fees or INR 12,000 (whichever is less) 2. Students scoring 81% – 90%: Up to 80% of tuition/course fees or INR 15,000 (whichever is less) 3. Students scoring 91% and above: Up to 80% of tuition/course fees or INR 18,000 (whichever is less) Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card) 2. Passport-size photograph of the applicant 3. Income proof (Form 16A/income certificate issued by government authority/salary slips, etc.) 4. Proof of admission (college/institution ID card/bonafide certificate, etc.) 5. Current academic year fee receipt 6. Bank account details of the scholarship applicant (cancelled cheque/passbook copy) 7. Marksheets or grade cards of the preceding class 8. Disability and Caste certificate (if applicable) How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button . Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and land on the ‘Application Form Page’. . If not registered, register at Buddy4Study with your email/mobile number/Gmail account. . You will now be redirected to the ‘Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Program 2025-26’ application form page. . Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload relevant documents. . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. . If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program is an initiative by Myntra Cares, the CSR and Sustainability arm of Myntra, designed to empower students from garment worker and artisanal families by offering financial assistance for their higher education. This scholarship provides annual support for three consecutive years, covering educational expenses for students pursuing graduation courses at recognized State and Central universities. By easing financial barriers, the program enables students to complete their higher education with confidence. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/mynvidhya-myntra-cares-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 15 Feb 2026 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Applicants must have completed Class 12 (any stream) with a minimum of 60% marks. 2. Must be enrolled in any year of a full-time graduation course (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA, BCA, and any technical courses -Tech & Engineering, etc.) in a recognized State/Central university. 3. Annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 5,00,000. 4. The applicant's parent must be employed as a full-time garment worker. Benefits: Selected students will receive a scholarship of INR 20,000 per year for 3 years. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. A recent passport-sized photograph of the applicant. 2. College admission or continuing proof (Admission Letter/Institution ID Card, etc.) 3. Class 12th & 10th marksheet 4. Address Proof (Driving License, Electricity bill, etc.) 5. Identity Proof (PAN Card, Driving License, etc.) 6. Family income proof (Form 16A, government-issued income certificate, salary slip, etc.) 7. Applicant’s bank account details 8. Occupational Proof of Parent (Indicating their current employment status) 9. Appointment Letter or Company ID card of the parent for Garment Workers, and a Certificate issued by the relevant authority certifying them as traditional artisans for artisanal families. 10.Caste certificate, where applicable How can you apply? . Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. . Log in to Buddy4Study using your registered ID to access the ‘Application Form page’. . If you’re not registered, sign up on Buddy4Study using your Email, Mobile, or Google account. . You will be redirected to the “MynVidya: Myntra Cares Scholarship Program” application form page. . Click the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. . Fill in the required details in the online application form. . Upload the relevant documents. . Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click ‘Preview’. If all the details are correct in the preview, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete your application. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- Myntra Cares Scholarship Program All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled the AMCAT SVAR and WriteX Assessments from 7th February to 8th February, 2026 for all placement registered students of 2027 graduating batch. These assessments are important for you in terms of placement perspective. Good performance in these assessments will play a vital role in creating career opportunities for you. Therefore, it is essential to approach these assessments with complete enthusiasm. About SVAR: IVR Based, Spoken English Test to assess Student's Fluency, Pronunciation, Active Listening, Spoken English Understanding, Grammar, Vocabulary & more. A crucial test essential for Interviews or Client based Interaction Profiles. Based on CEFR Levels. About WriteX: The only Written English Test driven on Machine Learning to help you in assessing the overall quality of a candidate's written sample. major factors that attribute towards the construction of a great write-up like grammar, usage, mechanics, style, organization and development etc. IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Both assessments are mandatory for every student, as per the attached list. 2. Both SVAR and WriteX Assessments will remain open from 7th February (9AM) to 8th February (11PM). You can attempt any Assessment at any time within the given time span but make sure once you start an assessment then complete it in one go without taking a break. 3. Assessments will be conducted online in Auto Proctored mode. You can appear it in from your own location. 4. The total combined duration of both assessments is approximately 60 minutes. 5. Reattempt / Reschedule is not allowed. Therefore, kindly follow the Assessment instructions carefully before starting your assessment. 6. This national platform recognizes and supports college students who have already take action for the environment as well as those who have innovative ideas and solutions to address climate change. Participants stand a chance to gain national recognition, media coverage, institutional honor, and cash prizes, while contributing meaningfully to India’s growing green economy. WHO CAN REGISTER? All college students (UG / PG / Research) from any discipline are eligible if they: • Have worked on environmental or climate-related initiatives (community projects, sustainability drives, climate communication, green startups, research, campaigns, etc.)OR • Have a strong, innovative idea or solution related to climate action that can be scaled or replicated. The only mandatory eligibility criterion is that the participant must be a college student. AWARD CATEGORIES • Community-led Climate Action • Emerging Business in Climate Action • Women Leaders in Climate Action • Institutional Leadership in Climate Action • Young Climate Champions Programme • Communicators for Climate Action SESSION DETAILS Date: 23rd January 2026 Time: 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM Venue: Room 32-513 Organized by: Student Organization by: EARTHDAY.ORG This session will guide students on eligibility, categories, and how to build a strongnomination, with direct insights from EARTHDAY.ORG. All interested students are encouraged to attend and explore this opportunity to turnclimate action into national impact. Link for Registration- https://forms.gle/6pvuioYZoTryY7oH9 Attendees will get Participation certification from EARTHDAY.ORG. full_content: The University remains committed to supporting your academic progress and helping you overcome academic challenges. In continuation of this commitment, the University is pleased to announce a special initiative of Tuition Classes for selected courses (list attached), scheduled to be conducted during January–April 2026 in online as well as offline mode. This initiative is specifically designed for: 1. Students who feel they have performed below expectations in one or more courses of the First Term (Autumn Term) of Session 2025–26 and wish to strengthen their understanding and improve their academic performance. 2. Students having pending E/G grades, providing them an opportunity to clear these grades and enhance their academic readiness, including preparation for placements. The exams of these course code will be conducted just after the completion of these classes. Key Details of the Tuition Classes Initiative . Tentative Start Date of Classes: The classes will start only after the declaration of the end term examination result. . Course Duration: 40 hours per course (Maximum 2 hours per day) . Mode of Classes : Online or Offline (depending upon students interest) . Class Timings: 09:00 AM-5:00 PM and after 5:00 PM (Students will be granted duty leaves for classes overlapping with their regular schedule (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). . Course Registration Limit: Maximum two courses per student . Classes for a course will be conducted only if sufficient student registrations are received for that course code. . Registration Fee: Rs. 1000 per course(The fee will be charged to the student’s account upon registration.) . Fee Policy: Once registered, the fee is non-refundable, and deregistration will not be permitted. . Exam Registration: Students enrolling in tuition classes must separately register for the corresponding E/G grade examinations, wherever applicable, through the designated exam registration portal. Additional Support: . Examinations for G-grade courses of registered students will be conducted after the completion of the tuition classes (tentatively during March–April 2026) This initiative aims to provide focused academic support and help students strengthen their concepts, improve performance, and achieve their academic goals. Eligible students are strongly encouraged to take full advantage of this opportunity. Register using the link https://tinyurl.com/tutionclasses latest by 02nd February, 2026 and take a confident step toward your academic success. For Queries / Assistance Students may log an RMS ticket through:UMS Navigation → RMS → Log Request → Student Relationship (DSR) → Academic Support → Additional Tutoring Classes Alternatively, students may contact us at 01824-520150. full_content: Dear Aspirants, Professional Enhancement means expanding your ability to do a particular task or moving up the hierarchical ladder by upgrading your skills. No matter which field it is, skill enhancement is a prerequisite to a successful career. Every industry from fashion to education evolves with time and through the process our initial skills get obsolete which reflects in low or completely no growth. A person with the right blend of functional and technical skills, and interpersonal attributes is always preferred at a professional setting when compared to the one lacking in any of these. Therefore, any opportunities to hone your skills should not be missed. full_content: The University remains committed to supporting your academic progress and helping you overcome academic challenges. This initiative is specifically designed for: 1. Students who feel they have performed below expectations in one or more courses of the First Term (Autumn Term) of Session 2025–26 and wish to strengthen their understanding and improve their academic performance. 2. Students having pending E/G grades, providing them an opportunity to clear these grades and enhance their academic readiness, including preparation for placements. The exams of these course code will be conducted just after the completion of these classes. Key Details of the Tuition Classes Initiative . Tentative Start Date of Classes: The classes will start only after the declaration of the end term examination result. . Course Duration: 40 hours per course (Maximum 2 hours per day) . Mode of Classes : Online or Offline (depending upon students interest) . Class Timings: 09:00 AM-5:00 PM and after 5:00 PM (Students will be granted duty leaves for classes overlapping with their regular schedule (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). . Course Registration Limit: Maximum two courses per student . Classes for a course will be conducted only if sufficient student registrations are received for that course code. . Registration Fee: ?1000 per course (The fee will be charged to the student’s account upon registration.) . Fee Policy:Once registered, the fee is non-refundable, and deregistration will not be permitted. . Exam Registration: Students enrolling in tuition classes must separately register for the corresponding E/G grade examinations, wherever applicable, through the designated exam registration portal. Examinations for G-grade courses of registered students will be conducted after the completion of the tuition classes (tentatively during March–April 2026) This initiative aims to provide focused academic support and help students strengthen their concepts, improve performance, and achieve their academic goals.
