full_content: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26, one of India's largest scholarship programs, is an initiative of the SBI Foundation. This program aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families across India, ensuring the continuity of their education. This scholarship is open to students, who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses from the top 300 NIRF universities/colleges. Selected students can receive a scholarship of up to INR 75,000 for UG and up to INR 2.5 lakh for PG to support their educational endeavors. Eligibility for Undergraduates Applicants: Applicants should be Indian nationals. Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate course (any year) from a premier university/college in India, as listed in the Top 300 Institutes according to the latest NIRF rankings. Students must have secured 7 CGPA / 75% marks or above in their previous academic year. The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 6,00,000. Eligibility for Postgraduates Applicants: Applicants should be Indian nationals. Applicants must be pursuing a postgraduate course (any year) from a premier university/college in India, as listed in the Top 300 Institutes according to the latest NIRF rankings. Applicants must have secured 7 CGPA/75% marks or above in their previous academic year. The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 6,00,000. Last date of Registration: 15-Nov-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Undergraduates Applicants: Scholarship up to INR 75,000 (T&C Applied) Rewards for Postgraduates Applicants: Scholarship up to INR 2,50,000 (T&C Applied) Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-asha-scholarship-program Link 2 : https://forms.gle/4jhF1ZwoGMSHizjL6 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in. full_content: Be Ready, Be Safe – A Workshop That Could Save Your Life! Imagine waking up to the sudden shake of an earthquake or hearing a siren signaling a flood nearby. In those crucial moments, knowing what to do can mean the difference between safety and disaster. That’s why the Department of Geography, Lovely Professional University is organising a One day Workshop on Disaster Management and Preparedness on 15th October, 2025 from 10:00 AM onwards. Join us to learn life-saving skills from expert talks by Sh. Pankaj Kumar Sharma, Assistant Commandant, NDRF. You’ll witness earthquake rescue operations, participate in mock drills, and master CPR techniques. This workshop is your chance to be ready when disaster strikes, not just for yourself, but for your family and community. The workshop will begin with on Disaster Management and Preparedness. This will be followed by a lecture-cum-demonstration on Disaster Preparedness Activities by Inspector Jaswant Singh and entire team of NDRF. The following activity will be conducted during the workshop · Earthquake Rescue Operations: Training in search and rescue techniques to locate and save victims trapped under debris during earthquakes. · Mock Drills: Simulated disaster scenarios that help participants practice evacuation, emergency response, and coordination in a controlled environment · CPR and First Aid Demonstrations: Teaching lifesaving techniques such as cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and basic first aid to treat injuries until professional medical help arrive · Fire Safety and Evacuation Procedures: Training on how to safely evacuate buildings during fire emergencies and use firefighting equipment. · Flood Rescue Techniques: Methods to safely rescue people from flooded areas using boats and other equipment. · Awareness Sessions: Informing communities about disaster risks, early warning systems, and preparedness plans to reduce vulnerability. All students are encouraged to participate and gain valuable knowledge and skills. Contact Person for further query Mr. Amandeep Singh Asst. full_content: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from October 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after every 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of ETP registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy for that term. c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. Registration for ETP evaluation All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars eligible for ETP) are required to register for ETP evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-ETP Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 15th October 2025 to 6th November 2025 (snapshots for using the interface for registration is attached along with the announcement). 2. Uploading of ETP reports All registered research scholars are required to upload their files (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics ---> Research and Development--> Registration of Upcoming Activity-ETP--Click to Submit report. Kindly watch the guided video on How to register for ETP by clicking on the following link- https://youtu.be/_IkzLlh69gE?si=jqU9-y8SIQahk81i Note: The link for uploading of ETP report will remain active from 15th October 2025 to 6th November 2025 3. Recommendation of ETP Report by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their ETP report for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path UMS navigation --->Division of Examination---> Department of Ph.D. Evaluation --->Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --->ETP Note: The last date for the recommendation of the ETP report by Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor is 10th November 2025. If the supervisor does not verify the report of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the ETP evaluation. Important Note: a) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for end term report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for ETP) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. b) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. c) The ETP report must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for ETP beyond the last date. d) Research scholars are also required to bring a hard copy of the report duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation, failing which the scholar will not be allowed to appear for the evaluation. e) Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of ETP report will not be considered. f) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. g) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the ETP registration interface) before registration and uploading the ETP reports at the interface. h) As per the current guidelines, the research scholars who are eligible for ETP evaluation as per the attached list but do not complete the registration process/appear for the evaluation after registration will be marked absent for the ETP evaluation, and the result of the evaluation will stand as "Unsatisfactory". i) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines and as per the guidelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of ETP report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Department (Ph.D. - Research Degree Evaluation Cell) -->Sub Category: ETP. 2. full_content: Dear All, Today, as we observe World Mental Health Day, We want to take a moment to remind you that your well-being matters deeply. Between classes, projects, and the constant buzz of notifications, it’s easy to lose sight of yourself. But in the middle of all this motion, remember: it’s okay to pause. It’s okay to breathe. It’s okay to care for your mind as much as your ambitions. Even small acts of mindfulness can help taking a walk across campus, sharing a laugh with a friend, or simply sitting in silence for a few moments. These are not pauses in progress; they are essential parts of it. Let this day be a gentle reminder that caring for your mental health is not a sign of weakness, but of awareness and strength. When you nurture your mind, you create space for clarity, compassion, and courage to grow. As part of our ongoing efforts to promote well-being, our partners at YourDOST are hosting a special session “Learn the Art of Balancing Your Brain” to explore simple, practical ways to support your mental health and stay centered. Be a part of this enriching experience, you are warmly invited to join by clicking the link below: https://yourdost-com.qmailroute.net/x/d?c=48219155&l=ea91ac2a-38cb-4e5b-82b9-7414351e1af2&r=f06f193c-ac3d-474f-85a1-222a5c220cb0 Date: Oct 16, 2025 Timing: 04:00 PM Because caring for your mind isn’t an option — it’s essential. full_content: The U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26, an initiative by U-Go, is designed to provide financial assistance to young women pursuing professional undergraduate courses. This scholarship aims to support academically bright students enrolled in professional graduation courses in teaching, nursing, pharmacy, engineering, architecture, law, etc. This financial assistance will be provided throughout the duration of their undergraduate course, enabling them to complete their education, reduce dropout rates, and build a pathway to empowered and self-reliant futures. Recipients of this scholarship will receive up to INR 60,000 ($750) per year for a duration of up to four years. U-Go, a non-profit organization based in California, USA, offers this scholarship to help ambitious and promising young women in India pursue higher education. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/ugo-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 31 Oct 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Young women pursuing professional graduation courses in teaching, pharmacy, medicine, engineering, architecture, law, etc., are eligible. 2. Applicants must be studying in any year (except the last year) of their graduation program. 3. Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in the Class 10 and 12 examinations. 4. The annual family income of the applicants from all sources must be less than INR 5 lakh. 5. Students from across India can apply. Benefits: The selected scholars will receive the scholarship as specified below: 1. For Teaching Courses - INR 40,000 ($500) per year for two years 2. For Pharma Courses - INR 40,000 ($500) per year for four years 3. For Three-year courses such as BCA, BSc, etc. - Up to INR 40,000 ($500) per year for 3 years 4. For Engineering, Law, Architecture Courses, etc. - INR 60,000 ($750) per year for four years. Note: Scholarship to cover 100% of educational expenses, including academic expenses (tuition fee, admission fee, exam fee, books, etc.), living expenses (hostel fee, mess fee, uniform, etc.), devices (laptop, mobile, equipment, etc.), monthly allowance, etc. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: The applicants are required to attach the following documents during the U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26 application process. 1. Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets and passing certificates 2. A government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar card/ Voter ID card/Driver’s license/PAN card) 3. Current year admission proof (fee receipt/admission letter/institution identity card/Bonafide certificate) 4. Family income proof (ITR, Form-16/income certificate issued by a competent government authority/salary slips) 5. Payment receipts for funds spent on academic pursuits Bank account details of the applicant 6. A recent photograph of the applicant How can you apply? Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and navigate to the ‘Application Form’ page. If you're not yet registered, sign up on Buddy4Study using your Email, Mobile number, or Google account. You will now be redirected to the ‘U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26’ application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online application form. Upload relevant documents. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- U-Go Scholarship Program 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26, one of India's largest scholarship programs, is an initiative of the SBI Foundation. This program aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families across India, ensuring the continuity of their education. This scholarship is open to students from who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses from the top 300 NIRF universities/colleges. Selected students can receive a scholarship of up to INR 20 lakh to support their educational endeavours. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-asha-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 15 Nov 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for Indian nationals. 2. Applicants must be studying or pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses from the top 300 NIRF universities 3. Applicants must have secured 75% marks or above in their previous academic year. 4. The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 3,00,000. Note: There is a provision of 10% relaxation for students belonging to SC/ST (Percentage of marks – 67.50%, CGPA – 6.30). 50% of slots are reserved for females. 50% reserved for SC/ST (25% SC, 25% ST). Benefits Scholarship up to INR 15,000 (*T&C Applied) Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Marksheet from the previous academic year (Class 10/Class 12/Graduation/Postgraduation, as applicable) 2. Government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar card) 3. Current year fee receipt 4. Proof of current year admission (admission letter/institution identity card/bonafide certificate) 5. Bank account details of the applicant (or parent) 6. Proof of income (Form 16A/income certificate from a government authority/salary slips, etc.) 7. Photograph of the applicant 8. Caste Certificate (Wherever Applicable) How can you apply? Click the ‘Apply Now’ button. Login to with your registered ID and land on the ‘Application Form Page’. If not registered, register with your Email/Mobile number/Google account. You will now be redirected to the ‘SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26’ application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online application form. Upload relevant documents. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) and Student Exchange Agreement between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod, Russia. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Established in 1916, Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod (UNN) stands as one of Russia's most prominent public research institutions. Located in Nizhny Novgorod, the university offers a diverse range of programs across its 15 faculties and institutes, catering to over 30,000 students, including a significant international community. UNN is renowned for its pioneering contributions to scientific research, particularly in fields such as radio physics, mechanics, and neuroscience, and maintains strong collaborations with top scientific centers globally. full_content: The Division of International Affairs (International Relations Cell), LPU, is pleased to announce an outstanding opportunity for LPU Master’s and PhD scholars in Bio Sciences, Biotechnology, and Bioengineering to pursue a full-time PhD program at National Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology (NKUST), Taiwan. National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST / Taiwan Tech) holds a prominent position in the QS Asia University Rankings, ranking 66th in Asia and 5th in Taiwan in the 2025 rankings. Applications are invited for the Spring 2026 semester (starting February 2026). The application window will be open till October 15, 2025. In this intake, two PhD vacancies are available in the host lab. Selected students will receive monthly fellowships and full fee waiver, making it an excellent opportunity to pursue doctoral research abroad. Research Areas in the Lab: Bioprocess Technology / Biochemical Engineering with emphasis on: Enzymes Biomass valorization Fermentation Value-added products (Prebiotics, Biofilms for food packaging, Nanoparticles from cellulose/lignin) Food technology Eligibility: Open to LPU Master’s and PhD scholars in Bio Sciences, Biotechnology, and Bioengineering with strong research interest Minimum 8.0 CGPA preferred Valid Passport No backlog/reappear or disciplinary cases Fellowship & Benefits: Stipend: TWD 18,000 per month (approx. ?50,000–55,000) to cover living expenses Tuition & Admission Fee: Fully waived (for 3.5–4 years of PhD) Final Degree: Awarded by NKUST, Taiwan Language Requirement: Basic Chinese language course during the first 2 years of the PhD Expenses to be Borne by Students: Health Insurance (every 6 months): TWD 6,000 (approx. ?16,500–17,000) Flight tickets Visa charges Travel/Health insurance Personal expenses Duration: 3.5 to 4 years (Full-time PhD Program) Application Process: Students must apply through the International College of NKUST. Interested candidates are requested to share their CVs in advance for review. To Apply register at this link: https://forms.gle/4oprHQubACJg88fHA Contact: ?? Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310) ?? 7986997720 / 9875928583 / 7888398891 ? study.abroad@lpu.co.in Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Command the Stage: A workshop on conquering stage fright”. This empowering workshop envisions individuals conquering stage fright and becoming captivating speakers and performers. It aims to help students explore the root causes of stage fright and provides practical strategies to manage anxiety, boost self-assurance, and project confidence on stage. The activity-based workshop will include hands-on exercises, vocal warm-ups, and body language techniques to enhance public speaking skills. The main objectives of the event are: . To explore the root causes of stage fright. · To learn practical strategies to manage anxiety, boost self-assurance, and project confidence on stage. · To enhance student’s public speaking prowess through hands-on exercises, vocal warm-ups, and body language techniques. · To offer personalised feedback to overcome stage fright and become confident speakers. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme is an initiative from OakNorth to provide financial assistance to underprivileged women seeking to pursue higher education in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) subjects. Under this scholarship, female students from Haryana, Uttarakhand, and Bihar who have passed Class 12 and are pursuing a degree (any graduation year) in STEM-related subjects at government colleges/universities will be provided with a scholarship of ?30,000 to continue their education. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/oaknorth-stem-scholarship-program Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open to students domiciled in Haryana, Uttarakhand and Bihar. 2. Only female candidates are eligible. 3. Applicants must be pursuing a degree (any graduation year) in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) subjects at government universities or colleges across India. 4. Candidates must have secured an aggregate of 75% or above in Class 12 (or equivalent) and at least 65% in the previous class/semester/year (if applicable). 5. The applicant's annual family income must be less than ?3 lakhs. 6. Children of employees of Buddy4Study and OakNorth are not eligible to apply. Benefits A scholarship of ?30,000 (fixed amount) will be offered to the selected students for one time only. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. CV/resume of the applicant 2. Copies of Class 10 marksheet, Class 12 marksheet, and previous semester marksheets (if applicable) 3. Copy of Aadhaar Card 4. Family Income Proof (e.g., a letter from the SDM, DM, Tehsildar, or equivalent authority/proof of income tax returns/an affidavit, etc.) 5. Provisional allotment/admission letter from the university 6. An essay on “Why You Should Be Given This Scholarship?” 7. A letter of recommendation (from College/University) HOW TO APPLY: 1. Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. 2. Log in to Buddy4Study using a registered ID to land on the ‘Online Application Form Page’. 3. If not registered, please register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile number/Google account. 4. You will now be redirected to the ‘OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme 2025-26’ application form page. 5. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. 6. Fill in the required details in the online scholarship application form. 7. Upload the required documents. 8. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. 9. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- OakNorth STEM Scholarship Programme 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: L'Oréal India invites applications for the L’Oréal For Young Women in Science Program 2025-26 from Class 12th passed girls aspiring to pursue higher education in science. The program supports talented young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds by providing scholarships of up to Rs 62,500 for Undergraduate (UG), up to Rs 1,00,000 for Postgraduate (PG), and for PhD studies across diverse fields including Pure Sciences, Life Sciences, Applied Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, Cosmetology, Cosmetic Science, Pharmacology, and more at recognised Indian institutions. Since its inception in 2015, the initiative has empowered over 550 women to pursue careers in science. Eligibility for Under-graduate Students: Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 85% marks in Class 12th (Science Stream). Applicants’ annual family income should not exceed Rs 6,00,000. Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate (any year) degree in a science-related field (except those who are in their final year). Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Eligibility for Post-graduate Students: Open to female students only. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in their undergraduate course. Applicants’ annual family income should not exceed Rs 6,00,000. Applicants must be pursuing post-graduation (any year) in fields such as Technology, Science, Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, etc. (except those who are in their final year). Students from PAN India can apply. Children of employees of L'Oréal India and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: The final selection is contingent upon the submission of an admission letter from a recognized college/university in India. Last Date of Registration: 03-Nov-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Under-graduate Students: Fixed scholarship of Rs 62,500 Rewards for Post-graduate Students: Scholarship up to Rs 1,00,000 Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/loreal-india-for-young-women-in-science-scholarships Link 2 : https://forms.gle/LR6rFRcBYPCDSJ8a9 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in. full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and Soongsil University, South Korea. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Founded in 1897, Soongsil University is South Korea’s first modern university, originally established in Pyongyang. Today, Soongsil is recognized for its rigorous academic programs and selective admissions, with competitive majors in business, economics, and information technology. It is particularly noted for its computer science department, which ranks second nationally after Seoul National University, and its business school, which has produced a significant number of certified public accountants. The university has educated numerous prominent figures, including former South Korean President Kim Dae-jung, who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. With over 16,000 students, Soongsil continues to uphold its legacy as a pioneer in Korean higher education. If you are interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with Soongsil University, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration! Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2025-26 is an initiative by DXC Technology aimed at supporting the educational expenses of students from marginalized groups. Under this national-level scholarship program, women and transgender students pursuing STEM courses are eligible to receive a one-time scholarship of INR 50,000 to continue their education. To apply, the family income of the student must be less than or equal to INR 4,00,000. Preference is given to persons with disabilities Link for apply Scholarship: www.buddy4study.com/page/dxc-progressing-minds-scholarship The Last date for the scholarship is 30 Sept 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Women and transgender students pursuing graduation in any year of a STEM-related field are eligible. 2. Applicants must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks in their previous class/semester. 3. Applicants’ annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 4,00,000. 4. Students from PAN India are eligible to apply. 5. Children of employees of DXC Technology and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. 6. Students with disabilities will be given preference. Benefits INR 50,000(Fixed Amount) Note: The scholarship amount covers education-related expenses, which include tuition fees, hostel fees, mess charges, travel expenses, books, stationery, devices/data, medical insurance, etc. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Applicant’s photograph 2. Institution admission proof (Admission Letter/Institution ID Card, etc.) 3. Previous year’s marksheet 4. Payment receipts for education-related expenses, such as tuition fees, hostel fees, books, mess charges, etc., along with the fee structure for the whole academic year 5. Class 12 marksheet 6. Proof of family income such as ITR, salary slips, letters from a concerned government authority, etc. 7. Proof of identity (Pan Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, etc.) 8. Bank Passbook 9. Document proof for transgender and physical disability (if applicable). HOW TO APPLY: Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. Log in to Buddy4Study using your registered ID. You will be navigated to the ‘Online Application Form’ page. If you are not already registered on Buddy4Study, register using your email ID/mobile number/Facebook/Gmail account. Once logged in, you will be redirected to the “DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship for Graduation Students in STEM 2025-26” application form page. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. Fill in the required details in the online scholarship application form. Upload the required documents. Click the ‘Accept” button to agree to the terms and conditions. Please ensure you have read the terms and conditions before accepting them. Click the ‘Preview’ button. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correct on the preview screen, click on the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2025-26 -------->- - DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2025-26 All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103(B), and Window No. 4. full_content: The Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2025-26, a Social Initiative of Group Legrand India, aims to provide financial support to meritorious girls, differently-abled girls, Covid-affected students, LGBTQ+ students and students with single parents or those who are orphans, to help them pursue higher education. Under this program, academically promising girl students enrolled in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., or undergraduate degrees in Finance or Science (such as B.Sc, B.Com, B.B.A., etc.) will receive 60% of the annual course fee, up to INR 60,000 per year. Students in the special category* will receive 80% of the annual course fee, up to INR 1,00,000 per year, until they complete their course, based on their academic performance. Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/legrand-empowering-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship is 30 Sept 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Open for girl students across India only. 2. Applicants must have secured admission in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., B.B.A., B.Com., or B.Sc. degrees in India. 3. Applicants must have passed Class 12 in the year 2024–25. 4. Applicants must have secured a minimum of 70% and above marks in Class 10 and 12 examinations. 5. The applicant's annual family income from all sources must be less than or equal to INR 5,00,000. There are two categories of students eligible for scholarship disbursement: 1. Generic category: All meritorious and deserving girl students. Scholarship award amount - 60% of the course fee up to the limit of 60,000/- (whichever is less) per annum until the completion of the course. 2. Special category: Differently-abled girl students, LGBTQ+ students, Covid-affected students, and students with single parents or those who are orphans. Scholarship award amount - 80% of the course fee up to the limit of 1,00,000/- (whichever is less) per annum until the completion of the course. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Photo ID Card 2. Age-proof (Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passport, Class 10 school leaving certificate) 3. Aadhaar Card (If Aadhaar Card is not available, an equivalent document for proof of address) 4. Class 10th and 12th marksheet 5. Family Income Certificates or Form 16 of parents/ bank statements of the last six months 6. Bank account details of the applicant (or parent) 7. Passport-size photograph of the applicant 8. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct "Metaphor Mosaic: A Competition on Storytelling." This event offers a unique platform for students to explore the art of storytelling through the lens of metaphors, encouraging them to think creatively, speak confidently, and connect deeply with their audience. In this one-of-a-kind event, participants will be presented with a random image on screen. They will have 30 seconds of thinking time, followed by a 2-minute storytelling speech, where they must creatively link the image to a workplace skill such as leadership, teamwork, adaptability, problem-solving, or time management. This activity promotes not only creativity and critical thinking but also enhances spontaneous speaking. Students will unlock their storytelling potential and develop skills essential for both academic and professional success. The main objectives of the event are: • To foster creativity and imagination through metaphor-based storytelling. • To enhance spontaneous narrative-building and public speaking skills. • To provide a competitive yet collaborative platform for students to share their stories. Target Audience: The students of all School of lovely professional university will participate in the event. full_content: This is to inform you that the IAEC meeting for the pre-clinical study will be held shortly. You are requested to submit your proposed Form B (attached herewith) by 15th October 2025 in 5-101. Please note that submissions received after this date will not be entertained. Please note that the IAEC meetings are conducted only three times a year (October, December, and February). Important Instructions for Form B Submission, Presentation, and Animal Work: 1. Guide Evaluation: Form B must be evaluated by the respective guides. The guide/co-guide and students are solely responsible for this. 2. Submission Protocol: Form B must be submitted by the guide only. 3. Correction Process: If corrections are suggested, the corrected Form B must be resubmitted along with the earlier version within 1-3 days. Late submissions will not be accepted. 4. Meeting Attendance: Attendance at the pre-IAEC (if held) and IAEC meetings is mandatory for both guides and students. Non-attendance will result in the non-approval of Form B, which will then be deferred to the next meeting. 5. IAEC Certification: Certificates will be issued upon submission of Form D and the summary report, duly signed by guides and authorized personnel. 6. Faculty Involvement: Faculty/Guides must visit the animal house to assist their respective students. 7. full_content: The HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India 2025 program extends financial assistance to PwD female engineering students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, facilitating their pursuit of education. Automobile b. Mechanical c. Mechatronics d. Electrical and Electronics e. Electronics and Communication f. Production g. Instrumentation h. Computer Science Engineering i. Information Technology 4. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 5,00,000. 5. Children of employees of Schaeffler India or Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for this scholarship. full_content: Dear students, The University Grants Commission (UGC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE), is promoting India Skills Competition 2025 — a national-level skill competition to identify, nurture, and reward young talented individuals in various technical and vocational skills. Why Participate? Showcase your skills at a national platform, and compete for recognition and prestige. Get a chance to represent India in the World Skills Asia Competition 2025 and World Skills Competition 2026. Benefit from specialised training, mentorship, and exposure to world-class skill standards. Enhance your employability prospects and gain recognition in industry & academia for your exceptional skills. India Skills 2025 – Key Details: Topic Details Eligibility (Age Criteria) for all Indian nationals Minimum age: 16 years Maximum Age: (i) Competitor must be born on or after 1 January 2004, in general; (ii) Competitor must be born on or after 1 January 2001 for the 13 Skills i.e., Digital Construction, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, ICT Network Infrastructure, Additive Manufacturing, Industrial Design Technology, Industry 4.0, Mechatronics, Optoelectronic Technology, Robot Systems Integration, Water Technology, Dental Prosthetics, and Aircraft Maintenance. Please note: Age Criteria may change subject to the notification/ announcement by World Skills India (WSI). Skills covered All skills are divided in the following six categories: 1. Construction & Building Technology 2. Creative Arts & Fashion 3. Information & Communication Technology 4. Manufacturing & Engineering Technology 5. Social & personal Services 6. Transportation & Logistics For details of skill categories, please refer to Annexure-I given in the UGC guidelines attached with this communication. Registration Mode & Portal Via Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) portal https:/www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/home You can also follow the following link: https://www.mygov.in/task/india-skills-competition-2025 Last date to register 30 September 2025 Selection / Competition Process Please go through the multi-tiered selection process as mentioned in the attached UGC guidelines for India Skills Competition 2025 UGC Notification link For further details you can go through the UGC notice and guidelines for India Skills Competition 2025 as per the following link or go through the UGC notice attached with this communication. https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/2710131_IndiaSkills-Competition-2025.pdf Please note: Students who demonstrate outstanding performance in the above-mentioned competition shall also be considered for inclusion under the Edu-Revolution academic benefit category, subject to due evaluation. In case of any other query, students can visit the Assistance Zone in Block 27-Room no. 102. full_content: Artificial Intelligence-Centre of Excellence (AI-CoE) and Centre of Space Science (CSS) are jointly seeking for student participation in challenging and real-life project-based research works dealing with "AI-Augmented Resource Mapping of Battlefield Equipment with Offline Communication Capabilities". The detailed topics are as follows. A. Real-Time Location Tracking using NavIC + Inertial Navigation Systems Objective: Develop a rugged and power-efficient GPS+INS system using NavIC receivers and IMU sensors without using internet. Deliverables: 1. Microcontroller-based hardware prototype (e.g., ESP32, NavIC Module, MPU6050/ICM20948) 2. Location accuracy testing in GPS-denied or low-signal environments (Field testing) 3. Data buffering and synchronization for offline operations B. Decentralized Mesh Communication System (No-Internet Data Relay) Objective: Build a self-forming wireless mesh network (LoRa, Zigbee, MANET-style) for secure battlefield communication. Deliverables: 1. Deployable mesh nodes (eg. LoRa-enabled MCUs like Heltec/RAK, Zigbee, MANET etc.) 2. End-to-end encrypted communication 3. Multi-hop, fault-tolerant packet relay between field units and command center C. AI-Based Resource Allocation and Repair Suggestion Engine Objective: Develop a lightweight AI model to allocate nearest functional repair resource based on fault type, priority, and availability. Deliverables: 1. Decision engine trained on synthetic repair fault datasets (using tools like Python, Scikit-learn, Decision Trees/Neural Networks) 2. Optimized routing algorithm 3. Service time + risk-aware allocation decisions 4. Fault-based prioritization system, resource allocation map D. Command Center Dashboard and Visualization Interface Objective: Develop an intuitive interface to monitor all resources, fault locations, and suggested responses. Deliverables: 1. UI dashboard for Rea-time GIS-based visualization for field monitoring 2. Live plotting on offline GIS maps (MapBox/QGIS tiles, Google Earth Engine, Leaflet.js, etc.) 3. Visual alerts for downtime, risk, or supply needs (asset tracking interface) E. Secure Data Transmission and Encryption Layer Objective: Implement a lightweight cryptographic protocol (ECC or AES) to secure field data without internet dependency. Deliverables: 1. Embedded-side encryption/decryption 2. Time-bound keys or One-time password schemes 3. Command center decryption tool for trusted access only F. Portable Power System and Field Deployable Hardware Design Objective: Create rugged, low-power enclosures with solar/rechargeable battery modules for all edge units. Deliverables: 1. Power Supply Unit (Foldable Solar-array, Swappable Battery Pack, etc.) 2. Power management circuit with DC/DC converters to support multiple voltages (3.3V, 5V, 12V). 3. Compact enclosure designs (3D-printable/cut, IP67, shock/dust/water resistant etc.) 4. MIL-grade connectors and ruggedization study Note: 1. This initiative is part of a real-time, mission-driven project with defined deliverables and timelines. Due to its critical nature, only students demonstrating a strong sense of responsibility, technical competence, and commitment will be considered. Non-performance or lack of active participation may lead to reassignment or withdrawal from the project. 2. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Mechanical Engineering presents an opportunity to join “Mind Over Matter” an exclusive club dedicated to developing aptitude, reasoning, and analytical skills among students. The club will serve as a platform for interactive learning through puzzles, quizzes, mock tests, doubt-clearing sessions, and engaging activities that make problem-solving both fun and effective. Students will also benefit from exam updates, smart preparation tips, and opportunities to showcase their talent in competitions and events. Mission of the Club The mission of Mind Over Matter is to cultivate logical reasoning, problem-solving, and analytical skills among students by creating an engaging and collaborative environment. The club aims to make aptitude and reasoning practice more enjoyable, accessible, and purposeful, while also preparing students for academic success, competitive exams, and real-life challenges. Through regular activities, peer learning, and leadership opportunities, we strive to build confident, critical thinkers who can approach problems with clarity, creativity, and confidence. Benefits of Joining the Club · Regular practice of aptitude, reasoning, and puzzles sharpens problem-solving ability. · Help prepare for competitive exams (SSC, Bank PO, CAT, state exams, campus placements). · Exposure to multiple problem-solving methods and quick calculation techniques. · Enhances logical thinking and clarity of expression, useful in real interviews. · Quizzes, games, and activities make learning enjoyable, not stressful. · Students can discuss, ask questions, and learn collaboratively. · Information on upcoming exams, test patterns, and opportunities are shared regularly. Target Audience: The Students of all Schools at Lovely Professional University. full_content: LPU offers a wide range of international opportunities — from the International Credit Transfer Program (2+2 / 1+1) to semester exchange, summer schools, global internships. Many of the opportunities are available on 100% Scholarship. To participate, students must be passport-ready and keep essential documents updated. A valid passport is the first requirement to apply for any international program. Why act now? ? Applying early avoids last-minute delays. ? Passport processing requires police verification at your permanent address — you must be present at home during that time. ? International opportunities can arise anytime, and being prepared ensures you don’t miss out. What you need for a passport application: ? Aadhaar Card (Identity & Address proof) ? 10th Marksheet / Birth Certificate (Date of Birth proof) ? College ID Card (Recommended for students) ? Passport-size photographs (if not opting for on-spot service) How to apply: ? Register at passportindia.gov.in ? Fill application form & pay fees online ? Book appointment at nearest Passport Seva Kendra (Jalandhar / Ludhiana / Amritsar) ? Visit with required documents ? Track application status online Apply for your passport in your first year itself. Many students lose opportunities due to delays in passport readiness — don’t let that happen to you. Take the first step towards your global journey today. full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the University of West of England (UWE Bristol), UK. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Founded in 1595 and based in Bristol, England, UWE Bristol is a modern public research university with origins in the Merchant Venturers’ Navigation School. It is one of the largest universities in South West England, recognised for its practice-oriented teaching and strong industry links. Ranked in the 601–800 band globally in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2025, the university is especially known for excellence in robotics, data science, creative industries, and politics, and for impactful, internationally recognised research. full_content: Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12. Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and pursuing professional graduation courses like Engineering and other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) will be provided scholarship of Rs 1.5 lakh per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree). Eligibility for Applicants: Open for meritorious girl students across India. Applicants must have scored at least 75% or more marks or equivalent CGPA in Class 12 board examinations. Applicant's annual family income must be less than Rs 6,00,000. Meritorious girl students who have secured admission to the first year of graduation programs in the academic year 2025-26 for professional graduation degrees such as Engineering, or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.). Children of employees of Kotak Mahindra Group, Kotak Education Foundation and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for the Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025-26. Last of Registration: 31-Aug-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: A scholarship amount of Rs 1.5 lakh per year will be given to each selected scholar till completion of her professional graduation course/degree. full_content: Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. This year, the competition is going to be held in 2 categories: i.Human powered ii.RC controlled No. Of Seats: 20 ( 10 for each team) Eligibility Criteria: Age: 18 or older, Student must be a regular student of Lovely Professional University CGPA: Student must have minimum CGPA of 6.5 (not applicable for freshers students). Passport: Should have a valid passport with at least 2 years of validity considering 30th November as final date of submission of documents. Language Skills: Good proficiency in English communication. The Total Expense for the event which include (Team registration fee, Air fare/ticket (both way), hotel stay, local travel for competition at Alabama- USA. Technical Skills: Expertise in any of the following . Designing- CAD and CAM software Fabrication Coding Robotics and Automation Content writing Video creation, editing and promotion Sponsorship STEM engagement Selection criteria: I. Students will be selected on the basis of eligibility criteria, previous experience, skill set followed by personal interview/interaction through an expert committee. II. After selection, only 20 students will be shortlisted for final participation and representation at USA. Previous Experience: At least 1 year of domain experience in the relevant skill. We encourage all eligible and interested students to take advantage of this incredible opportunity. For more information and to apply, click on the following link: Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/NASA-HERC-LPU . Last Date of Registration: 31st August, 2025 Contact- Mr. Ruhul Choudhury-6284626764 For any further information, please contact us at Department of Student Research and Project, Innovation Studio, Block 39- Room no-111B Attachment: 1 Rover Challenge.jpeg Uploaded By: Office of HOD Innovation Studio *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: In response to the queries raised by students of the School of Computer Science and Engineering regarding the UMS announcements: “Commencement of Classes for specific programmes of Computer Science and Engineering in Fractal Mode (2nd Year::Term-3)/ (3rd Year::Term-5)”, the following clarifications are being issued. The adoption of the Fractal mode is necessitated by inclement climatic conditions leading to extraordinary heavy rains and widespread waterlogging and floods in nearby regions. This restructuring ensures both student safety and continuity of learning without any disruption. Academic Schedule & Fractal Mode: . The academic term is not reduced in duration; instead, it has been carefully reorganized into two fractals with no compromise on academic quality and content delivery. . Fractal 1 (September 2025): Some courses will be taught in online synchronous learning mode, and you will be fully engaged for the day. Each course will have the complete set of 40–42 lectures, ensuring full academic coverage as per Instruction Plan (IP) . Fractal 2 (October 2025–January 2026): All the remaining courses will be taught in offline mode during this period. These will also be delivered with the full number of lectures, exactly as per the Instruction Plan (IP). . Further, the classes of courses running in Fractal 1 will also be conducted in offline mode during Fractal 2. Students who wish to improve their grade in Fractal 1 courses may attend the offline classes and/or appear for the corresponding offline improvement examination without any additional fee. . To ensure there is absolutely no compromise in academic quality, the term duration has been extended by 15 days. Further, no winter vacation will be given this year so that the complete syllabus is accommodated in time. 2. Choice of Mode of Classes for Fractal 1: . Students have the freedom to attend Fractal 1 classes either online (through synchronous live sessions on My Class) or offline in campus classrooms, as per their choice. . For the students reporting in the university for Fractal 1, the classes will be conducted in the offline mode. Also, the Continuous Assessment (CA) and End Term Exam (ETE) will be conducted in offline mode only. . Those who wish to attend offline must register through the UMS link : UMS Navigation > Examination System > Mode Preference- Fractal 1 online classes . Separate timetables and sectioning will be arranged for online and offline group of students. 3. Mode of Examination: Fractal Mode CA Mid Term End term exam Fractal 1 Online 1 CA-Online Not applicable Online Fractal 1 Offline Offline Not applicable Offline Fractal 2 Offline CAs as per course IP- Offline Offline Offline The question paper pattern for End Term online examinations for Fractal 1 will follow below mentioned pattern: S No. Question Paper pattern Total no. of questions Marks per question Total marks Time allocated per question Total exam time 1 All MCQ 45 1 mark for correct answer, 0.25 negative marking for wrong answer 45 2 minutes 90 minutes 2 All Subjective 5 10 marks per question 50 24 minutes (20 minutes to attempt the question + 4 minutes to upload the photograph of answer sheet) 120 minutes 4. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) a. For students who have applied for RPL in the courses running in Fractal 1: No RPL Provision is applicable. b. For students who have applied for RPL in the courses running in Fractal 2: The RPL examination will be conducted in the offline mode, within first week of the start of fractal 2 classes. 5. Hostel Fee Adjustments . For students availing university residential facilities, one month’s refund is being processed. . Proportionate hostel fee in lieu of Fractal 1 online classes will be also adjusted against the next term fee. . Hence the students will be eligible for total hostel fee refund of 20% which will be adjusted towards fee of next session. The refund shall be made on all types of hostel fee including Mess , gym , laundry etc. 6. First Week attendance Bonus The first week bonus will be applicable for students who have successfully completed the prescribed online certifications. The students should submit their mode preference for attending the Fractal 1 classes at the below mentioned link latest by 26th August 2025 so that the sectioning can be initiated accordingly. Link: UMS Navigation > Examination System > Mode Preference- Fractal 1 online classes The University reaffirms that there will be no compromise in your academic quality. Every course will be delivered with the full lecture count, assessments will be held on time, and the learning outcomes will remain intact. All students are advised to rely only on official university notices and UMS announcements for accurate and updated information. Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Academic Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. This year, the competition is going to be held in 2 categories: i.Human powered ii.RC controlled No. Of Seats: 20 ( 10 for each team) Eligibility Criteria: Age: 18 or older, Student must be a regular student of Lovely Professional University CGPA: Student must have minimum CGPA of 6.5 (not applicable for freshers students). Passport: Should have a valid passport with at least 2 years of validity considering 30th November as final date of submission of documents. Language Skills: Good proficiency in English communication. The Total Expense for the event which include (Team registration fee, Air fare/ticket (both way), hotel stay, local travel for competition at Alabama- USA. Technical Skills: Expertise in any of the following . Designing- CAD and CAM software Fabrication Coding Robotics and Automation Content writing Video creation, editing and promotion Sponsorship STEM engagement Selection criteria: I. Students will be selected on the basis of eligibility criteria, previous experience, skill set followed by personal interview/interaction through an expert committee. II. After selection, only 20 students will be shortlisted for final participation and representation at USA. Previous Experience: At least 1 year of domain experience in the relevant skill. We encourage all eligible and interested students to take advantage of this incredible opportunity. For more information and to apply, click on the following link: Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/NASA-HERC-LPU . Last Date of Registration: 25 August, 2025 Email- innovation.studio@lpu.co.in Contact- Mr. Ruhul Choudhury-6284626764 For any further information, please contact us at Department of Student Research and Project, Innovation Studio, Block 39- Room no-111B Uploaded By: Office of HOD Innovation Studio *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The Infosys Foundation launched the Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship Program 2025–26 to help female students who want to pursue an undergraduate course in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). This covers living expenses, tuition, and the price of study materials Link for apply Scholarship: https://www.buddy4study.com/page/infosys-stem-stars-scholarship The Last date for the scholarship is 15 Sept 2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship 1. Also, students pursuing second-year B.Arch or five-year Integrated/Dual Degree courses are eligible to apply. 4. Applicants must have an annual family income of less than or equal to ? 8,00,000. full_content: Lovely Professional University is inviting applications for student participation and representing India in the prestigious NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, (NHERC)- 2026, set to take place in the United States of America. This exciting opportunity allows you to be part of a team representing LPU on an international platform. This annual event, part of the Artemis Student Challenge, engages students worldwide in the next phase of human space exploration. Lovely Professional University is participating in this event from last 5 years and this year also, we are ready to participate with full throttle. About the Challenge: The NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge is an annual competition that challenges students to design, build, and test human-powered rovers capable of traversing simulated extraterrestrial terrains. This event encourages teamwork, problem-solving, and practical application of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) concepts. HERC draws inspiration from both the Apollo and Artemis missions, emphasizing the design, construction, and testing of technologies to traverse unique environmental terrains. As an Artemis Student Challenge, it emphasizes innovation in designing and testing technologies for various environmental terrains. This year, the competition is going to be held in 2 categories: i.Human powered ii.RC controlled No. Of Seats: 20 ( 10 for each team) Eligibility Criteria: Age: 18 or older, Student must be a regular student of Lovely Professional University CGPA: Student must have minimum CGPA of 6.5 (not applicable for freshers students). Passport: Should have a valid passport with at least 2 years of validity considering 30th November as final date of submission of documents. Language Skills: Good proficiency in English communication. The Total Expense for the event which include (Team registration fee, Air fare/ticket (both way), hotel stay, local travel for competition at Alabama- USA. Technical Skills: Expertise in any of the following . Designing- CAD and CAM software Fabrication Coding Robotics and Automation Content writing Video creation, editing and promotion Sponsorship STEM engagement Selection criteria: I. Students will be selected on the basis of eligibility criteria, previous experience, skill set followed by personal interview/interaction through an expert committee. II. After selection, only 20 students will be shortlisted for final participation and representation at USA. Previous Experience: At least 1 year of domain experience in the relevant skill. We encourage all eligible and interested students to take advantage of this incredible opportunity. For more information and to apply, click on the following link: Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/NASA-HERC-LPU . full_content: UNESCO has launched the 2025 edition of its Youth Hackathon, a central initiative of Global Media and Information Literacy (MIL) Week, aimed at empowering young people to address pressing challenges in today’s complex digital information ecosystem. The Hackathon provides a platform for youth to design and present innovative solutions that promote media and information literacy, digital rights, and civic engagement. Participants will be guided through a mentoring program and invited to co-create practical, youth-led responses to issues such as AI ethics, disinformation, online hate speech, platform monopolies, and threats to information integrity. Eligibility: 1. Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years of age at the time of registration. 2. Participate either individually or as part of a team (teams may include up to five members). 3. Demonstrate an interest in media literacy, digital ethics, information access, civic technology, or related fields. Participants will follow a structured process: 1. Registration: Applicants must complete an online registration form with accurate team or individual details. 2. Mentoring Phase: All registered participants will receive access to a free online mentoring program in August 2025, conducted by international experts in digital media, technology, education, and civic engagement. 3. Proposal Submission: Final project proposals must be submitted by the designated deadline. Submissions will be evaluated by an international jury on criteria such as originality, feasibility, impact, and alignment with the theme. Final Selection: Winning teams will be invited to showcase their projects at the Global MIL Week Conference in Cartagena, Colombia, on 23–24 October 2025. UNESCO will cover travel and accommodation expenses for the selected teams. UNESCO encourages solutions that are: Innovative: Combining new approaches or technologies to solve persistent MIL challenges. Scalable and Sustainable: Designed for replication or adaptation in other contexts or communities. Community-Driven: Centered around local needs and involving diverse stakeholder input. Ethically Sound: Aligned with human rights, freedom of expression, and digital inclusion. Examples might include mobile apps, toolkits, educational games, media campaigns, policy frameworks, or digital platforms that improve access to reliable information, counter disinformation, promote fact-checking, or enhance civic engagement through media literacy. How to Register Interested individuals or teams must submit their registration via UNESCO’s designated online portal. All team members must be listed at the time of registration to qualify for the mentoring phase. Link: https://www.unesco.org/en/weeks/media-information-literacy/youth-hackathon-2025 For any clarification and discussion, you can contact Prof. Rahul Saha, Coordinator, AI-CoE, Research and Development Cell, Block 38, Room 207, Cabin 03. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement presents an opportunity to join “Language Boosters Club” for the students. It is well known that language is not merely a means of exchanging words, but a tool that shapes our thoughts, perspectives, and interactions with the world. Therefore, English has emerged as the global lingua franca, connecting people from different countries and cultures worldwide. It serves as the language of international communication, business, science, and technology, making it essential for individuals seeking to thrive in the globalized economy. full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the Saint Petersburg State University (SPbU), Russia. This strategic collaboration aims to foster mutual co-operation in key areas such as semester exchange, articulation pathways, joint research, summer/winter programs, and more. Founded in 1724 and based in St. Petersburg, Russia, SPbU is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Eastern Europe. It consistently ranks among Russia’s top institutions and is recognized globally for its rigorous academic environment and strong research output. Ranked #375 in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the university is especially known for excellence in mathematics, physics, international relations, political science, and linguistics, and has produced a number of Nobel laureates, presidents, and prominent scholars over its long history. If you're interested in exploring joint initiatives or a study abroad opportunity with the Saint Petersburg State University, please feel free to reach out to the Division of International Affairs. Stay tuned for upcoming opportunities under this exciting collaboration! Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature
title: LPU Signs MoU with Saint Petersburg State University, Russia : LPU/11.2/IRC(SPSU)/2025/003(3.11)/IC/250808/0001 (8/8/2025)

full_content: Through the NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning), online courses (MOOCs) the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, recognizes students across the country for their academic excellence through certified MOOCs and distinguished Gold, Silver and Elite badges. These honors not only validate subject mastery but also enhance students’ academic and professional profiles. Performance Badges Awarded by NPTEL: 1. Gold Badge – Awarded to students who scored 90% and above, reflecting exceptional academic excellence. 2. Silver Badge – Awarded to students with a score of 75% to 89%, reflecting strong academic performance. 3. Elite Badge – Awarded to students who scored 60% and above, signifying noteworthy course completion with distinction. We are delighted to announce that several students of our university have successfully completed NPTEL MOOCs mapped to our curriculum under the Academic Equivalence Framework, and have been granted corresponding academic benefits. Heartfelt congratulations to all the achievers! The attached document contains the list of all our achievers. This achievement is a testament to your dedication and pursuit of academic excellence through self-paced learning. We encourage other students to explore the vast learning opportunities offered by NPTEL MOOCs and strive for similar accomplishments. For any further clarifications regarding the evaluation or award process, students may visit the Query and Assistance Zone located at Block 27-102A. Students may also reach out through RMS as per the path specified below: UMS---> Relationship Management System (RMS) ---> Log Request . Select Department: Academics . Category: Academics . Subcategory: MOOCs In case students who have successfully completed MOOC courses offered through NPTEL/SWAYAM but have not yet submitted the course details are requested to submit the completed MOOC certifications latest by 10 August 2025 at Feedback.daa@lpu.co.in. Further, students intending to enroll in NPTEL MOOCs for the upcoming academic term are advised to take note of the course registration deadlines and complete their registration through UMS > LMS > MOOC Certification by 18th August 2025. (Details of the course and course mapping for above MOOC certifications has been provided in the attachment) We commend your efforts in taking proactive steps toward academic growth and wish you continued success in all future endeavors. full_content: The Division of International Affairs is delighted to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Lovely Professional University (LPU) and the Tomsk State University, Russia. Founded in 1878 in Tomsk, Siberia, National Research Tomsk State University (TSU) is one of Russia’s oldest and most prestigious public universities. Ranked #499 in the QS World University Rankings 2026. TSU is known for its strengths in physics, materials science, chemistry, mathematics, and computer science, often placing among the top 3-4 in Russia for engineering and physical sciences. full_content: We are pleased to inform you about an exciting national-level opportunity launched by Hyundai Motor India Foundation – the "Art for Hope 2025" initiative. This year’s edition is focused on community-based art, encouraging projects that engage with social, cultural, or environmental themes. Selected applicants will get to bring their ideas to life and contribute meaningfully to society through art. Who can apply? Visual artists, performing artists, craft practitioners, digital creators, photographers, and other creatives · Applicants must be 18 years or older as of the application date. Open to both individual artists and collectives What Will You Receive? Financial grant of Rs 1,00,000 (individual). Mentorship and guidance from industry experts and curators.
