full_content: Department of Student Research and Projects under the aegis of Student Welfare Wing is excited to announce that - the Ministry of MSME has launched MSME Idea Hackathon 5.0. This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon:The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co Attachment: 1 MSME_Idea_Hackathon_5.0_Instructions_for_Participation.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature
title: Registration open for MSME-Idea Hackathon 5.0. : LPU/18.4/CAPB/2024/001/IC/250730/0001 (7/30/2025)

This edition marks a significant milestone in the journey of fostering inclusive innovation, as it opens its doors to a broad spectrum of participants, welcoming all Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years. The Hackathon 5.0 is a celebration of India’s diverse talent pool, which is designed to harness the collective ingenuity of our people to address pressing national challenges and unlock new opportunities for the future. With themes ranging from low-carbon technologies and cyber defence to Industry 4.0 & 5.0 adoption, coastal and hilly area sustainability, and smart supply chains, this initiative reflects our commitment to building a future-ready MSME ecosystem. Themes of the Idea Hackathon 5.0 to create innovation for smart and sustainable MSME ecosystem are as following:- 1. Low-carbon footprint solutions/technologies 2. Stealth, Surveillance, and Cyber Defence Technologies 3. Innovation in Adoption of Industry 4.0 & 5.0 in MSME ecosystem: 4. Innovation for business upliftment and sustainability in coastal and hilly areas 5. Smart and Resilient Supply Chains Stages of Idea Hackathon- Stage 1 - Evaluation by the Host Institutes Stage 2 - Evaluation by the Ministry of MSME Stage 3 – Selection of Ideas by Domain Expert Selection Committee (DESC) Stage 4 – Final Selection by Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee(PMAC) Eligibility Criteria: a. Any innovator of Indian origin- having e-mail and mobile number. b. You can apply under three categories – MSME, Student and Others. c. Under MSME category, register for MSME Idea Hackathon using Udyam Registration number. (To register for Udyam Registration, https://udyamregistration.gov.in/Government-India/Ministry-MSME-registration.htm) d. Under Student category, a Student Identity Card valid for FY 25-26 must be submitted Outcome of the Hackathon:The selected Ideas will receive funding of up to a maximum of 15 lakhs & incubation support under the Ministry’s MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation Component) for nurturing and development of Idea into prototype. Last Date to apply: 31.07.2025 Fees: NIL Registration Link: https://innovative.msme.gov.in/ (while registering on the MSME portal please use Host Institute as Lovely Professional University) Detailed information brochure is attached herewith. For any query please contact: - Ph. No. 9814818964, Email: innovation.studio@lpu.co Attachment: 1 MSME_Idea_Hackathon_5.0_Instructions_for_Participation.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Youth Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Dear Students, Welcome to Lovely Professional University ! As we say that the best way to get something done is to begin. So working on the mantra of Why Wait, University has taken an innovative step to introduce a Diagnostic Assessment right at the beginning of your academic journey to ensure overall skill enhancement and to make you industry ready. Diagnostic Assessment helps you to know your strengths, areas to fill the gaps, building capacity, stand out amongst your peers, and have a clear road map ahead and finally you will be an inch closer to get your dream job. This Assessment assesses you on critical areas like communication skills, logical reasoning and quantitative skills. These skills play a pivotal role in the entire placement process and help the recruiter to identify the suitability of a candidate. This methodology is rapidly emerging as an industry benchmark with companies like Cognizant, Capgemini, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, and Microsoft for recruitment at entry level roles. The diagnostic assessment will also help the University to plan appropriate activities and training initiatives for your future endeavours. Based on this Diagnostic Assessment, your placement specific credited, non-credited and language lab inputs will be planned. On the whole, the Diagnostic Assessment will act as a Gateway to Placements. KEY POINTERS* :- Exam URL is: https://cocubes.in/lpu2025 :- Exam PASSKEY will be shared with the eligible students via UMS my messages. :- For general instructions and guidelines, Kindly visit at : https://tinyurl.com/2025freshmenassessment :- For benefit and step by step pathway video of assessment, Kindly visit at : https://youtu.be/024AwmeeEQA Uploaded By: Office of HOD Centre for Professional Enhancement *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Division of Examinations is recruiting students for Part time job as a CCTV Surveillant for ODL-Examinations. The primary purpose is to utilize student's talent, zeal and enthusiasm positively for In-campus tasks like Monitoring CCTV, Reporting Suspicious Activity, System check and maintenance, Incident Logging and Data Storage Oversight etc. in the Division. Nature of Job: 01. Monitoring CCTV Feeds: Continuously observe live CCTV footage from examination rooms. Ensure real-time vigilance without distractions or interruptions. 02. Reporting Suspicious Activity: Immediately report any suspicious or unfair practices (e.g., cheating, unauthorized behavior). Inform supervisors/observer/flying squad for swift action. 03. System Check and Maintenance: Ensure all cameras are functioning properly before the start of the exam. Report any malfunctioning equipment immediately to the technical team. 04. Incident Logging: Maintain a log of all significant observations or incidents on an interface. 05. Data Storage Oversight: Ensure recording of suspicious activity and saved properly for future verification. Personality Traits: 01. Candidate should possess good communication and interpersonal skills. 02. Good teamwork and team member. 03. Efficient handling of Procedures. 04. Integrity and Honesty, Impartiality, Professionalism, Punctuality and Reliability,Observational Skills, Vigilant 05. Good knowledge of using computers/internet/social networking. Shortlisting and Academic Criteria: 01. Students enrolled Under PhD Degree (No major disciplinary records or case). 02. Minimum CGPA --- 6 CGPA without active reappear or backlog. All the interested candidates must registered through UMS path mentioned below : UMS Navigation >> Student Welfare System >> Part time job Module >> Student Registration or register through part-time job application option available on dashboard. Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “The Insight Exchange - A competition on group discussion”.The Group Discussion Battlefield is a dynamic platform where students will engage in intense, moderated discussions on pressing topics, testing their communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills which will help them prepare for the interviews. full_content: This is in reference to the Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from August 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have registered for the summer term classes in May-June 2025 and have successfully completed their attendance criteria are required to appear for Summer Term Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is as follows: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation: All eligible research scholars as per the attached list (List of research scholars who can register for summer term SAS evaluation with subject to eligibility criteria) are required to register for summer term SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: Academics - Research & Development Registration of Upcoming Activity SAS Note: The interface for registration will remain active from 22nd July 2025 to 29th July 2025. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis: All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the attached guidelines) through the following UMS path: Academics Research & Development- Registration of Upcoming Activity Submit SAS synopsis All the research scholars are required to completely register for SAS evaluation. The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the synopsis followed by the verification of synopsis by their supervisors. Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 22nd July 2025 to 29th July 2025. 3. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation Division of Examination Department of Ph.D. Evaluation Ph.D. Seminar File Verification SAS. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the SAS synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 31st July 2025. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a) At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b) No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c) The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 29th July 2025, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS. d) If a research scholar registers for the summer term SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS (scheduled tentatively from Dec 2025 onwards) only after the clearance of all pending dues. e) The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines (Guidelines for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f) File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g) The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h) Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of SAS synopsis will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of SAS synopsis, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of SAS synopsis. i) File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. j) Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. k) The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI &VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. full_content: About the Program: The HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India 2025 program extends financial assistance to female engineering students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, facilitating their pursuit of education. This program offers financial support to female students nationwide who are enrolled in their first year of engineering studies, with preference given to students with disabilities (PwD) who belong to economically weaker sections of society and need financial assistance to pursue their education. They can receive financial aid worth Rs 50,000 to support their academic endeavours and nurture their potential as future leaders in engineering. Eligibility for Applicants: Open to female students across India enrolled in the first year of an engineering program at any state or UGC-recognised college. Preference will be given to students with disabilities. Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in Class 12 (Science stream) in the academic year 2024–25. For PWD applicants, the minimum required marks are 40% in Class 12 (Science stream). Preference will be given to students pursuing the following engineering branches: Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering . The family income of the applicant should not exceed Rs 5,00,000 annually. Children of employees of Schaeffler India or Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply for this scholarship. Last Date of Registration: 30-July-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Rs 50,000. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/hope-engineering-scholarship-by-schaeffler-india Link 2 : https://forms.gle/84XAa2hTpo2AmDcu7 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. full_content: About the Program: The IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship is a need-based scholarship program by IDFC FIRST Bank that financially supports students with family incomes of less than Rs 6 lakh per annum. full_content: About the Program: The Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program, an initiative of Bharti Airtel Foundation, aims to support deserving students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds, with a focus on girl students, to become future technology leaders. This merit-cum-means-based scholarship program has been designed for deserving students enrolled in technology based engineering undergraduate and 5 year integrated courses. This fully funded scholarship aims to remove financial barriers that prevent deserving students from accessing quality education. It covers 100% annual fees, including meal and accommodation charges. Additionally, all Bharti Scholars are provided a laptop in their first year to aid in their academic journey. Eligibility for Applicants: Confirmed admission or enrollment in the first year (academic year 2025-2026) of the undergraduate/5 year integrated courses in fields of Electronics & Communication, Telecom, Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Data Sciences, Aerospace and Emerging Technologies (AI, IoT, AR/VR, Machine Learning, Robotics). Must be a citizen and resident of India.Parents’/guardians’ annual income from all sources should not exceed Rs 8.5 lakhs. Preference shall be given to students who are girls, persons with disabilities, have single /no parents and transgender. Applicants should not be recipients of any other scholarships/ grants for the same purposes as being supported by the Bharti Airtel Foundation. Last Date of Registration: 31st July 25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Scholarship covers 100% of annual fees as per the course fee structure of the respective university/institute. Scholarships are for the full duration of the UG courses, including integrated courses for up to 5 years (subject to meeting the renewal criteria as detailed in subsequent FAQ section). The hostel and mess fees shall be given to all eligible students who apply for it. For students staying in PG/outside hostel, the funds will be released as per the hostel/mess charges of the university/institute (whichever is less). A laptop will be provided to all Bharti Scholars during the first year of the course. (Responsibility for the safety/security of the laptop will be with the student. No replacements will be provided.) Upon successful graduation and subsequent gainful employment, Bharti Scholars will undertake to voluntarily support at least one student at the school or college level on a continuous basis. This commitment aims to foster a culture of giving back, ensuring the continued empowerment of future generations through education with the community. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/bharti-airtel-scholarship Link 2 : https://forms.gle/3VW3sxiXnwhvFyDq8 Note: It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the Buddy4Study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. In case of a query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering, is going to conduct “Nature and Well-Being: A workshop on mindfulness”. The workshop emphasizes the power of sensory experiences in nature (sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste) to promote mental well-being and self-awareness, and introduces evidence-based techniques like forest bathing and mindful walking. Through guided reflection, sensory-based techniques, and mindfulness practices, students will learn how natural elements can support emotional balance, reduce stress, and enhance daily focus. The session encourages students to re-engage with their surroundings—both indoors and outdoors—using practical tools and activities that nurture mental health. The main objectives of the event are: · To educate students on the psychological and physiological benefits of nature-based well-being practices. · To introduce practical techniques (e.g., 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, forest bathing) that students can use in their daily lives for stress reduction. · To foster a sense of connection—with nature, others, and oneself—by engaging the senses and promoting mindful presence. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Division of Residential Services is going to conduct “Persona Pitch: A Competition on Self-Branding” a dynamic and competitive workshop designed to empower participants in mastering the art of spontaneous communication. This competition will include a live interview simulation, providing an excellent opportunity to experience real-world interaction and further develop presentation and interpersonal skills. Target audience: The students of all Hostels will participate in the event. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Applications is going to conduct “First Words Matter: A Workshop on Self-Introduction Skills.” This workshop is designed to help participants understand the power of a well-crafted self-introduction and its impact on building first impressions in academic, professional, and social settings. full_content: About the Program: The Raman Kant Munjal Scholarships 2025-26 is an initiative by the Raman Kant Munjal Foundation, supported by Hero FinCorp, that aims to help students pursuing finance-related courses pursue their dreams of a promising career and a bright future. full_content: About the Program: The HOPE Engineering Scholarship by Schaeffler India 2025 program extends financial assistance to female engineering students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, facilitating their pursuit of education. full_content: The Division of International Affairs brings an exciting opportunity for students to earn an international degree through LPU’s Credit Transfer Program. full_content: About the Program: The Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program, an initiative of Bharti Airtel Foundation, aims to support deserving students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds, with a focus on girl students, to become future technology leaders. This merit-cum-means-based scholarship program has been designed for deserving students enrolled in technology based engineering undergraduate and 5 year integrated courses. This fully funded scholarship aims to remove financial barriers that prevent deserving students from accessing quality education. It covers 100% annual fees, including meal and accommodation charges. Additionally, all Bharti Scholars are provided a laptop in their first year to aid in their academic journey. Eligibility for Applicants: Confirmed admission or enrollment in the first year (academic year 2025-2026) of the undergraduate/5 year integrated courses in fields of Electronics & Communication, Telecom, Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Data Sciences, Aerospace and Emerging Technologies (AI, IoT, AR/VR, Machine Learning, Robotics). Must be a citizen and resident of India. Parents’/guardians’ annual income from all sources should not exceed Rs 8.5 lakhs. Preference shall be given to students who are girls, persons with disabilities, have single /no parents and transgender. Applicants should not be recipients of any other scholarships/ grants for the same purposes as being supported by the Bharti Airtel Foundation. Last of Registration: 31st July 25 till 11:59 pm Rewards for Applicants: Scholarship covers 100% of annual fees as per the course fee structure of the respective university/institute. Scholarships are for the full duration of the UG courses, including integrated courses for up to 5 years (subject to meeting the renewal criteria as detailed in subsequent FAQ section). The hostel and mess fees shall be given to all eligible students who apply for it. For students staying in PG/outside hostel, the funds will be released as per the hostel/mess charges of the university/institute (whichever is less). A laptop will be provided to all Bharti Scholars during the first year of the course. (Responsibility for the safety/security of the laptop will be with the student. No replacements will be provided.) full_content: LPU Global – National Theatre Screening of Small Island The Division of International Affairs is pleased to announce a special opportunity for students to attend the National Theatre (UK) screening of Small Island, hosted by the British Deputy High Commission in collaboration with Alliance Française. This acclaimed adaptation of Andrea Levy’s award-winning Windrush novel brings to life the powerful and moving stories of three individuals navigating the journey from Jamaica to Britain, against the backdrop of World War II and the post-war immigration wave of 1948. “A spectacular adaptation of Andrea Levy’s Windrush novel” – The Observer The play follows: Hortense, who dreams of a better life in Britain Gilbert, with ambitions of becoming a lawyer Queenie, seeking freedom from her rural English life Their interwoven stories explore themes of hope, identity, and colonial legacy, brought to the stage by a cast of 40 actors on the Olivier Stage of the National Theatre Event Details: Venue: Alliance Française, Sector 36, Chandigarh Date: Friday, 6 June 2025 Time: 10:15 AM Duration: 3 hours 20 minutes (including a 20-minute interval) Limited seats available – 10 participants on a first-come, first-served basis. Interested students must submit their names by 12:00 PM on Tuesday, 2 June 2025 Register here: https://forms.gle/DuBvLydVkzRfN9bG7 For more information, please contact: Division of International Affairs (Block 32-310) Mobile: +91 7986997720 Email: study.abroad@lpu.co.in Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of International Affairs *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Community Development Project aims toward understanding the society related issues/problems and then working towards the solutions to these problems for betterment of the society. Thus, community development project is included as a core course in the curriculum of the students. All students who are required to undergo a community development project (CDP) during June-July 2025 as per their program scheme (tentative list of students is attached as Annexure I) are hereby informed that the students can complete their CDP by choosing any NGO/local organizations involved in community development tasks allowing physical reporting so that student can work on real time problems existing in the society. Important Points: 1. Minimum duration required to complete the community development project should be at least 30 hours or at least 4 weeks. 2. Student must identify/choose an NGO/Organization that qualifies for tax exemption under Section 80G. 3. It is mandatory for students to include day wise “GEO-TAGGED PICTURES” in their final report and presentation demonstrating the live work done by students related to CDP (for 30 hours or for 4 weeks). No Presentation/Report shall be acceptable without “Geo Tagged Pictures”. i.e. Every report should have minimum 6 Geo Tagged pictures. 4. The students are required to obtain the certificate from the NGO/ local organizations involved in community development areas describing the topic and number of hours the student has worked with the NGO/local organization to complete the project. The certificate should be included in the final report, to be eligible for appearing in the ETP. 5. For evaluation parameters and report submission details, kindly go through the guidelines for Community Development Project (Annexure-II). 6. The final ETP viva voce for Community Development Project shall be tentatively scheduled after commencement of classes of Upcoming Autumn Term 25261. The final schedule shall be communicated to students at least 7-10 days prior to the date of ETP evaluation. 7. Lastly all the students are required to submit the name and address of their finalized NGO to the university latest till 10th June 2025 for the verification purpose. For the same soon UMS link shall be shared with all the students via UMS my message. In case of any query, students may log an RMS request via the below mentioned path: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS) --->Log Request Message Type: Enquiry Category Type: Academic and Administrative Issues Category: Examination Sub-Category: Seating Plan and VIVA- Capstone/ Dissertation/ Thesis/ CDP/ Summer Training Attachment: 1 Annexure I.xls 2 Annexure II.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: About The Program The Mirae Asset Foundation Scholarship Program, an initiative of the Mirae Asset Foundation, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from underprivileged sections of society across India. Under this scholarship, students currently pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses in the country can apply and stand a chance to receive a scholarship of up to Rs 50,000. About Mirae Asset Foundation Mirae Asset Foundation, established in 2018, is the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) arm of Mirae Asset Financial Group in India. Guided by the vision of its parent organisation, the Mirae Asset Park Hyeon Joo Foundation in Korea, the Foundation is dedicated to advancing education at all levels. Its initiatives include providing scholarships to students and collaborating with schools, colleges, government agencies, civil society organisations, and other partners to deliver impactful educational programs across the country.Mirae Asset Scholarship Program for Undergraduate. Student Eligibility for Undergraduate Applicants:- Open to students who are currently pursuing undergraduate courses in India. Students must have scored at least 60% in the previous academic year. full_content: The Division of International Affairs brings an exciting opportunity for students to earn an international degree through LPU’s Credit Transfer Program. Under this program, students begin their academic journey at LPU, upon successful completion of the initial phase, transfer to one of our esteemed partner universities in countries such as the U.K., USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Latvia, Lithuania, or France. This unique program lets you experience the best of both worlds — students will study the initial part of their degree at LPU and transfer to a foreign university to complete the remaining coursework — ultimately earning a degree from the international partner university. Why Choose the Credit Transfer Program? Cost-Effective: Save up to 40% on tuition fees by studying just 2 years abroad instead of 4. Global Exposure: Immerse yourself in international academic and cultural experiences. Work Opportunities: Earn while you learn! Work up to 20 hours per week (as per host country norms). Support Your Stay: Cover your living expenses through part-time jobs. Post-Study Work Rights: Eligible students may receive PSWR after completing their degree abroad. Eligibility Criteria Minimum 6.5 CGPA with no backlogs or reappearances at the time of application. No pending disciplinary cases. IELTS score of 6.5 overall, with no less than 6 in each module. Proof of financial ability (Funds) to support living and study abroad. A valid Passport Open to 2023 batch (Bachelor’s) and 2024 batch (Master’s) students. Last Date to Register: May 30, 2025 Ready to begin your global journey? full_content: Recent trends in the job market have revealed the desire of the corporate sector as well as government undertaking institutions to hire candidates for various job positions who have research background through pursuance of Doctoral Degree. Looking into this context of new job opportunities which are not only well paid off but also very high in demand, Lovely Professional University (LPU) has brought an excellent opportunity for the final year Post Graduate students to register for Ph.D. programme for the upcoming Schedule 2 - August 2025 session. Ph.D. at LPU Ph.D. at LPU entitles you to a host of world class opportunities and facilitations in the form of research publication incentives, international travel grants, state-of-the-art central instrumentation facility (CIF) at highly subsidized rates, research contingency grant and various annual research fellowships. Important Points : 1. Application Fee Exemption: As a special gesture, final year PG students enrolling for the entrance test will have special chance to avail LPUNEST application form fee exemption. 2. Selection Process: The student can appear for LPUNEST on either 11th July/13th July 2025 followed by research proposal discussion with the technical committee. 3. Programme Fee and Scholarship: The term fee for the Ph.D. programme is Rs. 50,000/- with a minimum 20% scholarship as part of Alumni benefit. However, higher scholarships of up to 60% can also be availed based on the performance in the LPUNEST. Scholarship Slab Scholarship Amount Fee Applicable per semester 60% Rs 30,000/- Rs 20,000/- 50% Rs 25,000/- Rs 25,000/- 40% Rs 20,000/- Rs 30,000/- NOTE: a. Students who have already applied through UMS and either appeared or did not appear for the LPUNEST exam held on 22nd April 2025 at LPU (Schedule 1) and wish to avail a second chance can apply through the LPUNEST Admission Dashboard. b. Students who have not applied in schedule 1 due to any reason(s) can apply for LPUNEST 2025 in Schedule 2 by following the steps mentioned below. How to Apply ? Stage 1 Basic Details: Fill out your basic details in the following link: https://forms.gle/3eXW2iMNA2dmddSY7 Stage 2 Coupon Code: After verification of details, a special coupon code will be shared with the student on the registered email id which can be used to complete LPUNEST registration with full application fee waiver. full_content: Dear Students, We are immensely proud of our armed forces, who have provided us with a safe environment and because of whom we are safe and sound in our homes! All academic operations at the university have resumed. The End Term Examinations for the Spring Term 2024-25 (i.e., Term 2 of the 2024-25 session) will be conducted online, starting from Wednesday, 21st May 2025 for all students except for those belonging to School of Pharmacy. Regarding the same the following guidelines must be immediately noted by all the students: 1. Select Mode of Examination: a. In case any student wishes to appear for the ETE examinations in the offline mode at the university campus instead of online mode, then he/she should submit request at the link UMS Navigation --- Examination System --- Consent for Mode of Examination latest by 15th May 2025 (Thursday). For the students opting for offline mode of examination, separate date sheet will be displayed in due course. b. For the students wishing to appear for exams in the online mode, they should also visit the above-mentioned UMS link and select the preferred mode of Examination as “Online” latest by 15th May 2025. In case a student does not select any mode of exam by 15th May 2025, then his/her the examination will be conducted in the online mode by default. c. The online examinations will be conducted through the LPU My Class interface. 2. Date sheet and Question paper pattern for online examination: a. The date sheet for online examination has been made available to students for the upcoming End Term Examination through the UMS portal under the following navigation path: UMS Navigation ---- Examination System --- Exam Seating Plan. All students should refer to the date sheet through the mentioned link immediately. b. The online examination will follow the below mentioned question paper pattern for majority of the courses. Question Paper pattern Total no. of questions Marks per question Total marks Time allocated per question Total exam time Unit wise distribution All MCQ 45 1 mark for correct answer, 0.25 negative marking for wrong answer 45 2 minutes 90 minutes 5 questions each from Unit I, II and III.10 questions from Unit IV, V and VI c. The exam session timings and question paper pattern applicable for each course code will be displayed in the UMS Seating Plan shortly. Students are advised to carefully check their applicable question paper pattern. d. If any course code has a different question paper pattern (other than All MCQ) due to the nature of the course, the details will also be communicated under the “UMS Exam Seating Plan” tab shortly. 3. Instructions to candidates: All students are strictly advised to refer the “Instructions to students for End Term Examination May 2025-Online Mode” attached with this communication. 4. Mock Test: a. To familiarize students with the use of the LPU MyClass platform for appearing in examinations, mock sessions will be conducted for all students from 16th to 18th May 2025. b. The schedule for these mock sessions will also be displayed under the “Exam Seating Plan” tab for all students in UMS login shortly. c. It is mandatory for all students appearing for the online examination to attend and attempt the mock test. 5. Infrastructure requirements: Students are advised to ensure they are equipped with the necessary infrastructure and prerequisites to appear in the online examination. This includes having a laptop or mobile device that meets the specified technical requirements, as well as access to a dedicated room or quiet space for taking the exam. For detailed infrastructure guidelines, please refer to the attached document. 6. Code of Conduct: a. All students are strictly warned to refrain from using any unfair means during the online examination. If any student is found cheating, copying from any online/offline sources or indulging in use of any prohibited/unfair means, then strict penal action will be taken. b. The online examination software is AI-based and continuously captures your screen activity during the examination. If you navigate away from the examination window or engage in any form of malpractice, an Unfair Means Case (UMC) case will be registered against the student immediately. c. Detailed guidelines regarding Unfair Means Cases (UMC) have been attached with this communication. All students should carefully go through these guidelines for reference. For any query, feel free to contact at 01824-520150. Attachment: 1 infrastructure requirements.pdf 2 Instructions to students for End Term Examination May 2025-Online Mode.pdf 3 UMC guidelines.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: About The Program:- The IET India Scholarship Award is one of India's most prestigious scholarship programs for undergraduate engineering students. Established by the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), it aims to identify and support the next generation of engineering leaders in India by recognising their creativity, innovation, leadership, and academic excellence. Now in its 9th edition, the program is open to undergraduate engineering students across all years (1st to 4th year), offering a total scholarship fund of Rs 10,00,000. Applications are entirely free of cost, making this opportunity even more accessible to all eligible candidates. About the IET:- The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), one of the world’s largest professional societies for engineers, is headquartered in the UK. It collaborates with industry, academia, and government to advance engineering and technology, supporting engineers at every stage of their careers in its mission to engineer a better world. In India, IET focuses on Future Technologies, Mobility & Transport, and the Future of Work. Its esteemed Honorary Fellows include Shri Ratan Tata, N. R. Narayana Murthy, and T. V. Ramachandran. Through strategic partnerships, practical learning initiatives, and thought leadership, IET aims to enhance engineering skills, drive technology adoption, and address challenges of national importance. Eligibility for Applicants:- Open for students studying in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of a full-time regular undergraduate engineering program (in any field) approved by AICTE/UGC. Applicants must have cleared all credit courses in a single attempt. Applicants must have scored a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate (or 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) in the semesters cleared so far. There is no age limit for the applicants. Applications are entirely free of cost. Note:- Application is open for all IET members and non-members and for all branches of engineering as recognised by the AICTE/UGC.Also, lateral entry students joining a B.Tech. program in the 2nd year can apply too. Last of Registration:- 31-May-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- The selected scholars will receive the scholarship prize as mentioned below – For Regional Round of Selection: the scholarship award will be as follows. Regional round winner – Rs 60,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). Regional round runner-up – Rs 40,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). For National Finals: The winners of the regional round will compete in national finals, and the scholarship award will be as follows . Winner – Rs 3,00,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). 1st runner-up – Rs 1,70,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). 2nd runner-up – Rs 1,50,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). Note: If a student wins the scholarship at regional and national levels, he/she will be awarded a certificate for both levels and the prize money for the national level only. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/iet-india-scholarship-awards Link 2 : https://forms.gle/fgEL4Xo72iuDXQsT6 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. Kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in. full_content: Mercor Graduate Fellowship, aimed at supporting exceptional Ph.D. scholars who are on track to make significant contributions in their respective fields. This fellowship is designed to recognize potential, not just past accomplishments. Mercor works with thousands of researchers across disciplines and is committed to strengthening the ecosystem of doctoral and postdoctoral research. Eligibility Ph.D. scholars in STEM fields are eligible to apply. This includes traditional areas such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics. Interdisciplinary fields related to STEM are also encouraged to apply. Application Process The application process is simple and requires approximately 15 minutes to complete. It involves: Uploading your resume Completing a brief interview with Mercor’s AI interviewer The AI-led interview is designed to explore your research interests and academic experiences in a conversational format. For further details or to discuss the evaluation process, please contact Dr. Oriza Kamboj in Block 38, Room 202. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Computer Science and Engineering is going to conduct “Design Sense: A Workshop on The UX Laws and Wireframing Sprint”. This fast-paced, interactive workshop will be designed for students, beginners, and creative minds curious about the world of UX design. Through this engaging session, participants will cover the key psychological laws that shape great digital experiences and will learn how to apply them to create clean, user-friendly wireframes. From understanding Fitts’ and Hick’s Laws to building their first mobile app wireframe, this workshop will simplify UX concepts and will help them think like designers — no prior experience will be needed. The main objectives of the event are: · To understand the fundamentals of User Experience (UX) design principles. · To identify and apply key UX laws such as Fitts' Law, Hick’s Law, and Visual Hierarchy to real interfaces. · To comprehend the importance of user-centered design thinking in product and interface design. · To learn the basics of wireframing and its role in the UX process. Target audience: The students of all Schools of Lovely Professional University will participate in the event. full_content: This is for the information of all PhD scholars and their supervisors that the evaluation of State of the Art Seminar (SAS) will be conducted tentatively from June 2025 onwards. The main aim of the Ph.D. State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation is finalization of: a) Title of the proposed research work. b) Objectives of the proposed research work. c) Research methodology of the proposed research work. The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for SAS registration: a. The research scholar must have cleared the course work or must be exempted for the same due to M. Phil. b. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration c. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy Note: Agriculture research scholars who have cleared the first term of coursework may request for registration at : rdc.sas@lpu.co.in I. The research scholars must take the following three steps to register and appear for SAS evaluation. 1. Registration for SAS evaluation All eligible research scholars are required to register for SAS evaluation through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --- Examination system --- Ph.D. Evaluation --- Registration of Upcoming Activity --- SAS – Select “Click here for SAS registration” Note: The interface for registration and file uploading will remain active from 30th April 2025 to 26th May 2025. 2. Uploading of SAS Synopsis All registered research scholars are required to upload their synopsis (prepared strictly according to the shared guidelines) through the following UMS path: UMS Navigation --- Examination System--- Ph.D. Evaluation --- Registration of Upcoming Activity--- Submit report Note: The link for uploading of SAS synopsis will remain active from 30th April 2025 to 26th May 2025. Recommendation of SAS synopsis by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/ Administrative supervisor: Once the research scholar has uploaded their SAS synopsis for the evaluation, the same must be recommended by their respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor by visiting the following path: UMS navigation --- Division of Examination --- Department of Ph.D. Evaluation ---Ph.D. Seminar File Verification --- SAS The registration will only be considered as complete if the scholars will upload the verified synopsis by their supervisors. If the supervisor does not verify the synopsis of the scholar, it will be considered as rejected and the scholar will not be allowed to appear in the SAS evaluation. Note: The last date for the recommendation of the synopsis by Supervisor/Co Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor 30th May 2025. Important Note: For Registration and Uploading of SAS synopsis: a. At the time of SAS registration, the research scholars should opt their domain for their SAS Seminar very carefully after consulting with their Supervisor/Co-Supervisor/Administrative Supervisor (if any) as they will be evaluated by the expert panel from the selected domain only. No request for change in domain shall be entertained afterwards. b. No extension in the timelines as mentioned in the announcements will be allowed. c. The registered scholars who wish to de-register themselves, may do so through a request application forwarded to Department of Ph.D. Evaluation duly recommended by supervisor no later than 26th May 2025, failing which the scholar will be marked absent during the SAS evaluation and will have to pay INR 5000/- as fee for registering in the next SAS d. If a research scholar registers for the SAS evaluation but does not upload the synopsis by the stated last date or he/she is absent at the date of SAS seminar/evaluation then he/she shall be required to re-register for the next scheduled SAS evaluation with the applicability of fee of Rs. 5000/- subject to fulfilment of other eligibility criteria. He/ she shall only be allowed to appear in next scheduled SAS only after the clearance of all pending dues. e. The research scholars must upload a single PDF file for SAS synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisors strictly as per the attached guidelines ( for SAS) to complete the registration process or else their registration may be cancelled. f. File containing cropped signature of the supervisor shall not be considered for the evaluation. Scholars are advised to scan the page containing the signature of the supervisor and include it as a part of final PDF document to be uploaded. g. The SAS synopsis must be uploaded through UMS interface as per the prescribed timelines. No extension shall be given for registration for SAS beyond the last date. h. Research scholars are also required to submit a hard copy of the synopsis duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor/ co-supervisor/ administrative supervisor (wherever applicable) at the time of evaluation. Cropped or digital signatures on the hard copy of SAS synopsis will not be considered. It is mandatory to submit the hard copy of SAS synopsis, as the result will be shared only after the submission of hard copy of SAS synopsis. i. File containing PDF of snapshots of pages is strictly prohibited and shall not be considered for evaluation. j. Research scholars should go through the attachment (Snapshots for using the SAS registration interface) before registration and uploading the SAS synopsis at the interface. k. The research scholar must have a laptop and bring their own projector cable (HDMI to HDMI / HDMI to VGA) for connecting the projector at the time of evaluation (mandatory). For Recommendation of SAS synopsis: 1. The research scholar must upload the SAS synopsis well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines. 2. Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. In case, any of the eligible research scholars has query regarding the following issues, the paths for submitting RMS requests are provided below: 1. For Registration/Uploading of SAS report, submit RMS by following the path: UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Category (Academic and administrative issues) --> Select Search by Category: Ph.D - Research Degree Evaluation Cell: SAS -->Sub Category: SAS. 2. For Supervisor / Co-supervisor / Extension / Term off/ document/fees, submit RMS by following the path UMS Navigation --> Relationship Management System --> Log Request --> Select Message Type (Enquiry) --> Select Search by Category (Academic and Administrative issues) --> Select Ph.D - Centre for Research Degree Programmes. full_content: This is to notify all Continuing students that they can now apply for a Change of Program using the online interface available at the following link: UMS Navigation -->Change of Program--> Request for Change of Program. However, the students should meticulously go through the guidelines (attached with this communication) before applying for the same. Timelines for change of Program:- Phase Processing Fee From To I Rs.1000/- 29th April, 2025 17th June, 2025 II Rs.3000/- 18th June, 2025 31st July, 2025 III Rs.5000/- 1st Aug, 2025 30th Aug, 2025 No program change option will be allowed after the last date i.e. 30th August, 2025 under any circumstances. Important Note:- All students who apply for change of program shall be required to pay the “processing fee” online after submitting their request along with the parent’s consent letter/undertaking form. (Note: - The processing fee is non-refundable even if the change of program request of student is not approved by competent authorities) The program of the student shall be changed for the notified students (approved cases) after the payment of change of program fee (Rs 4000/-) within the given timelines and the final approval of the competent authorities. In case student fails to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for the Change of Program shall stand cancelled and he/she would be required to continue in the ongoing program only. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old program after approval of Change of Program. Due to course mapping if student is allocated additional courses to study to complete the requirements of the new program he/she will have to register the courses as backlog by paying the 1/10th of the tuition fee with scholarship plus 350/- (per course). Only one chance is given to the students for change of program during the entire program duration, hence the students are advised to be very careful while availing this chance. No benefit of missed CA or Attendance will be given to the student applying for change of program after start of classes. To avoid this, students are strongly advised to apply for the change of program before the start of the term. The attendance shall be calculated from the date of registration of student in new program. full_content: We are delighted to announce the opening of university’s new Admission and Counseling Office in Hamirpur! This expansion reinforces our commitment to providing dedicated support to students, parents, and educational partners in the region. full_content: Dear Students, Welcome to a new era of learning! The University proudly announces the launch of EduRevolution for the upcoming term– a student-centric transformation initiative where gamification in education would be aiming at redefining your academic experience with greater flexibility, beyond classroom exposure, freedom to choose alternative learning modes, skill development for effective industry readiness and opportunity to convert real world implementation into real earnings. Step into this revolutionary academic experience where Artificial Intelligence will be your learning companion — guiding, supporting and empowering you at every step of the way. Begin your EduRevolution Journey here: You can now access and apply for EduRevolution through your UMS student login in the below mentioned categories. For each category, options (that you may choose) have been crafted by expert faculty members for specific courses of your upcoming term. . Recognition of Prior Learning(RPL) (Core/Non-Core) . Grade Upgradation (Core/Non-Core) . 10% attendance relaxation . Duty Leave for Recognized Activities . Value Addition in Academic Transcript . Evaluation Component modification Summer break extends an excellent opportunity to students to complete these offered activities so that students come better equipped and prepared for upcoming term. To effectively tap the benefits of summer break the students can apply for their nominations latest by May 10th, 2025 (for Phase I). After required approvals, the approved nominations for Phase I shall be intimated to students by May 20th, 2025 so that they can complete these tasks during the summer break. Steps to Apply: Login UMS --> LMS---> EduRevolution:Be the Change---> Apply for EduRevolution Have an Idea to Add? Be the Voice behind the Revolution! EduRevolution is built with you and for you. If you have a new option for any course that aligns with real-world learning or flexible academic enhancement which is not available in the EduRevolution portal, then you can share it through the category -“Any Other” (available across all categories) for all courses. Your contribution could shape future academic innovations! Across all categories the provision has been laid in the interface wherein students can submit their own ideas and after due approval and intimation of associated academic benefits, the students may pursue these ideas. Important Instructions: i. All selections must be completed for Phase I, by 10th May, 2025. For subsequent phases periodic intimidation shall be released. ii. Student can apply for maximum one course under the category of Recognition of Prior learning (RPL) for the upcoming term; the examination for the same will be scheduled in 15 days of start of the Autumn term 2025-26. iii. Student can apply for maximum of 1 course under the category of core course equivalence. iv. Student can apply for a maximum of one course under Non-core course equivalence along with Core course equivalence or RPL. v. For assistance, feel free to reach out the Query Handling and Assistance Zone (Room 27–102). You may also raise queries via RMS under the EduRevolution category for effective resolution. *(For detail refer attachments) Let EduRevolution empower you to own your learning, elevate your profile, and lead with skills that matter in the real world. The primary purpose is to utilize student's talent, zeal and enthusiasm positively for In-campus tasks like counselling through Walkin/telephonic, preparation of ID cards and handling files, inquiry feeding, dispatching prospectus in postal cell etc. in the Division. Conducting surveys and collecting information from students/parents in Social Media outreach and Reputation Management cell: Student will be responsible for conducting surveys and collecting information. 02. Data Entry, Reception handling, Campus visits and Routing in Walk-in Inquiry Cell: Candidates will be responsible for data entry for new enquiries and routing the enquiries to the counselor for further processing. 03.Packing and dispatch of Prospectus, lpunest kits in Postal Cell: Candidates will be responsible for packing, dispatch of material time to time in postal cell. Good Information of LPU’s strengths, processes and interfaces. 05. Good knowledge of using computers/internet/social networking/office tools. 06. Estimated number of days in a week is 6 and working hours will be 8/9 hrs which can be extended on a rotational basis depending upon the task allotted. Shortlisting and Academic Criteria: 01. Students enrolled in Under Graduate/ Post Graduate Degree (with no active backlogs). 02. Students having any curriculum requirement/Placement activity/Classes/Training scheduled during the period of job (Between May to July) which is clashing with job timings (9 am to 5 pm/6 pm) need not to apply. Students will not be relieved or exempted for this purpose during the tenure of job. 03. Students will be relieved one day before the start of classes. However, they may apply for leave within the tenure of the job. Minimum CGPA --- 6 CGPA without active reappear or backlog. Working Hours: 9 AM to 5/6 PM -Min 08 Hrs shift Selection Procedure: Online Test & Personal Interview. Last Date for registrations: 23rd April 2025. All the interested candidates must registered through UMS path mentioned below :UMS Navigation >> Student Welfare System >> Part time job Module >> Student Registration or register on the UMS portal Part time job application. All interested candidates with CGPA greater than 6, must register through the Navigation by 23rd April, 2025. full_content: This is for the information of all concerned that Mettro waste Handing Pvt. Ltd. Company, which is actively engaged in charitable endeavors, has taken CRS initiatives to support the education of meritorious students who are facing financial hardships. The Student must go through the following details to apply for the scholarship. 1. Eligibility Criteria for Scholarship Academic Qualification: 0pen to undergraduate (UG) students with a Minimum CGPA of 7.0 (or equivalent) Financial Eligibility: Annual family income must not exceed 5,00,000/- Disciplinary Record: No history of disciplinary actions, penalties, or examination malpractice. Compliance with institutional /hostel / departmental codes of conduct is mandatory. 2. Scholarship Benefits Number of Beneficiaries: Approx. 30-50 students will be selected initially. Scholarship Amount: Approx. 120,000 to {30,000 per semester [disbursed upon meeting renewal criteria]. Renewal: Continuation would require maintaining a CGPA of 7.0+ and adherence to eligibility terms. 3. THE LAST DATE FOR THE SCHOLARSHIP APPLICATION IS 30-APR-2025 4. Important Conditions There is no bar on applicants holding other scholarships to submit application. However, they are required to make full disclosures in this application, such as amount and periodicity of previous/other scholarship(s) [ie, one-time, per semester, etc) Disbursement compliance: Funds will be released only after verification of eligibility. All decisions are final and binding. M/s. Metrro Waste Handling Pvt Ltd., City Life Foundation & City lnfra Group reserve the right to revoke scholarships for misrepresentation or non-compliance. 5. Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-size photograph 2. Class 10th mark sheet 3. Class 12th mark sheet 4. Academic Transcript Mark sheet 5. Student Aadhar Card Copy 6. Student’s Bank passbook 7. Disability certificate issued by the concerned government authority (if applicable) 8. Family income proof (ITR, salary slips, income certificate issued by concerned Government authority, etc.) 9. Category Certificate (if applicable) 10. Clean Disciplinary Record The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->- - Scholarship to Economically Disadvantaged Students for Educational Support under CSR Initiative by Metrro Waste Handing Pvt Ltd. Company. All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents along with application from (copy enclosed) at Building No. 32, Room No.103 (B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. full_content: About The Program:- The IET India Scholarship Award is one of India's most prestigious scholarship programs for undergraduate engineering students. Established by the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), it aims to identify and support the next generation of engineering leaders in India by recognising their creativity, innovation, leadership, and academic excellence. Now in its 9th edition, the program is open to undergraduate engineering students across all years (1st to 4th year), offering a total scholarship fund of Rs 10,00,000. Applications are entirely free of cost, making this opportunity even more accessible to all eligible candidates. About the IET:- The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), one of the world’s largest professional societies for engineers, is headquartered in the UK. It collaborates with industry, academia, and government to advance engineering and technology, supporting engineers at every stage of their careers in its mission to engineer a better world. In India, IET focuses on Future Technologies, Mobility & Transport, and the Future of Work. Its esteemed Honorary Fellows include Shri Ratan Tata, N. R. Narayana Murthy, and T. V. Ramachandran. Through strategic partnerships, practical learning initiatives, and thought leadership, IET aims to enhance engineering skills, drive technology adoption, and address challenges of national importance. Eligibility for Applicants:- Open for students studying in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of a full-time regular undergraduate engineering program (in any field) approved by AICTE/UGC. Applicants must have cleared all credit courses in a single attempt. Applicants must have scored a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate (or 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) in the semesters cleared so far. There is no age limit for the applicants. Applications are entirely free of cost. Note:- Application is open for all IET members and non-members and for all branches of engineering as recognised by the AICTE/UGC. Also, lateral entry students joining a B.Tech. program in the 2nd year can apply too. Last of Registration:- 31-May-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:-The selected scholars will receive the scholarship prize as mentioned below – For Regional Round of Selection: There will be five regional centres (Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata and Mumbai), and the scholarship award will be as follows. [1] Regional round winner – Rs 60,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). [2] Regional round runner-up – Rs 40,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). For National Finals: The winners of the regional round will compete in national finals, and the scholarship award will be as follows . [1] Winner – Rs 3,00,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). [2] 1st runner-up – Rs 1,70,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). [3] 2nd runner-up – Rs 1,50,000 + Trophy + Certificate + IET Membership (1 year). Note: If a student wins the scholarship at regional and national levels, he/she will be awarded a certificate for both levels and the prize money for the national level only. Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/iet-india-scholarship-awards Link 2 : https://forms.gle/fgEL4Xo72iuDXQsT6 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in. full_content: This is in reference to the Ph.D. End Term Presentation (ETP) evaluation which shall be tentatively scheduled from May 2025 onwards (exact dates will be shared in due course of time). All the research scholars who have successfully completed their State of the Art Seminar (SAS) evaluation are required to appear for End Term Presentation (ETP) after every 6 months from the date of successful completion of SAS. Aim of the End Term Presentation a. To present the action taken against the recommendations given by the Research Advisory Committee (RAC) in the previous evaluation. b. To present the work done or progress made since the last evaluation The research scholar must fulfill the following eligibility criteria for registration process: The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 1 and ETP 2 a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy The eligibility criteria for registration for ETP 3 and onwards a. Term Registration must be completed at the time of ETP registration b. Attendance criteria must be fulfilled as per University policy for that term. c. At least one research paper submitted/communicated in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP3 evaluation. d. At least one research paper accepted/published in Scopus indexed journal required to register/appear in ETP4 and onwards evaluations except for the scholars of Ph.D.-Hindi and Punjabi domain where research paper accepted/published in UGC indexed journal will be considered for evaluation. Note: All the scholars eligible for ETP 3 and above are required to register and upload the ETP report irrespective of their publication status. If the publication condition is not fulfilled, the scholar will not be allowed to appear in front of Research Advisory Committee rather and the case will be forwarded to Research Mentorship Committee (RMC) panel for guidance regarding research publications, for which a separate schedule will be shared with such scholars. Steps for ETP Registration: - The research scholars must complete the following steps to register for ETP evaluation. 1. For Recommendation of the End Term Presentation Report: 1. The research scholar must upload the ETP report well-in-advance so that it can be recommended by the respective Supervisor/Co-supervisor/Administrative supervisor within the stipulated timelines and as per the guidelines. 2.Supervisor must ensure that the research scholars upload the files within the stipulated timelines. full_content: The Nothing Technology in India launched the second edition of The Community Edition Project, which is a contest that invites our community to re-design four elements of one of our smartphones, from hardware and software to the creative marketing campaign. Each winner gets to work with the relevant internal team to co-develop their idea in time for production and a limited sale at the end of the year! Last year, the Phone (2a) Plus Community Edition, which the company co-created with five talented community members, sold out online in just 15 mins. The winners recently became iF Gold Award recipients and have since spoken at design events across the world! This year company is inviting our community to submit a proposal on how they would re-imagine the following elements of Phone (3a): 1. Hardware Design - dream up a new look (through colour, material and finish) for Phone (3a) and have your say on the look of the packaging. 2. Software Design - ideate new software design elements to deliver a unique on-screen experience. Think widgets, wallpapers and clock faces! 3. Accessory - develop an exclusive accessory or collectible to accompany Phone (3a) Community Edition. 4. Marketing Campaign - submit a creative proposal that’ll launch (3a) Community Edition to the world. Prize: The winners of each stage will receive £1000 (or local equivalent) and will embark on the co-creation journey with the Nothing Team. We’ll pay for a trip to London for the launch event towards the end of 2025, plus any in-person workshops that we invite the winners to over the summer! They will also receive the final Phone (3a) Community Edition once it has launched. Last date of Submissions : 23rd April 2025, 11am BST Submission Link: https://nothing.tech/pages/community-edition Registered students are requested to fill this Google for confirmation-https://forms.gle/GZ1aX1d3ywzbUT1t9 The full briefs for each of the four stages are mentioned on the above mentioned website For any query please contact: - Department of student project and research, Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Student Welfare Wing -Phone: +91 98148 18964 Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Innovation and Entrepreneurship *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: Flipkart Group is committed to strengthening the retail sector including the Kirana Stores which form a significant part. As part of our endeavour, the Flipkart Foundation is supporting a scholarship for children of Kirana Store Owners to make them future-ready. The Flipkart Foundation Scholarship 2024-25 is an initiative by the Flipkart Foundation aimed at supporting deserving, financially disadvantaged students, with a strong emphasis on empowering meritorious and underprivileged female students. Aligned with goals emphasising affordable education and gender equality, the program aims to enable access to higher education and promote empowerment. Under this program, first-year students enrolled in professional STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) undergraduate programs and children of Kirana Store Owners (KSOs) in the academic year 2024-25 will receive a fixed scholarship of INR 50,000 Link to apply for the Scholarship: - https://www.buddy4study.com/page/flipkart-foundation-scholarship-program The Last date for the scholarship application is 16-Apr-2025 Eligibility Criteria of Scholarship:- Applicants must be currently studying in the 1st year of professional undergraduate STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) courses at government colleges in India. 1. One parent must be a Kirana Store Owner (KSO). 2. Applicants must have scored at least 60% in their Class 12 exams. 3. The annual family income should not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. 4. Children of employees of Flipkart Group and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply. Note: The scholarship fund may be utilized to cover academic-related expenses, including, but not limited to, tuition fees, exam fees, hostel fees, books, stationery, travel, data, food and lodging, etc. Benefits:- A fixed scholarship of INR 50,000 Documents required to be submitted by the applicant are as under: 1. Recent passport-size photograph 2. College/ Institution admission proof (Admission Letter/ Institution Identity Card, etc.) 3. Class 12 mark sheet 4. Family income proof (ITR, salary slips, income certificate issued by concerned Government authority, etc.) 5. Proof of Kirana Store Owner (Shops and Establishment Registration Act, Entity Registration, GST Registration or as applicable) 6. Proof of identity (PAN Card, Aadhaar card, Driving Licence, etc.) 7. Disability certificate issued by the concerned government authority (if applicable) 8. Payment receipts of educational expenses (tuition fees, hostel fees, books, mess fee, etc.) along with fee structure for the academic year 9. Student’s Bank passbook HOW TO APPLY: 1. Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button. 2. Login to Buddy4Study with your registered ID and land on the ‘Application Form Page.’ 3. Register at Buddy4Study with your Email/Mobile/Gmail account. 4. You will now be redirected to the ‘Flipkart Foundation Scholarship 2024-25' application form page. 5. Click on the ‘Start Application’ button to begin the application process. 6. Fill in the required details in the online application form. 7. Upload relevant documents. 8. Accept the ‘Terms and Conditions’ and click on ‘Preview’. 9. If all the details filled in by the applicant are correctly showing on the preview screen, click the ‘Submit’ button to complete the application process. The detailed guidelines for applying for this scholarship scheme can be checked from the following UMS link available in your UMS login of students: UMS Navigation------->Scholarship Management System------->Scholarship Policies-------->Session 2024-25 -------->- Flipkart Foundation Scholarship Program 2024-25- reg All the eligible students have to submit their above-mentioned documents at Building No. 32, Room No.103 (B), and Window No. 4. For Submission of documents, students must book time slots via the following UMS path: UMS Navigation -------> Scholarship Management System -------> Apply for Outer Agency Scholarship. Documents shall be received for verification by the Department of SSIV only in the booked time slots. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Deputy Registrar, Department of SSIV on RMS link: UMS Navigation – RMS – External Agency Scholarships and Credit Card Schemes – State Scholarship Information & Verification – Verification and Eligibility Criteria/Process of External Agencies Scholarship Schemes of All States (Govt./Pvt.) or contact us on 01824-444378. full_content: About The Program:- The SBIF Asha Scholarship Program for Overseas Education 2024-25, one of India's largest scholarship programs, is an initiative of the SBI Foundation under its education vertical - Integrated Learning Mission (ILM). This program aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families across India, ensuring the continuity of their education. This scholarship is open to SC/ST students pursuing a master’s or above course (any year) at a premier university/college outside India. Selected students can receive a scholarship of up to Rs 20 lakh for a year to support their educational endeavours. About SBI Foundation:- SBI Foundation is the CSR arm of the State Bank of India. Upholding its tradition of service beyond banking, the Foundation operates in over 28 States and Union Territories of India, focusing on Rural Development, Healthcare, Education, Livelihood & Entrepreneurship, Youth Empowerment, Promotion of Sports, and more. The Foundation is dedicated to contributing to the socio-economic development and betterment of underprivileged sections of society, reflecting the ethos of the SBI group by running ethical interventions that promote growth, equality, and a positive societal impact. Eligibility for Applicants:- Applicants must be Indian nationals. Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories. Applicants must be pursuing a master’s or above course (any year) at a premier university or college outside India OR should have received an acceptance/offer letter from universities outside India. Students must have secured 75% marks or above in their previous academic year. Students with a gross annual family income of up to Rs 6,00,000 are eligible to apply. Note: - Premier universities/colleges outside of India will include those listed at the top in reputed world rankings such as the QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education World University Rankings Preference will be given to students with a family income of up to Rs 3,00,000 per annum. 100% of the slots for overseas education will be reserved for SC/ST scholars. Last of Registration:- 15 April-25 till 11:59 pm Rewards:- Up to Rs 20,00,000 or 50% of course-related expenses (whichever is less). Registration Details:- Link 1 : https://www.buddy4study.com/page/sbi-asha-scholarship-program-for-overseas-education Link 2 : https://forms.gle/qVnnRP96iNqEhGjJ7 Note:- It is mandatory for all the candidates to register on both the links for participation in the scholarship. The submissions received via the buddy4study official website will be considered for the scholarship qualification. For any query, kindly email to Mr. Inderjeet Singh at inderjeet.31638@lpu.co.in. Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Industry Interface *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature
