full_content: Dear All, We are pleased to inform you that the HRD Verification process has been started, including Attestation and Apostille of educational documents through eSanad portal of Govt. of India. Earlier, the students were visiting the office of Higher Education, Punjab, Mohali for HRD verification by submitting the documents physically. Now, this process has been made online by the Govt. The link for the online attestation/ Apostille is as under: Link: https://esanad.nic.in The complete process of applying for the documents verification and fees payment to LPU & Govt. of India is available on LPU website. The links are as under: a. Fees payment link: https://www.lpu.in/esanad/frmESanad.aspx b. Complete process link: www.lpu.in/eSanad The copy of the complete process of HRD verification is enclosed for your reference (Annexure -1) Some important points for the verification process are as under: 1. After successful submission of the application on eSanad portal, the portal will generate an acknowledgment with a unique ARN (Application Registration Number). Save this acknowledgment for future reference. 2. After the final submission by the student, the request of verification of the documents will be forwarded to the university for verification of certificates. The university will check and verify the certificate and forwarded the application online to Higher Education, Punjab for further action. 3. The Higher Education will forward the application online to the Ministry of External Affairs for final verification. 4. The verified documents will be sent to the students through post by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA). 5. Student can track the application status from govt. website https://esanad.nic.in/ using the Application ID or Document ID under tab Online Services – Track your application status. For any other information, you may contact us at Building No. 32, Room No. 101 A (Window No. 2) or lodged an RMS via UMS path – UMS Navigation---> RMS --->Records and Certificates ----> E-Sanad. full_content: This is for the information of all faculty members supervising the students registered in project, dissertation and similar courses (Annexure-I) that in order to be eligible for the Final End Term Presentation (ETP) viva, each student registered in such courses need to fulfil the following points as per the specified timelines mentioned in Annexure-III (Attached). 1. Uploading the soft copy of final report. All students need to prepare the final report of their research/ project work as per the guidelines attached (in Annexure-II) and upload the soft copy of the same in four parts i.e., PDF File-1, PDF File-2, PDF File-3 and PDF file-4 (details of pdf files are given in Table 1) via their UMS as per the timelines mentioned in Annexure-III by visiting the following path: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project/Internship Certificate details-->Upload Research Project Report/Internship Certificate --->Project/Dissertation Table 1- Contents of each PDF file (size should be less than 5 MBs) PDF File 1* PDF File 2 PDF File 3 PDF File 4 (Applicable only for final stage Master Dissertation) Students need to upload their Complete Project/ research Report as PDF File 1. Students need to upload "only Content Report" which is without any student identification Information (e.g. Student's Name, Reg. Number or Title Page) as PDF File 2. Plagiarism Report is to be uploaded for Standalone Project(s), Capstone Project-II, Dissertation-II or Dissertation- III (As per Annexure-I). Allowed Plagiarism limit shall be as per the Policy which has been described under the following link available on UMS: https://www.lpu.in/academics/pdf/research-policy.pdf. Also, AI plagiarism check will be applied so students should refrain from using AI. Student need to submit graphical abstract from Thesis/Dissertation work at Master's Level) Please ensure that PDF File 1 contains student as well as supervisor signatures on the declaration certificates before uploading the same on the UMS interface. Important Note- 1. It is advised that the student(s) must ensure timely uploading of their final report before the last date of submission so that the supervisors get sufficient time to approve or to get the modifications suggested by them incorporated in the final report before final submission of the hard copy of the report in the respective administrative officer (A.O.) office by the students. 2.In Extreme cases if the final report is not ready and requires more time, student can request for an extension of maximum 60 days with a fee of Rupees 1000/- in 30-310 by filling the hard copy Extension form. 3.The guidelines (Annexure-II) attached with this announcement for the preparation of the final reports are suggestive and can vary as per the nature and amount of the work done. 4.Respective supervisors must ensure that the reports submitted by the students get approved on or before the last date of submission as specified in Annexure-III. 2. Online Report Recommendation from Supervisor: The soft copy of the final report uploaded by each student should be recommended by the supervisor in order to be eligible for the final ETP viva. In case report is not recommended by supervisor then final ETP viva for the student(s) shall not be conducted. 3. Submission of hard copy of the final report in the respective administrative office (A.O. Office) Once the respective supervisors have recommended the soft copy of the report submitted by the students, two hard copies, either spiral or hard bound (As per Annexure-I) of the same duly verified and signed by the respective supervisor must be submitted by the students in respective A.O. office as per timelines specified in Annexure-III. While submitting the hardcopy of project report the AOs must write the E-Receipt Number, sign and put their UID along with the University stamp on hardcopies carried by the student. One Signed and stamped copy of the report should be returned to the student and the same must be carried by the student at the time of ETP viva. Respective School AO’s can generate an online report submission number via the following UMS path. UMS Navigation-- >Administrative Task-->Report Submission Important Points: 1. For students working in groups, any one member of the group can make the submission in AO office and it will be considered for all. Whereas, the supervisor must recommend the uploaded soft-copy via UMS interface for all students in-order to enable hard-copy submission for the whole group. 2. In case a student fails to submit his/her final report as per the specified timelines, R grade shall be awarded. 3. Reports will be accepted in AO offices latest by 17:00 hrs. as per the last dates mentioned in Annexure-III. In case of any query, student may log an RMS request using the below mentioned link: UMS Navigation---->Relationship Management System (RMS)--->Log Request Select Department: Division of Examination Select Category: Examination Select Sub Category: Training/ Dissertation/ OJT / Thesis / Seminar / Capstone & Viva Attachment: 1 Annexure I.xls 2 Annexure II.rar 3 Annexure III.pdf Uploaded By: Office of HOD Division of Examination *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) invites applications for Intermediate Extramural Research Grants under its prestigious Investigator-Initiated Projects scheme. This call supports Indian scientists (outside ICMR institutes) to undertake impact-driven research in medicine, public health, and allied fields. The research should be based on proven concepts and aim to deliver tangible health solutions such as new diagnostics, treatments, public health interventions, or commercial/clinical products. Types of Research Supported: Discovery Research – Novel targets, drug discovery, AI/ML for biomarkers, personalized medicine, etc. Development Research – Diagnostics, medical devices, vaccines, predictive tools. Delivery/Implementation Research – Barriers in healthcare delivery, health system optimization. Descriptive Research – Burden, risk factors, disease pathogenesis. Priority Areas Include (but not limited to): Tuberculosis, Cancer, Diabetes, Cardiovascular Diseases, Maternal & Child Health, Mental Health, Vector-borne diseases, AMR, Preterm Birth, Climate & Health, Anemia, Ageing, and more. Funding & Duration: Budget: 2 Crores to < 8 Crores Duration: Up to 4 years (+ optional 6-month preparatory period, no cost) Last date of submission: 08 April 2025 Link: https://www.icmr.gov.in/post/call-for-investigator-initiated-research-proposals-for-intermediate-extramural-grants-2025-last-date-april-8-2025-5-00-pm-ist Uploaded By: Office of HOD Research and Development Cell *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

full_content: The School of Computer Science and Engineering will be offering a pathway called “Corporate – Product Based (Placement oriented track of Competitive Programming for product-based companies)” to the students currently in the second year of their study under CSE/IT programmes. Under this pathway, the following 03 courses based on competitive coding theme will be offered in the next two terms i.e. Term 5 and Term 6 besides the Engineering minor, Open Minor/Open Elective and other regular courses. PRELUDE TO COMPETITIVE CODING COMPETITIVE CODING APPROACHES-TECHNIQUES CODING PEARLS A maximum of 270 students will be registered for this pathway. The students will be selected on the basis of performance in an online programming test containing two sections. Following are the details of the shortlisting process: A separate coding based diagnostic test of 70 marks shall be conducted on 03rd May, 2025 (Saturday) on IamNeo/Hackerrank platform. The test will have 02 coding problems (each of 35 marks) to be solved in 01 hours. A section of 15 multiple choice questions on Database Management Systems, Operating Systems, Data Structures, Computer Networks (totalling 30 marks) to be solved in 15 minutes.Students who are willing to go for the Product based pathway must register themselves by 15th April 2025 on https://tinyurl.com/productBasedTest Students having a maximum of 01 E/F/G grade courses at the time of declaration of result are allowed to take this pathway. Seating plan for this diagnostic test will be shared with students shortly through a separate UMS announcement. The number of courses for the students in the coming semesters will remain the same as for all the other students. These courses will replace some of the courses. The students selected in the programming test will have to continue with the product-based pathway. There will not be any separate process to take options for product-based pathway.Students selected for product-based pathway will have to register for placement services of the University in the first phase of placement registration process. full_content: Division of Art and Culture is organizing a series of Open Mike Show at Uni-Polis(Cultural & Social Hub of LPU) on every Thursday w.e.f March 20, 2025; 5 PM onwards. The Open Mike Show will offer a creative platform for students to show case their talents and connect with one another in a positive and inclusive environment. The Open Mike Show will feature a diverse range of activities, allowing participants to showcase their unique talents and creativity. Performers can take the stage to present various forms of entertainment, including live music, stand-up comedy, poetry readings, storytelling, dance, and spoken word performances. Additionally, participants may engage the audience with improvisational acts or share their original compositions. This vibrant and inclusive event aims to provide a platform for artists of all kinds to express themselves, entertain, and connect with a supportive audience, making it a dynamic and interactive experience for both performers and spectators alike. Selection Criteria Statement for Open Mike Show (First-Come-First-Serve Basis)To ensure fairness and transparency, the Open Mike Show will be operated on a first-come-first-serve basis, where the following criteria will be used to select participants: 1.Participants must register for the Open Mic Show as soon as the registration opens. The earliest registrations will be given priority for performance slots. 2.All participants must provide accurate and complete registration details. This includes the name, contact information, preferred performance type (e.g., music, comedy, poetry). 3.Once a participant has successfully registered, they will receive a confirmation email or message with the details of their performance time. This confirmation secures their slot in the show. 4.Each participant will be allotted a specific time slot based on availability. The time limit for each performance will be communicated upon registration, and participants are expected to adhere to this limit to ensure all performers are given equal opportunity. 5.In case of a high volume of registrations, priority will be given to those who register first, up to the maximum available slots. Late registrations may be placed on a waiting list in case of cancellations. 6.If a registered performer fails to show up at the designated time or cancels without proper notice, the slot may be offered to a participant on the waiting list or the next available registrant. 7.Participants are expected to respect the event’s schedule, including arriving on time for their performance. Any late arrivals may forfeit their slot in favor of those who are on time.By adhering to these selection criteria, we aim to ensure a smooth, fair, and enjoyable experience for all participants in the Open Mic Show.Schedule: March 27, 2025; April 03, 10, 17 & 24, 2025(Every Thursday) For Registration Kindly fill the google form at https://forms.gle/bNd7fJe6SDM7gncG7 For More Info, Kindly contact Dr. Bhumika Sharma, Assistant Professor, LPU(UID:32676), BL 13-211. full_content: Centre for Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Division of Residential Services is going to conduct an event named “Interview Strategist 2.0: A Competitive Bootcamp”. This event will focus on improving the employability skills of the students through hands-on practice and discussion on interview questions and answering strategies. It will be an activity-based bootcamp that will equip students with various techniques to handle stress-based questions, situation-based questions, goal-related questions, etc. The placement interview questions asked during recent placement drives will also be discussed to give students real-time exposure. The students will also be given feedback on their language skills as per the expectations of the corporate world. The main objectives of the event are: · To equip students with essential skills, strategies, and confidence to excel in interviews. · To improve problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities, enabling students to think quickly and strategically under time constraints. · To equip participants with language proficiency, effective communication, and decision-making skills that are essential for excelling in interviews and professional settings.
